# Exact design reproduction prompt — Mohammed Khattab / Warshat Al Tagheer

Approved visual baseline: **2026-10-07**; maintained unified architecture snapshot: **2026-10-09**. This file is a reusable instruction document and an exact implementation snapshot. Its source blocks are normative, not approximate examples.

## 1. Pasteable instruction for the implementing agent

> Reproduce the approved Arabic RTL workshop design using this document. Treat the embedded source, content, CSS cascade, component tree, interaction logic, and asset manifest as the specification. First inventory the available files and compare them with the manifest. Reuse the existing implementation when present. If creating a fresh project, materialize the source blocks at their exact indicated paths and use the original visual assets and dependency lockfile. Preserve the approved design; do not redesign, paraphrase, simplify, reorder sections, invent assets, replace fonts/icons, change dependencies, or approximate values. Read this entire specification, including responsive rules and behavioral source, before implementing. Run the specified validation. Report actual differences and missing inputs; do not assert pixel equality without a measured comparison. A new page may change only the inputs explicitly requested by its user, while retaining these existing patterns and theme.

The source appendix includes one Next.js application with three main pages and the private shared package. The portfolio is `/founder`, Ta3allam is `/`, and the workshop is `/workshops/7days-freelance`; routes/API handlers live under root `app/`. `modules/` contains namespaced feature modules, not another app. Root `public/` owns assets; `modules/public` is a compatibility symlink. Preserve canonical ownership; never reconstruct a second base theme or primitive implementation inside the LMS. User-authorized changes include the recorded FAQ/duration corrections, real media/player improvements, uncaptioned reels, reusable coming-soon poster artwork, and unified routing with shared cross-page links. The 2026-10-07 pixel results below remain historical reference evidence, not a claim about an untested current reconstruction.

**Default task mode: exact workshop replication.** A request to create a different page authorizes the specified content changes, not an aesthetic redesign. With changed content, compare shared patterns and responsive behavior; do not claim that the new page has identical whole-page pixels or height to this workshop.

## 2. What exactness means

There are four separate requirements:

1. **Source/design equality:** preserve the supplied tokens, rule order, selectors, DOM nesting/classes, inline SVG paths, visible copy, image sources/dimensions, spacing, and section order.
2. **Behavior equality:** preserve menu, accordion, deferred video, countdown, signup display, hover/click states, entrance effects, reduced motion, and roadmap progression.
3. **Asset equality:** use the same font and image bytes identified by SHA-256 below. Markdown does not contain the binary fonts, JPEG/PNG/WebP files, or screenshot binaries. Supply `public/assets/` from this project alongside this prompt; do not replace it with lookalikes. Inline interface SVG paths are included in the component source. The favicon SVG, which contains a large embedded portrait, is part of the companion asset folder.
4. **Measured static pixel equality:** compare original and reconstructed pages in the same browser, viewport, device scale, font loading state, and deterministic display state. Dynamic clocks, hover positions, animation frames, different operating systems, browser versions, font rasterizers, and embedded YouTube UI can change screenshots. The verified zero-diff result is for the controlled test setup below, not a universal guarantee from a text prompt.

The project lockfile is also a companion input for an identical dependency installation. Its checksum and resolved direct versions are recorded below. Do not silently update package versions. If assets or the lockfile are missing, identify the missing files, complete the available work, and leave exact-fidelity verification explicitly pending.

## 3. Approved identity and visual character

- Active page: **ورشة التغيير**, taught by **محمد خطاب**.
- Audience: ordinary people and students. Familiar readable Arabic, direct actions, clear sections, and practical information.
- Approved references: https://warshataltagheer.vercel.app/ and https://mohamedkhattab.vercel.app/.
- This snapshot fully implements the **workshop**. Personal-site differences are captured as `--portfolio-*` theme variants; this is not a complete snapshot of the personal-site page.
- Document: `<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">`. Right-aligned Arabic is the global default; specific centered sections follow the stylesheet.
- Visual character: dark canvas, alternating dark sections, layered dark cards, white headings, muted slate body text, saturated red actions/highlights, subtle borders, restrained glow, and green live-status cues.
- Local IBM Plex Sans Arabic; do not substitute another Arabic font, CDN font, Latin display family, icon pack, or emoji for the supplied SVG geometry.
- Preserve the original red highlighted hero phrase, sparkle badge, masked grid background, large deferred-video frame, cards, timeline badges, review flags, instructor portrait, shield guarantee, accordion, final action, and compact footer.
- No additional portfolio route, extra footer contacts, invented work samples, or newly connected analytics are part of this design.

## 4. Canonical ownership and implementation rules

| Concern | Canonical location |
| --- | --- |
| Canonical visual values and portfolio variants | `packages/design-system/styles/theme.css`; root/LMS theme files are import entry points |
| Local font declarations / critical resource hints | `packages/design-system/styles/fonts.css`, `config/fonts.ts`, shared FontPreloads |
| Full shared reference cascade | `packages/design-system/styles/workshop.css`; LMS adaptations in `modules/styles/lms.css` |
| CSS import order | `app/globals.css` — theme, fonts, workshop |
| Full template and section exports | `app/components/workshop/workshop-page.tsx`, `index.ts` |
| Route entry and document/metadata | `app/page.tsx`, `app/layout.tsx` |
| Shared primitives/contracts/hooks | `packages/design-system/`; app files adapt/re-export |
| Page copy, section IDs, assets, links, option composition | `app/data/workshop/content.ts` |
| Creator/reel/curriculum/review/FAQ/signup records | Adjacent files in `app/data/workshop/` |
| Identity/contact/environment/default campaign/motion settings | `app/config/` |
| Reusable contracts | `packages/design-system/types/` |
| Local states/subscriptions | `app/hooks/` |
| Pure functions and native animation engine | `app/lib/` |

Use typed content props. Components and hooks must not import page data or configuration. UI primitives must not depend on workshop components. Keep static sections as Server Components and interactive leaves as Client Components. The public template composes the sections; it is not a second copy of their markup. Theme constants belong in CSS, not a competing JavaScript colors/sizes object.

Do not add Tailwind, GSAP, Motion, Lenis, Plyr, icon libraries, class-merging packages, global-state stores, or a different media player to reproduce this frozen version. The implementation uses Next.js, React, plain CSS, IntersectionObserver, native Web Animations, passive listeners, and requestAnimationFrame. Preserve native focus outlines, real buttons/links, unique linked control IDs, timer semantics, and decorative `aria-hidden` attributes.

Next.js special filenames create routes or metadata endpoints even in nested app directories. The page-data file is `content.ts`; the shared icon component is `ui-icon.tsx`. Do not rename either to `page.ts` or `icon.tsx`. Read the installed Next.js documentation under `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before framework changes.

## 6. Typography and layout overview

Font stack: `"IBM Plex Sans Arabic", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`. Local font files cover weights **400, 500, 600, 700**. Some supplied rules request weight **800**, using the browser's treatment of the available font faces. Do not fetch an additional font face, change the declared weights, or alter font synthesis: that can change width and wrapping.

Default browser root sizing is preserved; do not impose a new root font-size. Body line-height is `1.7`. Default headings use weight `700`, line-height `1.25`, and letter-spacing `-0.02em`. Numerals use tabular numbers and weight `800`.

| Base class | Exact typography |
| --- | --- |
| `.headline-h1` | `clamp(1.85rem,5vw,3.8rem)`, weight 800, line-height 1.25, letter-spacing -0.03em |
| `.headline-h2` | `clamp(1.45rem,3.5vw,2.75rem)`, weight 700, line-height 1.3, bottom margin 16px |
| `.headline-h3` | `clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.65rem)`, weight 600, line-height 1.35 |
| `.body-large` | `clamp(1rem,1.4vw,1.22rem)`, secondary text, line-height 1.85 |
| `.body-regular` | `clamp(0.9rem,1.1vw,1rem)`, secondary text, line-height 1.75 |

These are base rules. Section-specific rules and later media overrides in the complete stylesheet take precedence. In particular, do not recreate hero or mobile typography from this table alone.

The container is centered at max-width 1200px with horizontal padding `clamp(16px,4vw,24px)`. Standard sections use top/bottom padding `clamp(48px,7vw,92px)`, then section-specific overrides. Anchor scroll padding/margins use 130px. Both `html` and `body` clip horizontal overflow. Images/SVG/video are block elements with max-width 100%; supplied component sizing controls their rendered dimensions.

## 8. Responsive contract

| CSS condition | Required treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `min-width: 1025px` | Desktop navigation; measured corridor alignment and scarcity capsule width; desktop multicolumn layouts as specified |
| `max-width: 1024px` | Mobile/tablet navigation toggle and dropdown; 2-column client/review grids; stacked transformation stages; instructor and section overrides from this block |
| `max-width: 768px` | Full mobile adjustments, including grid stacking, timeline placement, hero/video/actions, spacing, typography, instructor, guarantee, footer, and popup |
| `max-width: 480px` | Small-mobile refinements from the exact block |
| `max-width: 374px` | Compact-mobile refinements from the exact block |
| `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` | Disable decorative/entrance motion, retain visibility and layout, minimize specified transitions |

Media blocks accumulate; apply them in their existing order. CSS cannot resolve custom properties in media conditions, so the literal breakpoints mirror named theme tokens. Do not substitute Tailwind's default breakpoints. The desktop corridor is the rounded distance from the brand title's left edge to the booking button's right edge; the scarcity capsule is the rounded distance between the outer navigation links. Reset those measured overrides at widths <=1024px. Font readiness and resize observation are necessary for accurate alignment.

## 9. Interaction and motion contract

- **Navigation:** local open state; toggle updates `aria-expanded`; unique `aria-controls`; close on link click, outside pointer, Escape, and desktop transition. Escape focuses the toggle only when this menu is open. One site header owns document-level corridor variables.
- **FAQ:** one answer open at a time, repeat click closes it, keyboard-accessible real buttons, unique question/panel IDs, CSS panel expansion, original chevron rotation.
- **Video:** no iframe/request before play. Original placeholder/frame/play icon/caption/hint. Validate HTTPS YouTube host and 11-character video ID. Click mounts the user-supplied workshop intro `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/h1G6qEPRIPg?autoplay=1&playsinline=1` from `config/creator-media.ts` (updated 2026-10-08). Activation is tied to the current URL. Preserve iframe permissions and title. The workshop now uses user-requested custom play/pause/replay, seek/time, mute/volume and fullscreen controls through the lazy YouTube IFrame API. Native controls are disabled with `controls=0`; branding/share links remain provider-owned. No separate download action or npm player package is added. Labels and dimensions are supplied from the centralized player contracts.
- **Primary actions:** original red button styles, arrow SVG, hover and active transforms; configured WhatsApp destination and encoded message; external destinations use safe new-tab attributes. Do not replace the visible booking copy with different labels.
- **Countdown:** label `ينتهي الخصم خلال :`; units يوم / ساعة / دقيقة / ثانية; default duration **431920 seconds** (4 days, 23 hours, 58 minutes, 40 seconds); key `khatab-discount-deadline-v1`; refresh every 1000ms; persist deadline, clamp at zero, preserve expiry through refresh, handle blocked storage. Milliseconds per second remain 1000 independently of refresh interval. Optional shared deadline comes from `NEXT_PUBLIC_DISCOUNT_ENDS_AT`. Server and first-client snapshots match; read clock/storage in effects.
- **Prototype display:** viewers start at 54. Signup initial name `يوسف القحطاني`; original names are supplied by data. First appearance 3000ms, visible 5200ms, repeating interval 16000ms; close hides it. These displays are not connected analytics or a real registration feed.
- **Creator marquee:** duplicate the same 6 records once; second set is decorative/hidden from assistive technology. Preserve original direction, 38s linear animation, mask/overflow treatment, and hover pause.
- **Roadmap:** hovering a day badge must highlight its own adjacent card through the enclosing day item. Scroll progress uses a viewport cursor at 0.55 of height, end inset 16px, milestone offset 0.02. Requery current markers, account for card geometry, schedule through requestAnimationFrame/passive scroll, skip repeated offscreen work, clean up listeners/observers.
- **Entrances:** native Web Animations + IntersectionObserver, once at 75% viewport height; easing `cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1)`. Exact group transforms/durations/delays/staggers are in `reference-motion.ts` below. Immediate hero groups remain immediate. Cancel finished effects so hover transforms resume. Handle restored scroll positions, resize, reduced-motion changes, and unmount. Content remains visible without JavaScript.
- **Decorative CSS:** preserve every supplied keyframe, gradient, glow, mask, hover, active, focus-visible, and pseudo-element rule. Do not add pinned scenes, horizontal-scroll stories, scroll rotation, or smooth-scroll libraries from historical experiments.
- **Hydration:** tolerate body-level extension-injected attributes through the existing body setting while leaving child hydration diagnostics enabled. Do not suppress warnings across the entire tree.

## 10. Reuse and customization procedure

For exact replication, reconstruct or reuse `WorkshopPage` with the frozen `workshopPage` content. For a user-authorized new page, use exported sections and typed contracts rather than copying markup. Page-specific copy/IDs/assets/actions belong in a new data object. Keep components, tokens, and CSS patterns unchanged unless a visual change is explicitly authorized. Update page motion selectors when changing section IDs. Distinct campaigns use distinct storage keys. Preserve stable option objects passed to hooks.

Source snapshots below include shared heading/eyebrow/rich-text/microcopy/action/image/icon/social primitives, all section and repeated-card renderers, author/stage/formula/stat subcomponents, state hooks, and utility functions. No replacement implementation should be invented when the exact implementation is supplied.

## 11. Verification and acceptance

1. Verify original font/image checksums against the manifest. Verify the companion lockfile checksum for an identical installation.
2. Read installed Next.js docs. Materialize the source blocks or reuse their files. Preserve filename case and path aliases.
3. Run `npm ci` using the companion lockfile, `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build`. Stop development before building into the same `.next` directory.
4. Start a local server. Use localhost consistently. Example: `npm start`.
5. Restore Playwright browser support if needed: `npx playwright install chromium`; ensure system libraries exist. An existing Chromium-compatible browser can be supplied via `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE`. WSL may not have access to the host's `brave` command.
6. Run `TEST_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3040 npm run test:e2e -- --workers=2`. The development-only child hydration diagnostic requires a separate development-server run; it skips on production. The frozen refactor passed all 26 checks in development.
7. Run `TEST_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3040 node scripts/compare-reference.cjs`. It serves the embedded original HTML/CSS locally beside the app and compares raster pixels and section geometry at 320, 390, 768, and 1440px with a 900px viewport height and device scale 1.
8. For static comparison, disable animations/transitions equally, fix timer digits to 03:19:27:13, hide popup/timeline decorations, decode every image, wait for fonts, use reduced motion, and apply the same original desktop alignment measurement. These controls do not replace behavioral tests.
9. Accept exact workshop reproduction only when copy/counts/order/assets pass, there is no horizontal overflow, interactions work, static geometry deltas are zero, and the pixel comparison reports zero differing pixels under matching conditions. Fix measured differences; do not update the reference to hide them.

The frozen Chromium 153 controlled comparison returned zero differing pixels at every width. Exact measured raster sizes follow; different browsers may produce different raster sizes even while both pages agree.

| 390 | 390 × 13073 | 0 |
| 768 | 768 × 13085 | 0 |
| 1440 | 1440 × 10842 | 0 |

```tsx
import EnrollmentPanel from "@platform/components/courses/enrollment-panel";
import CourseOutcomes from "@platform/components/courses/course-outcomes";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { offerCopy } from "@platform/data/offers";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { findCourse, courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { readLearningState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
import Curriculum from "@platform/components/courses/curriculum";
import CourseOverview from "@platform/components/courses/course-overview";
import { copy } from "@platform/data/site";
export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  return {
    title: (await findCourse(slug))?.title ?? interfaceCopy.courseNotFound,
  };
}
export default async function CoursePage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) notFound();
  if (course.delivery === "live") redirect(routes.workshopPage(slug));
  const state = await readLearningState();
  const progress = courseProgress(course, state);
  return (
    <main className="container lms-public-main">
      <div className="lms-breadcrumb">
        <Link href={routes.courses}>{interfaceCopy.courseBreadcrumb}</Link>
        <span>/</span>
        <span>{course.categoryLabel}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="lms-course-detail">
        <CourseOverview
          course={course}
          instructorName={interfaceCopy.instructorName}
          lessonCount={courseLessons(course).length}
          lessonsLabel={copy.lessons}
        >
          <CourseOutcomes copy={{ outcome: copy.outcome }} course={course} />
          <div className="lms-content-heading">
            <h2>{copy.courseContent}</h2>
            <p>{copy.curriculumIntro}</p>
          </div>
          <Curriculum
            copy={{ lessons: copy.lessons, preview: copy.preview }}
            course={course}
          />
        </CourseOverview>
        <EnrollmentPanel
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
          interfaceCopy={{
            courseNotesBenefit: interfaceCopy.courseNotesBenefit,
            courseProgressBenefit: interfaceCopy.courseProgressBenefit,
          }}
          copy={{
            artworkLessonLabel: copy.artworkLessonLabel,
            demoVideo: copy.demoVideo,
            error: copy.error,
            saving: copy.saving,
            continue: copy.continue,
            enrollLabel: copy.enrollLabel,
          }}
          course={course}
          slug={slug}
          progress={progress}
          enrolled={state.enrolled.includes(slug)}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { categories } from "@platform/data/courses";
import { site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { offerCopy } from "@platform/data/offers";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import { Suspense } from "react";
import CatalogFilters from "@platform/components/courses/catalog-filters";
import CourseGrid from "@platform/components/courses/course-grid";
import EmptyState from "@platform/components/ui/empty-state";
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
import { listCourses } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { copy } from "@platform/data/site";
export const metadata = { title: interfaceCopy.courseBreadcrumb };
export default async function CoursesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string; category?: string }>;
}) {
  const search = await searchParams;
  const q = typeof search.q === "string" ? search.q : "";
  const category =
    typeof search.category === "string" ? search.category : "all";
  const courses = await listCourses(q, category);
  return (
    <main className="lms-public-main container">
      <PageHeading
        title={copy.coursesTitle}
        description={copy.coursesDescription}
      />
      <Suspense>
        <CatalogFilters
          interfaceCopy={{ categoryLabel: interfaceCopy.categoryLabel }}
          categories={categories}
          copy={{ search: copy.search, searchButton: copy.searchButton }}
          query={q}
          category={category}
        />
      </Suspense>
      <div className="lms-results-meta">
        <span>
          {courses.length} {interfaceCopy.catalogTitle}
        </span>
        <span>{interfaceCopy.catalogDemoLabel}</span>
      </div>
      {courses.length ? (
        <CourseGrid
          copy={{
            lessons: copy.lessons,
            continue: copy.continue,
            progress: copy.progress,
          }}
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
          courses={courses}
        />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={copy.noResults}
          description={copy.noResultsBody}
          href={routes.courses}
          label={copy.reset}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { readAdminCourses, readAdminLessons } from "@platform/features/admin/repositories/courses";
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import CourseEditor from "@platform/components/admin/course-editor";
import LessonVideoEditor from "@platform/components/admin/lesson-video-editor";
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
import { adminCopy } from "@platform/data/admin";
import { categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { requireAdminPage } from "@platform/features/admin/page-identity";
export default async function EditCoursePage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  await requireAdminPage();
  const { slug } = await params;
  const record = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!record) notFound();
  const lessons = await readAdminLessons(slug), metadata = courseLessons(record.course);
  return <><PageHeading title={record.course.title} description={adminCopy.description}><Link href={routes.course(slug, record.course.delivery)} className="lms-text-link">{adminCopy.publicPage}</Link></PageHeading>
    <section className="lms-profile-card"><CourseEditor {...record} labels={adminCopy} categories={categories.filter(category => category.id !== "all")} /></section>
    {lessons.length > 0 && <><PageHeading title={adminCopy.lessons} />{lessons.map(lesson => <LessonVideoEditor key={lesson.id} slug={slug} lesson={{ ...lesson, title: metadata.find(item => item.id === lesson.id)?.title ?? lesson.id }} labels={adminCopy} />)}</>}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
  </>;
}
```

### File: `app/api/auth/callback/route.ts`

SHA-256: `8aa1f55bdc83959e264dd025910d8280ee89d9682075960794e8685f3943c96d`

```typescript
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { ensureProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/ensure-profile";
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url), code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  const origin = applicationOrigin();
  if (code) {
    const client = await createDatabaseClient();
    const { data, error } = await client.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    if (!error && data.user) {
      await ensureProfile(client, data.user);
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(routes.dashboard, origin), { headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" } });
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(routes.login, origin), { headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" } });
}
```

### File: `app/api/auth/logout/route.ts`

SHA-256: `b41f1a4012d92d3dae5b369a1a74cc805484f97db3158f3069910f18db6a73d5`

```typescript
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const client = await createDatabaseClient();
    const { error } = await client.auth.signOut({ scope: "local" });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "AUTH_FAILED");
    return Response.json({ status: "signed_out" });
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const course = await findCourse((await params).slug);
    if (!course) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
    return Response.json(course);
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { readResource } from "@platform/features/resources/service";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const resource = await readResource((await params).id);
    return new Response(resource.content, { headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
      "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${resource.id}.txt"`,
    } });
  });
}
```

### File: `app/components/workshop/discount-countdown.tsx`

SHA-256: `ce7b148c1ee09c610f74ac34fb5c08d6572914dd02a7bf407716cd9e8d059e50`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Fragment } from "react";
import { useDiscountCountdown } from "@/app/hooks/use-discount-countdown";
import type {
  CountdownContent,
  CountdownOptions,
} from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";

export default function DiscountCountdown({
  content,
  options,
}: {
  content: CountdownContent;
  options: CountdownOptions;
}) {
  const time = useDiscountCountdown(options);
  return (
    <div className="top-timer-item">
      <span className="top-timer-label">{content.label}</span>
      <div
        className="top-timer-boxes"
        role="timer"
        aria-label={content.accessibleLabel}
        aria-live="off"
      >
        {content.units.map((unit, index) => (
          <Fragment key={unit.key}>
            {index > 0 && (
              <span className="timer-sep" aria-hidden="true">
                :
              </span>
            )}
            <div className="timer-unit-box">
              <b className="numeral" data-countdown-unit={unit.key}>
                {time[unit.key]}
              </b>
              <small>{unit.label}</small>
            </div>
          </Fragment>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `app/components/workshop/roadmap-day.tsx`

SHA-256: `e23fc70b7f284081d9a7371a0c68654534142c9837c7d9171cd6c632d7f1c532`

```tsx
import type { RoadmapDayData, RoadmapStatus } from "@khatab/design/types/workshop";

export default function RoadmapDay({
  day,
  status,
}: {
  day: RoadmapDayData;
  status: RoadmapStatus;
}) {
  const classes = [
    "timeline-item day-item",
    day.kind !== "lesson" && `day-item-${day.kind}`,
    status !== "pending" && `is-${status}`,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
  return (
    <article
      className={classes}
      aria-current={status === "active" ? "step" : undefined}
    >
      <div className="timeline-marker day-number-col">
        <div className="day-badge-num">
          <span className="day-badge-digit">{day.number}</span>
          <span className="day-badge-text">{day.label}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="timeline-content day-card">
        <div className="day-card-header">
          <h3 className="day-card-title">{day.title}</h3>
          <span className="day-card-type-tag">{day.type}</span>
        </div>
        {day.kind === "pause" ? (
          <div className="day-pause-banner">
            <h4>{day.pauseHeading}</h4>
            <p>{day.pauseDescription}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="day-lessons-list">
            {day.lessons.map((lesson) => (
              <li key={lesson}>{lesson}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

### File: `app/components/workshop/roadmap-timeline.tsx`

SHA-256: `5e8b3901d7428546f569d580263a3897a4193963698ab3286d8a7ce29da61179`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import type { RoadmapDayData } from "@khatab/design/types/workshop";
import { useRoadmapProgress } from "@/app/hooks/use-roadmap-progress";
import RoadmapDay from "./roadmap-day";

export default function RoadmapTimeline({
  days,
}: {
  days: readonly RoadmapDayData[];
}) {
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const activeIndex = useRoadmapProgress(timelineRef, days.length);
  return (
    <div className="roadmap-timeline" ref={timelineRef}>
      <div className="timeline-track" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="timeline-progress" aria-hidden="true" />
      {days.map((day, index) => (
        <RoadmapDay
          key={day.number}
          day={day}
          status={
            index === activeIndex
              ? "active"
              : index < activeIndex
                ? "passed"
                : "pending"
          }
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useInnerCorridor } from "@/app/hooks/use-inner-corridor";
import { useMobileNavigation } from "@/app/hooks/use-mobile-navigation";
import ScarcityBar from "./scarcity-bar";
import SiteNavigation from "./site-navigation";
import type { HeaderContent } from "@khatab/design/types/marketing";
import type { CountdownOptions } from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";

export default function SiteHeader({
  content,
  offer,
}: {
  content: HeaderContent;
  offer: CountdownOptions;
}) {
  const { navigationRef, isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen } = useMobileNavigation();
  useInnerCorridor(navigationRef);
  return (
    <header className="site-header" id={content.id} ref={navigationRef}>
      <ScarcityBar content={content} offer={offer} />
      <SiteNavigation
        content={content}
        open={isMenuOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsMenuOpen(false)}
        onToggle={() => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen)}
      />
    </header>
  );
}
```

### File: `app/components/workshop/site-navigation.tsx`

SHA-256: `5e10f4659484c66f287660e061416558811615f552b364a6a13d98e329367d6c`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId } from "react";
import { useBelowBreakpoint } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-below-breakpoint";
import Container from "@khatab/design/ui/container";
import ActionLink from "@khatab/design/ui/action-link";
import Icon from "@khatab/design/ui/ui-icon";
import type { HeaderContent } from "@khatab/design/types/marketing";

export default function SiteNavigation({
  content,
  open,
  onClose,
  onToggle,
}: {
  content: Pick<
    HeaderContent,
    "brand" | "navigation" | "navigationLabel" | "toggleLabel" | "action"
  >;
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  const menuId = useId();
  const collapsed = useBelowBreakpoint("--breakpoint-navigation") && !open;
  return (
    <nav className="site-navbar" aria-label={content.navigationLabel}>
      <Container className="nav-inner">
        <a
          href={content.brand.href}
          className="nav-brand"
          aria-label={content.brand.title}
        >
          <span className="nav-brand-title">{content.brand.label}</span>
        </a>
        <ul
          id={menuId}
          className={open ? "nav-links is-open" : "nav-links"}
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-hidden={collapsed}
          inert={collapsed}
        >
          {content.navigation.map((link) => (
            <li className="nav-link-item" key={link.href}>
              <a href={link.href}>{link.label}</a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <div className="nav-actions">
          <ActionLink
            action={content.action}
            className="nav-cta-btn"
            arrow={false}
          />
          <button
            className="mobile-nav-toggle"
            type="button"
            aria-label={content.toggleLabel}
            aria-controls={menuId}
            aria-expanded={open}
            onClick={onToggle}
            data-menu-toggle
          >
            <Icon name="menu" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </Container>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
        <RoadmapSection content={content.roadmap} />
        <TestimonialsSection content={content.testimonials} />
        <InstructorSection content={content.instructor} />
        <GuaranteeSection content={content.guarantee} />
        <FaqSection content={content.faq} />
        <FinalCtaSection content={content.finalCta} />
      </WorkshopContent>
      <SiteFooter content={content.footer} />
      <RecentSignupToast
        content={content.signup.content}
        options={content.signup.options}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import palette from "../styles/theme-server.json";

// Entrance groups and timings from the approved workshop's motion script.
export const referenceMotion = {
  viewportThreshold: motion.viewport,
  easing: motion.easing,
  groups: [
    {
      trigger: ".hero-headline",
      y: motion.distanceCard,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
      delay: motion.delayHeading,
      immediate: true,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".hero-support-text",
      y: motion.distanceText,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
      delay: motion.delaySupport,
      immediate: true,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".hero-video-shell",
      y: motion.distancePreview,
      scale: motion.scalePreview,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
      delay: motion.delayPreview,
      immediate: true,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".hero-cta-wrapper",
      y: motion.distanceAction,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
      delay: motion.delayAction,
      immediate: true,
    },
    {
      trigger:
        ".clients-header, .transform-header, .roadmap-header, .testimonials-header, .faq-header",
      children: true,
      y: motion.distanceText,
      duration: motion.durationHeading,
      stagger: motion.staggerHeading,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".clients-grid, .transform-stages-grid, .testimonials-grid",
      y: motion.distanceCard,
      duration: motion.durationCard,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".featured-review-card",
      y: motion.distanceText,
      scale: motion.scaleReview,
      duration: motion.durationCard,
    },
    {
      trigger: "#instructor",
      target: ".instructor-photo-column",
      x: motion.offsetPhoto,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
    },
    {
      trigger: "#instructor",
      target: ".instructor-copy-column",
      x: motion.offsetCopy,
      duration: motion.durationMain,
    },
    {
      trigger: "#guarantee",
      target: ".guarantee-card",
      y: motion.distancePanel,
      duration: motion.durationCard,
    },
    {
      trigger: ".faq-accordion",
      target: ".faq-item",
      y: motion.distanceText,
      duration: motion.durationFaq,
      stagger: motion.staggerFaq,
    },
    {
      trigger: "#enroll",
      target: ".final-cta-box",
      y: motion.distancePanel,
      duration: motion.durationCard,
    },
  ],
} as const satisfies RevealOptions;
```

```tsx
import CertificateCard from "@platform/components/certificates/certificate-card";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
import EmptyState from "@platform/components/ui/empty-state";
import { listCourses } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { copy, site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { readStudentState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
export const metadata = {
  title: interfaceCopy.certificatesPageTitle,
};
export default async function CertificatesPage() {
  const state = await readStudentState();
  const courses = await listCourses();
  const earned = courses.filter(
    (course) =>
      state.enrolled.includes(course.slug) &&
      courseProgress(course, state).percent === 100,
  );
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeading
        title={copy.certificateTitle}
        description={copy.certificateDescription}
      />
      {earned.length ? (
        <div className="lms-resource-grid">
          {earned.map((course) => (
            <CertificateCard
              interfaceCopy={{
                certificateHeading: interfaceCopy.certificateHeading,
              }}
              copy={{ print: copy.print }}
              site={{ name: site.name, demoLabel: site.demoLabel }}
              key={course.slug}
              course={course}
              learnerName={state.profile.name}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={copy.emptyCertificates}
          description={copy.emptyCertificatesBody}
          href={routes.library}
          label={copy.continue}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { offerCopy } from "@platform/data/offers";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
import EmptyState from "@platform/components/ui/empty-state";
import CourseGrid from "@platform/components/courses/course-grid";
import { listCourses } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { readStudentState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
import { copy } from "@platform/data/site";
export const metadata = { title: interfaceCopy.libraryPageTitle };
export default async function MyCourses() {
  const state = await readStudentState();
  const courses = await listCourses();
  const enrolled = courses.filter((course) =>
    state.enrolled.includes(course.slug),
  );
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeading
        title={interfaceCopy.libraryTitle}
        description={interfaceCopy.libraryDescription}
      />
      {enrolled.length ? (
        <CourseGrid
          courses={enrolled}
          layout="dashboard"
          progress={Object.fromEntries(
            enrolled.map((course) => [
              course.slug,
              courseProgress(course, state),
            ]),
          )}
          copy={{
            lessons: copy.lessons,
            continue: copy.continue,
            progress: copy.progress,
          }}
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
        />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={copy.emptyCourses}
          description={copy.coursesDescription}
          href={routes.courses}
          label={copy.browse}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `app/dashboard/page.tsx`

SHA-256: `952bd3296f36d61283ac5b27533cbb832183ab761f66fc195124f24f63f20e08`

```tsx
import { dashboardStats } from "@platform/features/learning/helpers/dashboard-stats";
import { selectCourses } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import { catalogSettings } from "@platform/data/catalog-settings";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { site, copy } from "@platform/data/site";
import { offerCopy } from "@platform/data/offers";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import Link from "next/link";
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
import EmptyState from "@platform/components/ui/empty-state";
import DashboardStats from "@platform/components/learning/dashboard-stats";
import ContinueCard from "@platform/components/learning/continue-card";
import CourseGrid from "@platform/components/courses/course-grid";
import { readStudentState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
import { listCourses } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { hasAdminAccess } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
export const metadata = { title: interfaceCopy.dashboardLabel };
export default async function DashboardPage() {
  if (await hasAdminAccess()) redirect(routes.adminDashboard);
  const state = await readStudentState();
  const courses = await listCourses();
  const enrolled = courses.filter((course) => state.enrolled.includes(course.slug));
  const active =
    enrolled.find((course) => courseProgress(course, state).percent < 100) ??
    enrolled[0];
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow={`${interfaceCopy.greeting} ${state.profile.name}`}
        title={copy.dashboardTitle}
        description={copy.dashboardDescription}
      />
      <DashboardStats stats={dashboardStats({ state, courses: enrolled, labels: copy })} />
      {active ? (
        <ContinueCard
          interfaceCopy={{ continueContext: interfaceCopy.continueContext }}
          copy={{
            artworkLessonLabel: copy.artworkLessonLabel,
            continue: copy.continue,
            progress: copy.progress,
            lessons: copy.lessons,
          }}
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          course={active}
          progress={courseProgress(active, state)}
        />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={copy.emptyCourses}
          description={copy.coursesDescription}
          href={routes.courses}
          label={copy.browse}
        />
      )}
      <div className="lms-section-top lms-dashboard-section">
        <h2>{copy.myCourses}</h2>
        <Link href={routes.library} className="lms-text-link">
          {interfaceCopy.libraryAction}
        </Link>
      </div>
      <CourseGrid
        courses={enrolled}
        layout="dashboard"
        progress={Object.fromEntries(
          enrolled.map((course) => [
            course.slug,
            courseProgress(course, state),
          ]),
        )}
        copy={{
          lessons: copy.lessons,
          continue: copy.continue,
          progress: copy.progress,
        }}
        site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
        offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
      />
      <div className="lms-section-top lms-dashboard-section">
        <h2>{copy.recommendations}</h2>
        <Link href={routes.courses} className="lms-text-link">
          {copy.allCourses}
        </Link>
      </div>
      <CourseGrid
        courses={selectCourses(courses, catalogSettings.recommendationIds)
          .filter((course) => !state.enrolled.includes(course.slug))
          .slice(0, catalogSettings.recommendationLimit)}
        layout="dashboard"
        copy={{
          lessons: copy.lessons,
          continue: copy.continue,
          progress: copy.progress,
        }}
        site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
        offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `app/helpers/navigation/align-inner-corridor.ts`

SHA-256: `2186933fb819f4730a39bd49480adcc497109c03b47c79350e44507d5e2efc58`

```typescript
export function alignInnerCorridor(header: HTMLElement, desktop: boolean) {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  if (!desktop) {
    root.style.removeProperty("--inner-corridor-width");
    root.style.removeProperty("--top-capsule-width");
    return;
  }
  const brand = header.querySelector(".nav-brand-title")?.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cta = header.querySelector(".nav-cta-btn")?.getBoundingClientRect();
  const links = header.querySelectorAll(".nav-link-item a");
  if (brand && cta && brand.left > cta.right)
    root.style.setProperty("--inner-corridor-width", `${Math.round(brand.left - cta.right)}px`);
  if (links.length)
    root.style.setProperty("--top-capsule-width", `${Math.round(links[0].getBoundingClientRect().right - links[links.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().left)}px`);
}
```

### File: `app/helpers/roadmap/read-geometry.ts`

SHA-256: `0133dbb400e5f4f91cdb6c04fb017eb3b4786d5c57ab963186f53ed98e26e430`

```typescript
export function readRoadmapGeometry(timeline: HTMLElement, endInset: number) {
  const rect = timeline.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.bottom < 0 || rect.top > window.innerHeight) return;
  const markers = Array.from(timeline.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".timeline-marker"));
  if (!markers.length) return;
  const centers = markers.map((marker) => {
    const box = marker.getBoundingClientRect();
    return box.top + box.height / 2;
  });
  const lastCard = timeline.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".day-item:last-child .day-card");
  const start = centers[0];
  const end = lastCard ? lastCard.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - endInset : centers[centers.length - 1];
  return { top: start - rect.top, start, centers, height: Math.max(1, end - start) };
}
```

```typescript
export function readRoadmapOptions() {
  const theme = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  return {
    activation: Number(theme.getPropertyValue("--timeline-activation")),
    endInset: parseFloat(theme.getPropertyValue("--timeline-end-inset")),
    milestoneOffset: Number(theme.getPropertyValue("--timeline-milestone-offset")),
  };
}
```

### File: `app/helpers/roadmap/update-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `006a9b3135a0f0fda2b23964b6102724ea87eb5d02e19cd0a3b6c908f5d4a993`

```typescript
import { clamp } from "@/app/lib/timeline";
import { readRoadmapGeometry } from "./read-geometry";
export function updateRoadmapProgress(timeline: HTMLElement, track: HTMLElement, progress: HTMLElement, options: { activation: number; endInset: number; milestoneOffset: number }) {
  const geometry = readRoadmapGeometry(timeline, options.endInset);
  if (!geometry) return;
  for (const line of [track, progress]) {
    line.style.top = `${geometry.top}px`;
    line.style.height = `${geometry.height}px`;
  }
  const filled = clamp((window.innerHeight * options.activation - geometry.start) / geometry.height);
  progress.style.transform = `scaleY(${filled})`;
  return filled <= 0 ? -1 : geometry.centers.reduce((active, center, index) =>
    (center - geometry.start) / geometry.height - options.milestoneOffset <= filled ? index : active, -1);
}
```

### File: `app/hooks/use-discount-countdown.ts`

SHA-256: `67034c0f2146022d50a56d06b8d3a1983a5178b05d9fb59b565c6c18a3a99ade`

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { CountdownOptions } from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";
import {
  splitCountdown,
  resolveCountdownDeadline,
  remainingCountdownSeconds,
} from "@/app/lib/countdown";

export function useDiscountCountdown(options: CountdownOptions) {
  // Identical server and first-client snapshot; clock/storage are read after hydration.
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(options.durationSeconds);
  const { durationSeconds, endsAt, storageKey, tickMs } = options;
  useEffect(() => {
    let storage: Storage | undefined;
    try {
      storage = window.localStorage;
    } catch {
      /* Storage access can be blocked. */
    }
    const deadline = resolveCountdownDeadline(
      { durationSeconds, endsAt, storageKey, tickMs },
      Date.now(),
      storage,
    );
    const update = () =>
      setRemaining(remainingCountdownSeconds(deadline, Date.now()));
    const firstTick = window.setTimeout(update, 0);
    const interval = window.setInterval(update, tickMs);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(firstTick);
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [durationSeconds, endsAt, storageKey, tickMs]);
  return splitCountdown(remaining);
}
```

### File: `app/hooks/use-inner-corridor.ts`

SHA-256: `d6329238755918a0d2dada72c33b5c549fef3a512e78a0ac4c9fa190f3888036`

```typescript
import { alignInnerCorridor } from "@/app/helpers/navigation/align-inner-corridor";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";

/** Preserve the reference's alignment between the navigation and content grid. */
export function useInnerCorridor(headerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const header = headerRef.current;
    if (!header) return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const desktop = window.matchMedia(
      `(width > ${getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--breakpoint-navigation").trim()})`,
    );
    let disposed = false;
    const synchronize = () => {
      if (disposed) return;
      alignInnerCorridor(header, desktop.matches);
    };
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(synchronize);
    observer.observe(header);
    window.addEventListener("resize", synchronize);
    document.fonts.ready.then(synchronize);
    synchronize();
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", synchronize);
      root.style.removeProperty("--inner-corridor-width");
      root.style.removeProperty("--top-capsule-width");
    };
  }, [headerRef]);
}
```

```typescript
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useMenuDismissal } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-menu-dismissal";
/** Workshop navigation keeps its existing container and public state names. */
export function useMobileNavigation() {
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigationRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const close = useCallback(() => setIsMenuOpen(false), []);
  useMenuDismissal({ rootRef: navigationRef, open: isMenuOpen, onClose: close,
    focusSelector: "[data-menu-toggle]", breakpointToken: "--breakpoint-navigation" });
  return { navigationRef, isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen };
}
```

### File: `app/hooks/use-reference-signup.ts`

SHA-256: `03ca4d51a0998d271acb2a433f471dcedb08ee5a08b2b21b82bf77a4e3763abf`

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { SignupOptions } from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";

export function useReferenceSignup(options: SignupOptions) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState(options.initialName);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!options.names.length) return;
    let index = Math.max(0, options.names.indexOf(options.initialName));
    let hideTimer = 0;
    const show = () => {
      setName(options.names[index % options.names.length]);
      index++;
      setVisible(true);
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      hideTimer = window.setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), options.visibleMs);
    };
    const first = window.setTimeout(show, options.delayMs);
    const interval = window.setInterval(show, options.intervalMs);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(first);
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [options]);
  return { visible, name, close: () => setVisible(false) };
}
```

### File: `app/hooks/use-roadmap-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `d03452461dded9ea0475e18e60fbe7a33bbf4d18a1cd2ac2727f465d149a0287`

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { createFrameScheduler } from "@khatab/design/helpers/browser/animation-frame";
import { updateRoadmapProgress } from "@/app/helpers/roadmap/update-progress";
import { readRoadmapOptions } from "@/app/helpers/roadmap/read-options";
export function useRoadmapProgress(ref: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, itemCount: number) {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    const timeline = ref.current;
    const track = timeline?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".timeline-track");
    const progress = timeline?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".timeline-progress");
    if (!timeline || !itemCount || !track || !progress) return;
    const options = readRoadmapOptions();
    const { schedule, dispose } = createFrameScheduler(() => {
      const index = updateRoadmapProgress(timeline, track, progress, options);
      if (index !== undefined) setActiveIndex((previous) => previous === index ? previous : index);
    });
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(schedule);
    observer.observe(timeline);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    document.fonts.ready.then(schedule);
    schedule();
    return () => {
      dispose();
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
    };
  }, [ref, itemCount]);
  return activeIndex;
}
```

### File: `app/lib/countdown.ts`

SHA-256: `80dc44af7481869112a1610853a4099bcab6b1db0056a57e698899e4ae39f8cf`

```typescript
import type { CountdownOptions } from "@khatab/design/types/interactions";

const MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND = 1000;
type DeadlineStorage = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem">;

export function resolveCountdownDeadline(
  options: CountdownOptions,
  now: number,
  storage?: DeadlineStorage,
) {
  if (options.endsAt) {
    const deadline = Date.parse(options.endsAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(deadline))
      throw new Error(
        "Countdown endsAt must be an ISO timestamp with timezone.",
      );
    return deadline;
  }
  const deadline = now + options.durationSeconds * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND;
  try {
    const stored = storage?.getItem(options.storageKey);
    const saved = stored == null ? NaN : Number(stored);
    if (Number.isFinite(saved) && saved > 0) return saved;
    storage?.setItem(options.storageKey, String(deadline));
  } catch {
    // Storage may be blocked; keep a deadline for this mounted session.
  }
  return deadline;
}

export function remainingCountdownSeconds(deadline: number, now: number) {
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((deadline - now) / MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND));
}

export function splitCountdown(seconds: number) {
  const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  return {
    days: String(Math.floor(remaining / 86400)).padStart(2, "0"),
    hours: String(Math.floor((remaining % 86400) / 3600)).padStart(2, "0"),
    minutes: String(Math.floor((remaining % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, "0"),
    seconds: String(remaining % 60).padStart(2, "0"),
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { WorkshopPage } from "@/app/components/workshop";
import { workshopPage } from "@/app/data/workshop";
import { workshopMetadata } from "@/app/config/workshop-metadata";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/service";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { liveWorkshopCourse } from "@platform/data/workshop-course";
import { workshopCourseContent } from "@platform/features/marketing/models/workshop-course";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
type WorkshopParams = { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> };
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: WorkshopParams) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course || course.delivery !== "live") notFound();
  return { ...workshopMetadata, alternates: { canonical: routes.workshopPage(slug) }, title: { absolute: course?.title ?? liveWorkshopCourse.title }, description: course?.description ?? workshopMetadata.description };
}
export default async function FreelanceWorkshopPage({ params }: WorkshopParams) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course || course.delivery !== "live") notFound();
  return <WorkshopPage content={workshopCourseContent(workshopPage,course,liveWorkshopCourse)} />;
}
```

```typescript
import type { ReelData } from "@khatab/design/types/marketing";

import { portfolioWorks } from "./portfolio";
import media from "./portfolio-media.json";
import publishedVideos from "./portfolio-youtube.json";
import { arabicPlayerLabels as workshopPlayerLabels } from "@khatab/design/lib/player-labels";
import { formatPlayerTime } from "@khatab/design/helpers/media/format-time";

export const clientReels: readonly ReelData[] = portfolioWorks.flatMap(
  (work, index) => {
    if (!work.featured) return [];
    const published = publishedVideos.find(
      (video) => video.assetId === work.id,
    );
    if (!published)
      throw new Error(`Missing verified YouTube metadata: ${work.id}`);
    const title = published.title;
    const views = `${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(published.viewCount)} مشاهدة`;
    const asset = media[index];
    const name = `work-${String(asset.index).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    const poster = `/assets/images/portfolio/${name}.jpg`;
    return [
      {
        format: "من أعمال خطاب",
        duration: formatPlayerTime(asset.duration),
        preview: title,
        title,
        description: views,
        video: {
          source: {
            kind: "file",
            url: `/assets/video/portfolio/${name}.mp4`,
            poster,
          },
          controls: workshopPlayerLabels,
          playLabel: `تشغيل ${title}`,
          poster: { src: poster, alt: title, width: 720, height: 1280 },
        },
      },
    ];
  },
);
```

### File: `modules/components/account/auth/field.tsx`

SHA-256: `6a3c76438fef9a34f18c8d71a032fdb948a3f68cefa6bab6655fa49aab29f7f5`

```tsx
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import PasswordField from "@platform/components/ui/password-field";
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import type { AuthCopy, AuthField, AuthMode } from "@platform/types/auth";
export default function AuthFieldInput({ field, mode, copy, error, disabled }: {
  field: AuthField; mode: AuthMode; copy: AuthCopy; error?: string; disabled: boolean;
}) {
  const content = copy.fields[field];
  const common = { ...content, name: field, required: true, disabled, error };
  if (field === "password" || field === "confirmPassword") return <PasswordField {...common}
    showLabel={copy.show} hideLabel={copy.hide} dir="ltr" maxLength={authPolicy.passwordMax}
    autoComplete={mode === "login" ? "current-password" : "new-password"} />;
  return <FormField {...common} type={field === "email" ? "email" : "text"}
    dir={field === "email" ? "ltr" : undefined} autoComplete={field === "email" && mode === "login" ? "username" : field}
    maxLength={field === "email" ? authPolicy.emailMax : authPolicy.nameMax} />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/account/auth/form.tsx`

SHA-256: `f3506e4d7b697af8edd7cfc6f8587fae887b6900514cc6173152c1b76268ae2e`

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { useAuthForm } from "@platform/hooks/use-auth-form";
import type { AuthPageModel } from "@platform/types/auth";
import AuthFieldInput from "./field";
export default function AuthForm({ model }: { model: AuthPageModel }) {
  const { submit, change, blur, pending, errors, error, confirmation } = useAuthForm(model);
  return <form className="lms-profile-form lms-auth-form" method="post" action={model.endpoint} noValidate onSubmit={submit} onChange={change} onBlur={blur} aria-busy={pending}>
    {authFields[model.mode].map((field) => <AuthFieldInput key={field} field={field} mode={model.mode}
      copy={model.copy} error={errors[field] && model.copy.errors[errors[field]]} disabled={pending} />)}
    <Action kind="button" className="btn-primary" type="submit" disabled={pending}>
      {pending ? model.pending : model.submit}
    </Action>
    {confirmation && <p className="lms-success" role="status">{model.confirmationMessage}</p>}
    {error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {pending && <span className="lms-auth-status" role="status">{model.pending}</span>}
  </form>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/account/profile-form.tsx`

SHA-256: `55f3ad27b11377cba1cc0ecb6a381cbdf6933c48e56ea36f3e70816997777996`

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useId } from "react";
import { useProfileSubmission } from "@platform/hooks/use-profile-submission";
import type { Learner } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { profilePolicy } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
export default function ProfileForm({
  profile,
  entry = false,
  interfaceCopy,
  copy,
  emailPendingMessage,
}: {
  profile: Learner;
  entry?: boolean;
  emailPendingMessage?: string;
} & {
  interfaceCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"], "namePlaceholder">;
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    | "error"
    | "name"
    | "email"
    | "emailPlaceholder"
    | "saving"
    | "enterDemo"
    | "save"
    | "profileSaved"
  >;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const { submit, pending, error, saved, emailChangePending } = useProfileSubmission(entry, copy.error);
  return (
    <form className="lms-profile-form" onSubmit={submit}>
      <label htmlFor={`${id}-name`}>{copy.name}</label>
      <input
        id={`${id}-name`}
        name="name"
        defaultValue={entry ? "" : profile.name}
        required
        minLength={profilePolicy.nameMin}
        maxLength={profilePolicy.nameMax}
        autoComplete="name"
        placeholder={interfaceCopy.namePlaceholder}
      />
      <label htmlFor={`${id}-email`}>{copy.email}</label>
      <input
        id={`${id}-email`}
        name="email"
        type="email"
        dir="ltr"
        defaultValue={profile.email}
        required
        maxLength={profilePolicy.emailMax}
        autoComplete="email"
        placeholder={copy.emailPlaceholder}
      />
      <Action
        kind="button"
        className="btn-primary"
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
      >
        {pending ? copy.saving : entry ? copy.enterDemo : copy.save}
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {saved && !entry && (
        <p className="lms-success" role="status">
          {emailChangePending ? emailPendingMessage ?? copy.profileSaved : copy.profileSaved}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/admin-dialog.tsx`

SHA-256: `d10aa147f88d8dfec6f4870528190db3714260ebd2436395e1c7be462c88d83e`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export default function AdminDialog({ title, closeLabel, pending = false, onClose, children }: {
  title: string; closeLabel: string; pending?: boolean; onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null), titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = dialog.current;
    const opener = document.activeElement;
    element?.showModal();
    return () => { element?.close(); if (opener instanceof HTMLElement && opener.isConnected) opener.focus(); };
  }, []);
  return <dialog ref={dialog} className="lms-admin-dialog" aria-labelledby={titleId}
    onCancel={event => { event.preventDefault(); if (!pending) onClose(); }}>
    <header className="lms-admin-dialog-header"><h2 id={titleId}>{title}</h2>
      <button type="button" className="lms-admin-close" aria-label={closeLabel} disabled={pending} onClick={onClose}><span aria-hidden="true">×</span></button>
    </header>{children}
  </dialog>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { adminCoursePolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/admin";
import { useId } from "react";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseFields({ course, published, labels, categories }: { course: Course; published: boolean; labels: Record<string,string>; categories: readonly { id: string; label: string }[] }) {
  const id = useId();
  return <>
    <FormField label={labels.title} name="title" defaultValue={course.title} required maxLength={policy.titleMax} minLength={policy.titleMin} />
    <label htmlFor={`${id}-description`}>{labels.descriptionLabel}</label><textarea id={`${id}-description`} name="description" defaultValue={course.description} required maxLength={policy.descriptionMax} rows={4} />
    <FormField label={labels.price} name="amount" type="number" min={0} max={policy.amountMax} step="0.01" defaultValue={course.offer.amount} required />
    <label htmlFor={`${id}-category`}>{labels.category}</label><select id={`${id}-category`} name="category" defaultValue={course.category}>{categories.map(category => <option key={category.id} value={category.id}>{category.label}</option>)}</select>
    <FormField label={labels.thumbnail} name="thumbnailUrl" dir="ltr" defaultValue={course.thumbnailUrl ?? ""} maxLength={policy.urlMax} />
    <FormField label={labels.video} name="introVideoUrl" dir="ltr" defaultValue={course.introVideoUrl ?? ""} maxLength={policy.urlMax} hint={labels.mediaHint} />
    <label className="lms-admin-checkbox"><input type="checkbox" name="published" defaultChecked={published} />{labels.published}</label>
  </>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/moderation-confirmation.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
export default function ModerationConfirmation({ change, name, labels, pending, error, onConfirm, onCancel }: {
  change: UserModeration; name: string; labels: AdminUsersLabels; pending: boolean; error: string | null;
  onConfirm: () => void; onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const description = change.action === "remove" ? labels.confirmRemove : change.action === "promote" ? labels.confirmPromote : labels.confirmRestriction;
  return <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmTitle} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={pending} onClose={onCancel}>
    <p>{name}</p><p><strong>{labels[change.action]}</strong>{change.action === "suspend" && ` · ${suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)?.label}`}</p><p>{description}</p>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{error}</p>}
    <div className="lms-admin-actions"><button className="btn-primary" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.pending : labels.confirm}</button>
      <button className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={pending}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>
  </AdminDialog>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/moderation-controls.tsx`

SHA-256: `775875f6eae94e7559d7c07928799f8d85891426d77126b371692fe175612fc6`

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { AdminUser, AdminUsersLabels, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function ModerationControls({ user, labels, period, pending, onPeriod, onAction }: {
  user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels; period: SuspensionPeriod; pending: boolean;
  onPeriod: (period: SuspensionPeriod) => void; onAction: (change: UserModeration) => void;
}) {
  const periodId = useId();
  return <div className="lms-admin-controls">
    <fieldset disabled={pending}><legend>{labels.access}</legend><p>{labels.accessHint}</p>
      <label htmlFor={periodId}>{labels.period}</label>
      <div className="lms-admin-suspend"><select id={periodId} value={period} onChange={event => onPeriod(event.target.value as SuspensionPeriod)}>
        {suspensionPeriods.map(item => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.label}</option>)}
      </select><button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "suspend", period })}>{labels.suspend}</button></div>
      <div className="lms-admin-actions">
        {user.suspendedUntil && <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "restore" })}>{labels.restore}</button>}
        <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "ban" })}>{labels.ban}</button>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending || !user.confirmed}><legend>{labels.permissions}</legend><p>{labels.confirmPromote}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "promote" })}>{labels.promote}</button>
      {!user.confirmed && <p>{labels.unconfirmed}</p>}
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending} className="lms-admin-destructive"><legend>{labels.danger}</legend><p>{labels.confirmRemove}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "remove" })}>{labels.remove}</button>
    </fieldset>
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
export default function SaveFeedback({ pending, saved, error, labels }: { pending: boolean; saved: boolean; error: string; labels: { save: string; saving: string; saved: string } }) {
  return <><Action kind="button" type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.saving : labels.save}</Action>
    {error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{saved && <p className="lms-success" role="status">{labels.saved}</p>}</>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-actions.tsx`

SHA-256: `6886635fe231293d067606391a71504d409d1c28b1a3bb71162ef591078f80a2`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { AdminUser, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useUserModeration } from "@platform/hooks/use-user-moderation";
import ModerationConfirmation from "./moderation-confirmation";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
import ModerationControls from "./moderation-controls";
import UserIdentity from "./user-identity";
import UserStatus from "./user-status";
export default function UserActions({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<SuspensionPeriod>("day"), [change, setChange] = useState<UserModeration | null>(null);
  const command = useUserModeration(user.id, labels.error);
  const confirm = async () => { if (change && await command.execute(change)) { setChange(null); setOpen(false); } };
  const action = async (next: UserModeration) => {
    if (next.action === "restore") { if (await command.execute(next)) setOpen(false); }
    else setChange(next);
  };
  if (user.admin) return <span className="lms-admin-protected" title={labels.protectedAdmin}>{labels.protected}</span>;
  return <div className="lms-admin-user-actions">
    <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button lms-admin-manage" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{labels.manage}</button>
    {open && <AdminDialog title={labels.manage} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
      <UserIdentity user={user} labels={labels} /><p className="lms-admin-account-email" dir="ltr">{user.email}</p>
      <UserStatus user={user} labels={labels} />
      <ModerationControls user={user} labels={labels} period={period} pending={command.pending} onPeriod={setPeriod} onAction={next => void action(next)} />
      {command.error && !change && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{command.error}</p>}
    </AdminDialog>}
    {change && <ModerationConfirmation labels={labels} change={change} name={`${user.name} · ${user.email}`} pending={command.pending} error={command.error} onConfirm={() => void confirm()} onCancel={() => setChange(null)} />}
  </div>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-status.tsx`

SHA-256: `a6e1518d9e3b2ff7270c9fde9f6250b2a7c18951100813bb9ad34017e3e23adb`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useCurrentTime } from "@platform/hooks/use-current-time";
import { userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import { suspensionRemaining } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/suspension-remaining";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function UserStatus({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const now = useCurrentTime(userAdministration.refreshMs);
  const remaining = user.suspendedUntil && now ? suspensionRemaining(user.suspendedUntil, now) : null;
  const blocked = user.permanentlyBanned || Boolean(remaining && !remaining.expired);
  return <div className="lms-admin-status" data-blocked={blocked || undefined}>
    <strong>{user.permanentlyBanned ? labels.banned : remaining && !remaining.expired ? labels.suspended : user.suspendedUntil && !now ? "…" : labels.active}</strong>
    {user.suspendedUntil && !user.permanentlyBanned && <>
      <small>{labels.ends}: <time dateTime={user.suspendedUntil}>{new Date(user.suspendedUntil).toISOString().replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16)} UTC</time></small>
      {remaining && <small>{remaining.expired ? labels.expired : `${labels.remaining}: ${remaining.days} ${labels.days} · ${remaining.hours} ${labels.hours} · ${remaining.minutes} ${labels.minutes}`}</small>}
    </>}
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import { thumbnailUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/thumbnail-url";
import AssetImage from "@khatab/design/ui/asset-image";
import { validateArtworkKind } from "./artwork/helpers/validate-kind";
import CourseIllustration from "./artwork/illustration";
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseArtwork({
  course,
  large = false,
  showLabels = true,
  site,
  lessonLabel,
}: {
  course: Pick<Course,"modules"|"artwork"|"tool"|"categoryLabel"|"thumbnailUrl"|"delivery"|"deliveryLabel">;
  large?: boolean;
} & (
  | { showLabels: false; lessonLabel?: never }
  | { showLabels?: true; lessonLabel: string }
) & { site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName"> }) {
  if (course.thumbnailUrl) return <AssetImage asset={{ src: thumbnailUrl(course.thumbnailUrl), alt: "", width: 560, height: 260 }} className="lms-course-art" />;
  const kind = course.artwork;
  validateArtworkKind(kind);
  return (
    <div
      className={`lms-course-art lms-art-${kind} ${large ? "lms-art-large" : ""}`}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-top">
          <span className="lms-art-logo">{site.englishName.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <span>{course.tool}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <svg viewBox="0 0 560 260" fill="none">
        <path
          d="M0 52h560M0 104h560M0 156h560M0 208h560M80 0v260M160 0v260M240 0v260M320 0v260M400 0v260M480 0v260"
          stroke="var(--border-hairline)"
        />
        <CourseIllustration kind={kind} />
      </svg>
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-bottom">
          <span>{course.categoryLabel}</span>
          <span className="numeral">
            {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${lessonLabel}`}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
