### File: `modules/components/courses/course-card.tsx`

SHA-256: `f42d3c8902d664ed6014ea876eb56317220dd0a28af03272b042ed6a68891f67`

```tsx
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import ProgressBar from "@platform/components/ui/progress-bar";
import CourseArtwork from "./course-artwork";
import CoursePrice from "./course-price";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseCard({
  course,
  progress,
  copy,
  site,
  offerCopy,
}: {
  course: Course;
  progress?: {
    count: number;
    total: number;
    percent: number;
    next?: { id: string };
  };
} & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
}) {
  const detailHref = routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery);
  const actionHref = progress
    ? progress.next
      ? routes.lesson(course.slug, progress.next.id)
      : routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery)
    : routes.enrollment(course.slug, course.delivery);
  return (
    <article className="lms-course-card">
      <h3 className="lms-card-title">
        <Action kind="link" href={detailHref}>
          {course.title}
        </Action>
      </h3>
      <Action
        kind="link"
        href={detailHref}
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="lms-card-cover"
      >
        <CourseArtwork
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          course={course}
          showLabels={false}
        />
      </Action>
      <div className="lms-course-card-body">
        <div className="lms-card-summary">
          <div className="lms-card-meta">
            <span>
              <Symbol name="book" />
              {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${copy.lessons}`}
            </span>
            <span>
              <Symbol name="clock" />
              {course.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
          <CoursePrice
            offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
            offer={course.offer}
            compact
          />
        </div>
        {progress && course.delivery !== "live" && (
          <ProgressBar
            copy={{ progress: copy.progress, lessons: copy.lessons }}
            {...progress}
          />
        )}
        <Action
          kind="link"
          className="btn-primary lms-full-button lms-card-action"
          href={actionHref}
        >
          {progress ? copy.continue : course.offer.actionLabel}
          <Symbol name="arrow" />
        </Action>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    import("@platform/features/learning/helpers").CourseProgress
  >;
  layout?: "public" | "dashboard";
  motion?: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
}) {
  return (
    <RevealContent
      as="div"
      className={`lms-course-grid${layout === "dashboard" ? " lms-dashboard-grid" : ""}`}
      scope="cards"
      motion={motion}
    >
      {courses.map((course) => (
        <div className="lms-card-entrance" data-reveal key={course.slug}>
          <CourseCard
            copy={{
              lessons: copy.lessons,
              continue: copy.continue,
              progress: copy.progress,
            }}
            site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
            offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
            course={course}
            progress={progress[course.slug]}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </RevealContent>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { numbered } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/numbered";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";
import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function Curriculum({
  course,
  copy,
}: { course: Course } & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "preview">;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="lms-curriculum">
      {course.modules.map((module, index) => (
        <details key={module.title} open={index === 0}>
          <summary>
            <span className="numeral">
              {numbered(index)}
            </span>
            <b>{module.title}</b>
            <small>
              {module.lessons.length} {copy.lessons}
            </small>
          </summary>
          <ul>
            {module.lessons.map((lesson) => (
              <li key={lesson.id}>
                <Symbol name="play" />
                <span>{lesson.title}</span>
                {lesson.preview && (
                  <Link
                    className="lms-preview-link"
                    href={routes.lesson(course.slug, lesson.id)}
                  >
                    {copy.preview}
                  </Link>
                )}
                <time className="numeral">{lesson.duration}</time>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useCourseEnrollment } from "@platform/hooks/use-course-enrollment";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function EnrollButton({
  slug,
  firstLesson,
  enrolled,
  copy,
}: {
  slug: string;
  firstLesson?: string;
  enrolled: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "error" | "saving" | "continue" | "enrollLabel"
  >;
}) {
  const { start, pending, error } = useCourseEnrollment({ slug, firstLesson, enrolled, errorLabel: copy.error });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        type="button"
        className="btn-primary lms-full-button"
        disabled={pending || !firstLesson}
        onClick={start}
      >
        {pending ? copy.saving : enrolled ? copy.continue : copy.enrollLabel}
        <Symbol name="arrow" />
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default function EnrollmentPanel({

  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
  interfaceCopy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"],
    "courseNotesBenefit" | "courseProgressBenefit"
  >;

              {item}
            </li>

      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/layout/dashboard-shell.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";

import type { DashboardShellProps } from "@platform/types/dashboard-shell";

import { useId } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import { useProtectedSession } from "@platform/hooks/use-protected-session";
import { endpoints, routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import DashboardHeader from "./dashboard-header";
import DashboardSidebar from "./dashboard-sidebar";
export default function DashboardShell({
  children,
  name,
  interfaceCopy,
  dashboardNavigation,
  site,
  copy,
  sessionEndpoint = endpoints.auth.session,
}: DashboardShellProps) {
  const navigationId = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const verified = useProtectedSession(pathname, sessionEndpoint, routes.login);
  const menu = useMobileMenu({ breakpointToken: "--breakpoint-mobile" });
  if (!verified) return null;
  return (
    <div className="lms-app">
      <DashboardHeader name={name} site={site} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} />
      <div className="lms-app-grid">
        <DashboardSidebar name={name} interfaceCopy={interfaceCopy} dashboardNavigation={dashboardNavigation} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} pathname={pathname} />
        <main className="lms-app-main">{children}</main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/layout/site-header.tsx`

SHA-256: `190405ddfbcac4359fb97ad4f148704efe66ebbb9e89a6e25e6352cdb1b96199`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useBelowBreakpoint } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-below-breakpoint";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import Brand from "./brand";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function SiteHeader({
  interfaceCopy,
  marketingNavigation,
  copy,
  site,
  actions = {
    home: routes.home,
    dashboard: routes.dashboard,
    start: routes.login,
  },
}: {
  actions?: { home: string; dashboard: string; start: string };
  interfaceCopy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"],
    "mainNavigationLabel" | "dashboardLabel"
  >;
  marketingNavigation: ContentBindings["marketingNavigation"];
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "start" | "close" | "menu">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "name" | "englishName">;
}) {
  const { open, setOpen, menuRef, toggleRef } = useMobileMenu();
  const collapsed = useBelowBreakpoint("--breakpoint-navigation") && !open;
  const id = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <header className="site-header lms-site-header">
      <nav
        className="site-navbar"
        aria-label={interfaceCopy.mainNavigationLabel}
      >
        <div className="container lms-navbar">
          <Brand
            href={actions.home}
            site={{ name: site.name, englishName: site.englishName }}
          />
          <div
            className={`lms-marketing-links ${open ? "is-open" : ""}`}
            id={id}
            aria-hidden={collapsed}
            inert={collapsed}
            ref={(element) => {
              menuRef.current = element;
            }}
          >
            {marketingNavigation.map((link) => (
              <Link
                href={link.href}
                key={link.href}
                aria-current={pathname === link.href ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="lms-nav-actions">
            <Link href={actions.dashboard} className="lms-text-link">
              {interfaceCopy.dashboardLabel}
            </Link>
            <Link href={actions.start} className="btn-primary lms-nav-button">
              {copy.start}
              <Symbol name="arrow" />
            </Link>
            <button
              className="lms-mobile-toggle"
              ref={toggleRef}
              aria-label={open ? copy.close : copy.menu}
              aria-controls={id}
              aria-expanded={open}
              onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            >
              <Symbol name={open ? "close" : "menu"} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>
    </header>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/learning/lesson-notes.tsx`

SHA-256: `99eda9d1a2a972b5a5f3f0ddd628ec2915fe066b7a4512f4426e0fce404e5fe2`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useId } from "react";
import { useLessonNotes } from "@platform/hooks/use-lesson-notes";
export default function LessonNotes({
  storageKey,
  copy,
}: { storageKey: string } & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "notes" | "notesHint" | "notesUnavailable" | "notesSaved"
  >;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const { value, save, failed } = useLessonNotes(storageKey);
  return (
    <div className="lms-notes">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{copy.notes}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => save(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={copy.notesHint}
        rows={5}
      />
      <small role="status" className={failed ? "lms-error" : "text-muted"}>
        {failed ? copy.notesUnavailable : copy.notesSaved}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { numbered } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/numbered";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";
import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import ProgressBar from "@platform/components/ui/progress-bar";
import type { LessonOutlineModel } from "@platform/features/learning/helpers/lesson-outline";
export default function LessonOutline({
  model,
  active,
  copy,
}: {
  model: LessonOutlineModel;
  active: string;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "courseContent" | "completed" | "pending" | "progress" | "lessons"
  >;
}) {
  return (
    <aside className="lms-lesson-outline">
      <div className="lms-outline-heading">
        <span className="lms-small-label">{copy.courseContent}</span>

        <ProgressBar
          copy={{ progress: copy.progress, lessons: copy.lessons }}
          {...model.progress}
        />
      </div>

            {module.lessons.map((lesson) => {

                  href={lesson.href}

                  >
                    <Symbol name={complete ? "check" : "play"} />
                  </span>

                    {lesson.title}
                    <small className="numeral">
                      {lesson.duration} ·{" "}
                      {complete ? copy.completed : copy.pending}
                    </small>
                  </span>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMediaPlayerSession } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-media-player-session";
import { arabicPlayerLabels } from "@khatab/design/lib/player-labels";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import type { Course, Lesson } from "@platform/types/lms";

export default function LessonPlayer({

  lesson,
  interfaceCopy,
  copy,
  site,
}: {

  lesson: Lesson;
```

### File: `modules/components/marketing/landing-page.tsx`

```tsx
import ClientsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/clients-section";
import TestimonialsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/testimonials-section";
import ClosingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/closing-section";
import CoachingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/coaching-section";
import CourseShowcase from "@platform/components/marketing/course-showcase";
import SkillStrip from "@platform/components/marketing/skill-strip";
import SiteHeader from "@platform/components/layout/site-header";
import SiteFooter from "@platform/components/layout/site-footer";
import LandingHero from "@platform/components/marketing/landing-hero";
import InstructorSection from "@khatab/design/ui/instructor-section";
import TransformationSection from "@khatab/design/ui/transformation-section";
import FaqSection from "@khatab/design/ui/faq-section";
import { Fragment, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import RevealContent from "./reveal-content";
export interface LandingModel {
  header?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteHeader>;
  hero: ComponentProps<typeof LandingHero>;
  workSamples?: ComponentProps<typeof ClientsSection>;
  testimonials?: ComponentProps<typeof TestimonialsSection>;
  skills: ComponentProps<typeof SkillStrip>;
  courses: ComponentProps<typeof CourseShowcase>;
  steps: ComponentProps<typeof TransformationSection>;
  instructor: ComponentProps<typeof InstructorSection>;
  coaching: ComponentProps<typeof CoachingSection>;
  faq: ComponentProps<typeof FaqSection>;
  closing: ComponentProps<typeof ClosingSection>;
  footer?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteFooter>;
  order?: readonly LandingSection[];
  motion?: boolean;
}
export type LandingSection =
  | "hero"
  | "workSamples"
  | "testimonials"
  | "skills"
  | "courses"
  | "steps"
  | "instructor"
  | "coaching"
  | "faq"
  | "closing";
const defaultOrder: readonly LandingSection[] = [
  "hero",
  "skills",
  "courses",
  "workSamples",
  "steps",
  "instructor",
  "coaching",
  "testimonials",
  "faq",
  "closing",
];
export default function LandingPage({ model }: { model: LandingModel }) {
  const sections = {
    hero: <LandingHero {...model.hero} />,
    workSamples: model.workSamples && <ClientsSection {...model.workSamples} />,
    testimonials: model.testimonials && <TestimonialsSection {...model.testimonials} />,
    skills: <SkillStrip {...model.skills} />,
    courses: <CourseShowcase {...model.courses} />,
    steps: <TransformationSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.steps} />,
    instructor: <InstructorSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.instructor} />,
    coaching: <CoachingSection {...model.coaching} />,
    faq: <FaqSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.faq} />,
    closing: <ClosingSection {...model.closing} />,
  };
  return (
    <>
      {model.header && <SiteHeader {...model.header} />}
      <RevealContent motion={model.motion ?? true}>
        {(model.order ?? defaultOrder).map((key) => (
          <Fragment key={key}>{sections[key]}</Fragment>
        ))}
      </RevealContent>
      {model.footer && <SiteFooter {...model.footer} />}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useScrollReveals } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-scroll-reveals";
export default function RevealContent({
  children,
  as: Element = "main",
  className,
  scope = "page",
  options,
  motion = true,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  as?: "main" | "div";
  className?: string;
  scope?: "page" | "cards";
  options?: import("@khatab/design/types/interactions").RevealOptions;
  motion?: boolean;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useScrollReveals({ rootRef: ref, options, enabled: motion });
  return (
    <Element ref={ref} className={className} data-reveal-scope={scope}>
      {children}
    </Element>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/portfolio/header.tsx`

SHA-256: `6fd8eab54fe434d926de959aba89e8d910b8ca136f08a3f51e7da84fb08bfe5a`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId } from "react";
import type { PortfolioContent } from "@platform/types/portfolio";
import { usePortfolioNavigation } from "@platform/hooks/portfolio/use-portfolio-navigation";
export default function PortfolioHeader({
  content,
  sectionIds,
  heroId,
}: {
  content: PortfolioContent["header"];
  sectionIds: readonly string[];
  heroId: string;
}) {
  const menuId = `${content.menuId}-${useId()}`;
  const { ref, toggleRef, open, active, close, toggle } =
    usePortfolioNavigation(sectionIds, heroId);
  return (
    <header className="p-ref-site-header personal-header" ref={ref}>
      <div className="p-ref-container p-ref-nav-container">
        <a
          className="p-ref-brand-logo"
          href={content.homeHref}
          aria-label={content.label}
        >
          <span className="p-ref-brand-name">{content.brand}</span>
        </a>
        <nav
          id={menuId}
          aria-label={content.navigationLabel}
          className={`p-ref-nav-menu ${open ? "p-ref-is-open" : ""}`}
        >
          {content.navigation.map((link) => (
            <a
              className={`p-ref-nav-link ${active === link.href.slice(1) ? "p-ref-is-active" : ""}`}
              key={link.href}
              href={link.href}
              aria-current={
                active === link.href.slice(1) ? "location" : undefined
              }
              onClick={close}
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <div className="personal-header-actions">
          <a
            className="p-ref-btn p-ref-btn-primary p-ref-nav-cta"
            href={content.actionHref}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {content.action}
          </a>
          <button
            ref={toggleRef}
            className="p-ref-mobile-toggle personal-menu-toggle"
            type="button"
            aria-label={open ? content.closeLabel : content.openLabel}
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={menuId}
            onClick={toggle}
          >
            <span />
            <span />
            <span />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "./symbol";
export default function EmptyState({
  title,
  description,
  href,
  label,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
} & ({ href: string; label: string } | { href?: never; label?: never })) {
  if (href !== undefined && (!href.trim() || !label?.trim()))
    throw new Error("Invalid empty-state action");
  return (
    <div className="lms-empty">
      <Symbol name="book" />
      <h2>{title}</h2>
      <p>{description}</p>
      {href && (
        <Link href={href} className="btn-primary">
          {label}
        </Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

SHA-256: `c6e3f9b3a12735af5dc4c2547dca996aab6993ae305011f4caf8266c81effff8`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, type ComponentPropsWithoutRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export interface FormFieldProps extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"input">, "id"> {
  label: string; error?: string; hint?: string; control?: ReactNode;
}
export default function FormField({ label, error, hint, control, ...input }: FormFieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const descriptions = [error && `${id}-error`, hint && `${id}-hint`].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  return (
    <div className="lms-form-field">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <div className="lms-field-input-wrap" dir={input.dir} data-has-control={control ? true : undefined}>
        <input {...input} id={id} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={descriptions || undefined} />
        {control}
      </div>
      {hint && <small id={`${id}-hint`} className="lms-field-hint">{hint}</small>}
      {error && <p id={`${id}-error`} className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default function PageHeading({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  level = 1,
}: {
  eyebrow?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  level?: 1 | 2;
}) {
  const Heading = level === 2 ? "h2" : "h1";
  return (
    <div className="lms-page-heading">
      <div>
        {eyebrow && <p className="lms-heading-context">{eyebrow}</p>}
        <Heading>{title}</Heading>
        {description && <p className="body-regular">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/password-field.tsx`

SHA-256: `3ca7af389c27c10b606a375ae7816496bcd654fdf2a929f94a9d2aea0cf9bca1`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import FormField, { type FormFieldProps } from "./form-field";
export default function PasswordField({ showLabel, hideLabel, ...props }: Omit<FormFieldProps, "type" | "control"> & {
  showLabel: string; hideLabel: string;
}) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const action = visible ? hideLabel : showLabel;
  return <FormField {...props} type={visible ? "text" : "password"} control={
    <button className="lms-password-toggle" type="button" disabled={props.disabled}
      aria-label={`${action} ${props.label}`} aria-pressed={visible} onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}>
      {action}
    </button>
  } />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/progress-bar.tsx`

SHA-256: `a458cba65e077d037160c7e3eeae459da622064c2ce290a502f725f93fa34be4`

```tsx
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

export default function ProgressBar({
  percent,
  count,
  total,
  copy,
}: {
  percent: number;
  count: number;
  total: number;
} & { copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "progress" | "lessons"> }) {
  if (
    ![percent, count, total].every(Number.isFinite) ||
    !Number.isInteger(count) ||
    !Number.isInteger(total) ||
    percent !== (total ? Math.round((count / total) * 100) : 0) ||
    total < 0 ||
    count < 0 ||
    count > total ||
    percent < 0 ||
    percent > 100
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid progress model");
  return (
    <div className="lms-progress">
      <div className="lms-progress-label">
        <span>{copy.progress}</span>
        <b className="numeral">{percent}%</b>
      </div>
      <progress max="100" value={percent} aria-label={copy.progress} />
      <small className="text-muted">
        {count} / {total} {copy.lessons}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}: { name: SymbolName } & ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"svg">) {
```

### File: `modules/config/navigation.ts`

SHA-256: `c03452b577369d2d128422db8b954df2a94ae7127545546e6e7307095ba8b222`

```typescript
import { workshopCourseConfig } from "../../config/workshop-course";
import { projectRoutes } from "../../config/project-navigation";
/** Public destinations are owned here; route filenames remain Next.js conventions. */
const learningBase = projectRoutes.learning === "/" ? "" : projectRoutes.learning;
const segment = (value: string) => {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(value))
    throw new Error(`Invalid route segment: ${value}`);
  return value;
};
export const sectionIds = {
  courses: "courses",
  coaching: "coaching",
  instructor: "instructor",
  faq: "faq",
  steps: "how-it-works",
  enrollment: "course-enrollment",
} as const;
export const routes = {
  home: projectRoutes.learning,
  portfolio: projectRoutes.portfolio,
  workshop: projectRoutes.workshop,
  courses: `${learningBase}/courses`,
  dashboard: `${learningBase}/dashboard`,
  login: `${learningBase}/login`,
  signup: `${learningBase}/signup`,
  library: `${learningBase}/dashboard/courses`,
  resources: `${learningBase}/dashboard/resources`,
  certificates: `${learningBase}/dashboard/certificates`,
  profile: `${learningBase}/dashboard/profile`,
  admin: "/admin/dashboard/courses",
  adminDashboard: "/admin/dashboard",
  adminUsers: "/admin/dashboard",
  adminUser: (id: string) => `/admin/dashboard/users/${segment(id)}`,
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `${routes.admin}/${segment(slug)}`,
  workshopPage: (slug: string) => `/workshops/${segment(slug)}`,
  course: (slug: string, delivery?: "recorded" | "live") => delivery === "live" || slug === workshopCourseConfig.slug ? routes.workshopPage(slug) : `${learningBase}/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  lesson: (slug: string, id: string) =>
    `${learningBase}/learn/${segment(slug)}/${segment(id)}`,
  enrollment: (slug: string, delivery?: "recorded" | "live") =>
    delivery === "live" || slug === workshopCourseConfig.slug ? routes.workshopPage(slug) : `${routes.course(slug)}#${sectionIds.enrollment}`,
  section: (id: keyof typeof sectionIds) => `${projectRoutes.learning}#${sectionIds[id]}`,
  catalog: (query = "", category = "all") => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query) params.set("q", query);
    if (category !== "all") params.set("category", category);
    return routes.courses + (params.size ? `?${params}` : "");
  },
};
export const endpoints = {
  adminUsers: "/api/admin/users",
  adminUser: (id: string) => `/api/admin/users/${segment(id)}`,
  auth: { login: "/api/auth/login", signup: "/api/auth/signup", logout: "/api/auth/logout", session: "/api/auth/session" },
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `/api/admin/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  adminLesson: (slug: string, id: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/lessons/${segment(id)}`,
  courses: "/api/courses",
  enrollments: "/api/enrollments",
  progress: "/api/progress",
  profile: "/api/profile",
  introStream: (slug: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/intro`,
  lessonStream: (slug: string, id: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/lessons/${segment(id)}/stream`,
  course: (slug: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  resource: (id: string) => `/api/resources/${segment(id)}`,
  certificate: (slug: string) => `/api/certificates/${segment(slug)}`,
};
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/handle-course.ts`

SHA-256: `adcbbc94b32bbdcb992d16e5936331eca024d29c287e13f45e661ac29ff81a4b`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./repositories/courses";
import { saveCourse } from "./repositories/save-course";
import { validateCourseEdit } from "./helpers/validate-course-edit";
export async function handleAdminCourse(slug: string, request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    await requireAdmin();
    if (!request) { const record = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0]; if (!record) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND"); return Response.json(record); }
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
    const values = validateCourseEdit(await readJson(request));
    if (!values) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await saveCourse(slug,values));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/handle-lesson.ts`

SHA-256: `0f844b1af47d7e0a3b77b0e821d29435278ed398ec66b7644f0e446086a8f490`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./helpers/validate-media-url";
export async function handleAdminLesson(slug: string, id: string, request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client } = await requireAdmin();
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
    const body = await readJson(request);
    if (!validMediaUrl(body?.videoUrl) || !body.videoUrl) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
    const { data, error } = await client.from("lessons").update({ video_url: body.videoUrl }).eq("course_slug",slug).eq("id",id).select("id").maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw new ApiError(503,"INTERNAL_ERROR");
    if (!data) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/handle-user.ts`

SHA-256: `6fae92db917d19822c37c2c6f24e1c6a3334daa6dc4fced51a1850041c409e23`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { readModeration, validUserId } from "./helpers/read-moderation";
import { moderateUser } from "./repositories/moderate-user";
import { readAdminUser } from "./repositories/users";
import { readUserSubscriptions } from "./repositories/user-subscriptions";
export async function handleAdminUser(id: string, request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    await requireAdmin();
    if (!validUserId(id)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (!request) return Response.json({ user: await readAdminUser(id), subscriptions: await readUserSubscriptions(id) });
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const change = readModeration(await readJson(request));
    if (!change) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await moderateUser(id, change));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/admin-user-record.ts`

SHA-256: `9a1db8b8438b76efa36a4ab25afac1cb3f3b1304a2afab4a3842ae7699cb1e35`

```typescript
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
type Profile = Database["public"]["Tables"]["profiles"]["Row"];
export function adminUserRecord(user: User, profile: Profile | undefined, admin: boolean): AdminUser {
  const until = (user as User & { banned_until?: string }).banned_until ?? null;
  const avatar = profile?.avatar_url ?? user.user_metadata?.avatar_url;
  const name = profile?.name ?? user.user_metadata?.name;
  return { id: user.id, name: typeof name === "string" ? name : "—",
    username: profile?.username ?? `user-${user.id.replaceAll("-", "")}`, email: user.email ?? "—",
    avatarUrl: typeof avatar === "string" && /^https:\/\//.test(avatar) ? avatar : null,
    admin, confirmed: Boolean(user.email_confirmed_at), suspendedUntil: until,
    permanentlyBanned: Boolean(until && Date.parse(until) - Date.now() > 3650 * 86400000) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/read-moderation.ts`

SHA-256: `3dcfd406fa0b8d750930c1acb99acc89c858f5b7c209515d7b991a9ed80715f4`

```typescript
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export function readModeration(value: unknown): UserModeration | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("action" in value)) return null;
  if (value.action === "suspend" && "period" in value) {
    const period = suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === value.period);
    return period ? { action: "suspend", period: period.id } : null;
  }
  if (value.action === "ban" || value.action === "restore" || value.action === "remove" || value.action === "promote") return { action: value.action };
  return null;
}
export function validUserId(id: string) { return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id); }
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/suspension-remaining.ts`

SHA-256: `e085b00b4062a33f298bdda5cd3ea3c8419d846caf43004f76a8667ea9fc9a90`

```typescript
export function suspensionRemaining(until: string, now: number) {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(until) - now) / 60000));
  return { days: Math.floor(minutes / 1440), hours: Math.floor(minutes % 1440 / 60), minutes: minutes % 60, expired: minutes === 0 };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-edit.ts`

SHA-256: `d774968eca916902ee3fa9fb4300eae3147ba225d2413f4eff8f2c741e3a7bde`

```typescript
import { adminCoursePolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/admin";
import { categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./validate-media-url";
export function validateCourseEdit(input: Record<string, unknown> | null) {
  if (!input || typeof input.title !== "string" || input.title.trim().length < policy.titleMin || input.title.length > policy.titleMax ||
    typeof input.description !== "string" || input.description.trim().length < policy.descriptionMin || input.description.length > policy.descriptionMax ||
    typeof input.amount !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(input.amount) || input.amount < 0 || input.amount > policy.amountMax ||
    !categories.some(category => category.id !== "all" && category.id === input.category) ||
    !validMediaUrl(input.thumbnailUrl) || !validMediaUrl(input.introVideoUrl) || typeof input.published !== "boolean") return null;
  return { title: input.title.trim(), description: input.description.trim(), amount: input.amount, category: input.category as Exclude<typeof categories[number]["id"], "all">,
    thumbnailUrl: input.thumbnailUrl, introVideoUrl: input.introVideoUrl, published: input.published };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-media-url.ts`

SHA-256: `d09d3e0caf812769e0ba5b491baf708aa9a08e278149a5f570f3d038ccb4cc6a`

```typescript
import { adminCoursePolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/admin";
export function validMediaUrl(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > policy.urlMax) return false;
  if (!value) return true;
  if (/^\/assets\/[\w\-./]+$/.test(value)) return !value.split("/").includes("..");
  try { const url = new URL(value); return ["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password; } catch { return false; }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/identity.ts`

SHA-256: `2aaa213ab410e066c61e2bdff0349c8ae71beb24765bb8ac9d610777875c4887`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireIdentity, currentIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function hasAdminAccess() {
  const identity = await currentIdentity();
  if (!identity) return false;
  const { data, error } = await identity.client.from("admin_users").select("user_id").eq("user_id", identity.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return Boolean(data);
}
export async function requireAdmin() {
  const identity = await requireIdentity();
  if (!await hasAdminAccess()) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
  return identity;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/moderate-user.ts`

SHA-256: `6773f4112e683ef65708981160560aaee63e7f4c08f7de1b25c11ecff98d7037`

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readAdminUser } from "./users";
import { suspensionPeriods, userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export async function moderateUser(id: string, change: UserModeration) {
  const { client, user: actor } = await requireAdmin();
  const target = await readAdminUser(id);
  if (target.admin || actor.id === id) throw new ApiError(403, "PROTECTED_ADMIN");
  if (change.action === "promote") {
    const result = await client.rpc("promote_admin_user", { target_id: id });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(result.error.code === "22023" ? 400 : 503, "INVALID_INPUT");
  } else {
    const administrator = createAuthAdministrator();
    const result = change.action === "remove" ? await administrator.auth.admin.deleteUser(id)
      : await administrator.auth.admin.updateUserById(id, { ban_duration: change.action === "restore" ? "none"
        : `${change.action === "ban" ? userAdministration.permanentBanHours : (change.action === "suspend" ? suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)!.hours : 0)}h` });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
  return { saved: true };
}
```

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./courses";
import { categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { Json } from "@platform/types/database";
import type { validateCourseEdit } from "../helpers/validate-course-edit";
export async function saveCourse(slug: string, values: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof validateCourseEdit>>) {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const current = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!current) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { amount, published, ...metadata } = values;
  const course = { ...current.course, ...metadata, categoryLabel: categories.find(category => category.id === values.category)!.label,
    offer: { ...current.course.offer, amount, amountLabel: undefined } };
  const { error, data } = await client.from("courses").update({ metadata: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(course)) as NonNullable<Json>, amount, published }).eq("slug",slug).select("slug").maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  return { saved: true };
}
```

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { publicCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/public-course";
export async function readUserSubscriptions(id: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator();
  const enrollments = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug,created_at").eq("user_id", id).order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (enrollments.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!enrollments.data.length) return [];
  const courses = await client.from("courses").select("slug,metadata,amount").in("slug", enrollments.data.map(row => row.course_slug));
  if (courses.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return enrollments.data.flatMap(row => {
    const record = courses.data.find(course => course.slug === row.course_slug);
    if (!record) return [];
    const course = publicCourse(record.metadata, record.slug, record.amount);
    return [{ slug: course.slug, title: course.title, delivery: course.delivery ?? "recorded" as const, enrolledAt: row.created_at }];
  });
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import { adminUserRecord } from "../helpers/admin-user-record";
export async function readAdminUsers(page = 1) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator();
  const result = await client.auth.admin.listUsers({ page, perPage: userAdministration.pageSize });
  if (result.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const users = result.data.users, ids = users.map(user => user.id);
  if (!ids.length) return { users: [], page, hasNext: false };
  const [profiles, roles] = await Promise.all([
    client.from("profiles").select("*").in("id", ids), client.from("admin_users").select("user_id").in("user_id", ids),
  ]);
  if (profiles.error || roles.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return { users: users.map(user => adminUserRecord(user, profiles.data.find(row => row.id === user.id), roles.data.some(row => row.user_id === user.id))),
    page, hasNext: Boolean(result.data.nextPage) };
}
export async function readAdminUser(id: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator();
  const [identity, profile, role] = await Promise.all([
    client.auth.admin.getUserById(id), client.from("profiles").select("*").eq("id", id).maybeSingle(),
    client.from("admin_users").select("user_id").eq("user_id", id).maybeSingle(),
  ]);
  if (identity.error?.status === 404 || !identity.data.user) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  if (identity.error || profile.error || role.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return adminUserRecord(identity.data.user, profile.data ?? undefined, Boolean(role.data));
}
```

SHA-256: `7d5641dbdcbc37e99bc5ff46d4074d363d3f022ae0e8da00b775780c75f24aee`

```typescript
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { authCopy } from "@platform/data/auth";
import type { AuthMode } from "@platform/types/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "./helpers/validate";
import { authenticate } from "./server/authenticate";
export async function handleAuth(request: Request, mode: AuthMode) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const result = validateAuth(await readJson(request), mode);
    if (!result.valid) return Response.json({ error: authCopy.invalidRequest, fields: result.errors }, { status: 400 });
    return Response.json(await authenticate(result.values, mode));
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { readProfileResponse } from "@platform/helpers/read-profile-response";
export function readAuthResponse(input: unknown, failureLabel: string) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || !("status" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  if (input.status === "confirmation_required") return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  if (input.status !== "authenticated" || !("profile" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  try { return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: readProfileResponse(input.profile) }; }
  catch { throw new Error(failureLabel); }
}
```

```typescript
import type { AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function readAuthValues(input: unknown): AuthValues {
  const source = input && typeof input === "object" && !Array.isArray(input) ? input as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const text = (key: keyof AuthValues) => typeof source[key] === "string" ? source[key] : "";
  return { name: text("name").trim(), email: text("email").trim().toLowerCase(), password: text("password"), confirmPassword: text("confirmPassword") };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate-field.ts`

SHA-256: `d5b9bf7c4bab9903a8bd15988453668e31c930a7e058e3ae7ac464d6c74fbb0c`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import type { AuthField, AuthIssue, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuthField(field: AuthField, value: AuthValues): AuthIssue | undefined {
  if (field === "name") {
    if (!value.name) return "nameRequired";
    if (value.name.length < authPolicy.nameMin || value.name.length > authPolicy.nameMax) return "nameLength";
  }
  if (field === "email") {
    if (!value.email) return "emailRequired";
    if (!isValidEmail(value.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) return "emailInvalid";
  }
  if (field === "password") {
    if (!value.password) return "passwordRequired";
    if (value.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || value.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax) return "passwordLength";
  }
  if (field === "confirmPassword") {
    if (!value.confirmPassword) return "confirmationRequired";
    if (value.confirmPassword !== value.password) return "confirmationMismatch";
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate.ts`

SHA-256: `d604f69a9bc2e7d86a2f2363bbee9578f06be39d5ffc58ebc35fa32965e8b57d`

```typescript
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { readAuthValues } from "./read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "./validate-field";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthMode, AuthValidation } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuth(input: unknown, mode: AuthMode): AuthValidation {
  const values = readAuthValues(input), errors: AuthErrors = {};
  for (const field of authFields[mode]) {
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, values);
    if (issue) errors[field] = issue;
  }
  return Object.keys(errors).length ? { valid: false, errors } : { valid: true, values };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/server/authenticate.ts`

SHA-256: `af50854daa5ec23d8db13e2e2d2366b366e894b74de5601802d1426f7e02162b`

```typescript
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { ensureProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/ensure-profile";
import { readProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/read-profile";
import type { AuthMode, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export async function authenticate(values: AuthValues, mode: AuthMode) {
  const client = await createDatabaseClient();
  const result = mode === "login"
    ? await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: values.email, password: values.password })
    : await client.auth.signUp({ email: values.email, password: values.password, options: {
      data: { name: values.name }, emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback`,
    } });
  if (result.error) {
    if (result.error.status === 429) throw new ApiError(429, "RATE_LIMITED");
    throw new ApiError(mode === "login" ? 401 : 400, mode === "login" ? "INVALID_CREDENTIALS" : "AUTH_FAILED");
  }
  if (!result.data.session || !result.data.user) return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  await ensureProfile(client, result.data.user);
  return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: await readProfile(client, result.data.user) };
}
```

SHA-256: `f79d2dfa7304e252b7d3d7de00dbc04d9218a5b4105fcdded63e36130f8c9625`

```typescript

export function formatCourseDuration(seconds: number) {
  const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60),
    hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60),
    rest = minutes % 60;
  const arabic = (value: number) =>
    String(value).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩"[Number(digit)]);
  const hour =
    hours === 1 ? "ساعة" : hours === 2 ? "ساعتان" : `${arabic(hours)} ساعات`;
  const minute = `${arabic(rest || minutes)} ${(rest || minutes) >= 3 && (rest || minutes) <= 10 ? "دقائق" : "دقيقة"}`;
  return hours ? (rest ? `${hour} و${minute}` : hour) : minute;
}
```

```typescript

export function parseLessonTime(value: string) {
  if (!/^\d+:\d{2}$/.test(value))
    throw new Error(`Invalid lesson duration: ${value}`);
  const [minutes, seconds] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  if (seconds > 59) throw new Error(`Invalid lesson seconds: ${value}`);
  return minutes * 60 + seconds;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { validateCourse } from "./validate-course";
import { validateLessons } from "./validate-lessons";
export function publicCourse(metadata: unknown, slug: string, amount: number): Course {
  const course = metadata as Course;
  const result = { ...course, slug, offer: { ...course.offer, amount } };
  validateCourse(result, new Set());
  validateLessons(result, result.modules.flatMap(section => section.lessons.flatMap(lesson => lesson.resourceIds)));
  return { ...result, modules: result.modules.map(section => ({ ...section,
    lessons: section.lessons.map(lesson => ({ ...lesson, videoUrl: "" })),
  })) };
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { courseLessons } from "./course-lessons";
export function selectPreview(
  catalog: readonly Course[],
  courseId: string,
  lessonIds: readonly string[],
) {
  const course = catalog.find((item) => item.slug === courseId);
  if (!course) return undefined;
  const lessons = courseLessons(course);
  return {
    course,

      return lesson ? [lesson] : [];

  };
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-course.ts`

SHA-256: `4f412f910119f496b9632e539e84b87593a3908bfa6d9f2c8b5615878b74f919`

```typescript
import { artworkKinds, categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function validateCourse(course: Course, slugs: Set<string>) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(course.slug) || slugs.has(course.slug) ||
      !course.title.trim() || (!course.modules.length && course.delivery !== "live") ||
      !categories.some((category) => category.id === course.category) ||
      !artworkKinds.includes(course.artwork) || !Number.isFinite(course.offer.amount) ||
      course.offer.amount < 0 || !course.offer.actionLabel.trim())
    throw new Error(`Invalid course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (course.delivery === "live" && (!course.deliveryLabel?.trim() || !course.duration.trim())) throw new Error(`Invalid live course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (course.modules.some((module) => !module.title.trim() || !module.lessons.length))
    throw new Error(`Empty published module: ${course.slug}`);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-lessons.ts`

SHA-256: `6d44c87d39be9b052d5bbf3b361b0c77e8d37bfd83e6527e5b168207ebe16588`

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { courseLessons } from "./course-lessons";
export function validateLessons(course: Course, resourceIds: readonly string[]) {
  const ids = new Set<string>(), lessons = courseLessons(course);
  if (!lessons.length && course.delivery !== "live") throw new Error(`Empty published course: ${course.slug}`);
  for (const lesson of lessons) {
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(lesson.id) || !lesson.title.trim() ||
        ids.has(lesson.id) || !Number.isFinite(lesson.durationSeconds) || lesson.durationSeconds <= 0)
      throw new Error(`Invalid lesson: ${lesson.id}`);
    ids.add(lesson.id);
    if (lesson.resourceIds.some((id) => !resourceIds.includes(id)))
      throw new Error(`Unknown lesson resource: ${lesson.id}`);
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/stream-drive.ts`

SHA-256: `6e29e5198247591739d5d4bd3dd025a9aa5f458da8367fb05ce8d0055edca1c8`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { driveFileId } from "@platform/helpers/media/drive-file-id";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function streamDrive(url: string, request: Request) {
  const id = driveFileId(url);
  if (!id) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  const range = request.headers.get("range");
  if (range && !/^bytes=\d*-\d*$/.test(range)) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const response = await fetch(`https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=${id}&export=download&confirm=t`, {
    headers: range ? { Range: range } : {}, signal: request.signal, cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok || !/^(video\/|application\/octet-stream)/i.test(response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")) {
    await response.body?.cancel(); throw new ApiError(503,"MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE");
  }
  const headers = new Headers({ "Content-Type": response.headers.get("content-type") === "application/octet-stream" ? "video/mp4" : response.headers.get("content-type")!, "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" });
  for (const name of ["Content-Length","Content-Range","Accept-Ranges"]) { const value = response.headers.get(name); if (value) headers.set(name,value); }
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers });
}
```

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { readLearningState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
import { certificatePresentation } from "./presentation";
import { renderCertificate } from "./renderer";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import { site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { learningIdentity } from "@/config/identity";
export async function downloadCertificate(slug: string) {
  await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const state = await readLearningState();
  if (!state.enrolled.includes(slug) || courseProgress(course, state).percent !== 100) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
  const svg = renderCertificate({ brandName: site.name, brandEnglishName: site.englishName,
    learnerName: state.profile.name, courseTitle: course.title, title: interfaceCopy.certificateTitle,
    disclaimer: interfaceCopy.certificateDisclaimer }, certificatePresentation);
  return new Response(svg, { headers: { "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8",
    "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${learningIdentity.exportPrefix}-${slug}.svg"` } });
}
```

```typescript
export interface CertificateModel {
  brandName: string;
  brandEnglishName: string;
  learnerName: string;
  courseTitle: string;
  title: string;
  disclaimer: string;
}
export interface CertificatePresentation {
  colors: { primary: string; background: string; text: string };
  fontBase64: string;
}
const escapeXml = (text: string) =>
  text.replace(
    /[<>&"']/g,
    (char) =>
      ({
        "<": "&lt;",
        ">": "&gt;",
        "&": "&amp;",
        '"': "&quot;",
        "'": "&apos;",
      })[char]!,
  );
export function renderCertificate(
  model: CertificateModel,
  presentation: CertificatePresentation,
) {
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="850" viewBox="0 0 1200 850"><rect width="1200" height="850" fill="${presentation.colors.background}"/><rect x="35" y="35" width="1130" height="780" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="${presentation.colors.primary}" stroke-width="2"/><style>@font-face{font-family:CertificateArabic;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,${presentation.fontBase64}) format('truetype');font-weight:700;}</style><g font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="${presentation.colors.text}" font-family="CertificateArabic"><text x="600" y="150" font-size="44">${escapeXml(model.brandName)} / ${escapeXml(model.brandEnglishName)}</text><text x="600" y="285" font-size="40">${escapeXml(model.title)}</text><text x="600" y="400" font-size="48">${escapeXml(model.learnerName)}</text><text x="600" y="505" font-size="30">${escapeXml(model.courseTitle)}</text><text x="600" y="650" font-size="24">${escapeXml(model.disclaimer)}</text></g></svg>`;
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readState } from "./repositories/read-state";
import { enrollCourse } from "./repositories/enroll-course";
export async function handleEnrollment(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!request) {
      const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
      return Response.json(await readState(client, user));
    }
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const body = await readJson(request);
    if (typeof body?.courseSlug !== "string") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await enrollCourse(body.courseSlug));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/helpers/course-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `d896c8b9e3d1a0a5dc37f749eb985ba9e9fd111d83c4fbc1ead896f853e2e298`

```typescript
import { courseLessons, lessonKey } from "../../catalog/helpers";
import type { Course, LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function courseProgress(
  course: Course,
  state: Pick<LearningState, "completed">,
) {
  const lessons = courseLessons(course),
    completed = new Set(state.completed);
  const count = lessons.filter((lesson) =>
    completed.has(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
  ).length;
  return {
    count,
    total: lessons.length,
    percent: lessons.length ? Math.round((count / lessons.length) * 100) : 0,
    next: lessons.find(
      (lesson) => !completed.has(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
    ),
  };
}
export type CourseProgress = ReturnType<typeof courseProgress>;
```

```typescript
    },
  ];
}
```

```typescript
import { courseProgress } from "./course-progress";

        href: lessonHref(course.slug, lesson.id),
        complete: state.completed.includes(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
      })),
    })),
  };
}
export type LessonOutlineModel = ReturnType<typeof lessonOutline>;
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/read-lesson-context.ts`

SHA-256: `eb0ecc74e7661f84b120ffd57b1a194b03b1ba27f9220615fe9c03b295ef1599`

```typescript
import { playableUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/playable-url";
import { currentIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readPlayback } from "../catalog/repositories/read-playback";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { findCourse } from "../catalog/service";
import { findLesson, courseLessons, lessonKey } from "../catalog/helpers";
import { readLearningState } from "./service";
export async function readLessonContext(slug: string, lessonId: string) {
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) notFound();
  const lesson = findLesson(course, lessonId);
  if (!lesson) notFound();
  if (!lesson.preview && !await currentIdentity()) redirect(routes.login);
  const state = await readLearningState();
  const enrolled = state.enrolled.includes(slug);
  if (!enrolled && !lesson.preview) redirect(routes.course(slug));
  const lessons = courseLessons(course);
  const index = lessons.findIndex((item) => item.id === lessonId);
  return { slug, lessonId, course, lesson: { ...lesson, videoUrl: playableUrl(await readPlayback(slug, lessonId), slug, lessonId) }, state, enrolled, lessons, index,
    next: lessons[index + 1], complete: state.completed.includes(lessonKey(slug, lessonId)) };
}
export type LessonContext = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readLessonContext>>;
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/repositories/enroll-course.ts`

SHA-256: `7c918d9b720035e5ed4f11aea1a827b7d6f7a851adcc209fa238918c777bf74e`

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/service";
import { readState } from "./read-state";
export async function enrollCourse(slug: string) {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error: lookupError } = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("course_slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (lookupError) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) {
    if (course.delivery === "live" || course.offer.amountLabel || course.offer.amount > 0) throw new ApiError(403, "PAYMENT_REQUIRED");
    const { error } = await client.from("enrollments").insert({ user_id: user.id, course_slug: slug });
    if (error && error.code !== "23505") throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
  return readState(client, user);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/repositories/read-state.ts`

```typescript
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { readProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/read-profile";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
export async function readState(client: DatabaseClient, user: User): Promise<LearningState> {
  const [profile, enrollment, progress] = await Promise.all([
    readProfile(client, user),
    client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id),
    client.from("lesson_progress").select("course_slug,lesson_id").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("completed", true),
  ]);
  if (enrollment.error || progress.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return { profile, enrolled: enrollment.data.map((row) => row.course_slug), completed: progress.data.map((row) => `${row.course_slug}/${row.lesson_id}`) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/repositories/save-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `b24063d3844ee7494239b69cb49d9e1d5b04ab42a07c88c8d28aa7de3cce8319`

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/service";
import { findLesson } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import { readState } from "./read-state";
export async function saveProgress(slug: string, id: string, completed: boolean) {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course || !findLesson(course, id)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error: accessError } = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("course_slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (accessError) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
  const { error } = await client.from("lesson_progress").upsert({ user_id: user.id, course_slug: slug, lesson_id: id, completed }, { onConflict: "user_id,course_slug,lesson_id" });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return readState(client, user);
}
```

```typescript
import type { MarketingPageContent } from "@khatab/design/types/marketing";
import type { VideoContent } from "@khatab/design/types/ui";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { getYouTubeEmbedUrl } from "@khatab/design/lib/video";
import { playableUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/playable-url";
import { thumbnailUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/thumbnail-url";
export function workshopCourseContent(content: MarketingPageContent, course: Course, defaults: Course): MarketingPageContent {
  const source = course.introVideoUrl || defaults.introVideoUrl!;
  const video: VideoContent = { controls: content.hero.video.controls, controlsVariant: content.hero.video.controlsVariant,
    returnToPosterOnEnd: content.hero.video.returnToPosterOnEnd, title: content.hero.video.title,
    playLabel: content.hero.video.playLabel, caption: content.hero.video.caption, hint: content.hero.video.hint,
    poster: { ...content.hero.video.poster!, src: thumbnailUrl(course.thumbnailUrl || defaults.thumbnailUrl!) },
    ...(getYouTubeEmbedUrl(source) ? { url: source } : { source: { kind: "file" as const, url: playableUrl(source,course.slug) } }),
  };
  return { ...content, hero: { ...content.hero, video,
    title: course.title === defaults.title ? content.hero.title : [course.title],
    description: course.description === defaults.description ? content.hero.description : course.description,
  } };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/profile/handle-request.ts`

SHA-256: `ab9a050e13e13ecf9d74a9e35b42a21bb08e9efe605ee039e33b98dbad657275`

```typescript
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readProfile } from "./repositories/read-profile";
import { validateProfile } from "./validation";
export async function handleProfile(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
    if (!request) return Response.json(await readProfile(client, user));
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const profile = validateProfile(await readJson(request));
    if (!profile) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (profile.email !== user.email) {
      const { error } = await client.auth.updateUser({ email: profile.email }, { emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` });
      if (error) throw new ApiError(400, "AUTH_FAILED");
    }
    const { error } = await client.from("profiles").upsert({ id: user.id, name: profile.name });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
    return Response.json({ name: profile.name, email: user.email, emailChangePending: profile.email !== user.email });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/profile/repositories/ensure-profile.ts`

SHA-256: `021dc2a34b1fcdfa97d4d463e4e8a2595d4f7590634028d63835f1353f86a059`

```typescript
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { profilePolicy } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function ensureProfile(client: DatabaseClient, user: User) {
  const candidate = user.user_metadata.name;
  const name = typeof candidate === "string" && candidate.trim().length >= profilePolicy.nameMin && candidate.trim().length <= profilePolicy.nameMax ? candidate.trim() : interfaceCopy.demoLearnerName;
  const { error } = await client.from("profiles").upsert({ id: user.id, name }, { onConflict: "id", ignoreDuplicates: true });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

```typescript
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
export async function readProfile(client: DatabaseClient, user: User) {
  const { data, error } = await client.from("profiles").select("name").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const name = data?.name ?? interfaceCopy.demoLearnerName;
  return { name, email: user.email ?? "" };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/profile/validation.ts`

SHA-256: `4f5ce368774694f43d61beab8b0d8ce38403d9a179ee1a143cc016123bb04ddf`

```typescript
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import type { Learner } from "@platform/types/lms";
export const profilePolicy = {
  nameMin: 2,
  nameMax: 60,
  emailMax: 100,
} as const;
export function validateProfile(input: unknown, { allowEmptyEmail = false }: { allowEmptyEmail?: boolean } = {}): Learner | null {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return null;
  const value = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof value.name !== "string" || typeof value.email !== "string")
    return null;
  const name = value.name.trim(),
    email = value.email.trim();
  if (
    name.length < profilePolicy.nameMin ||
    name.length > profilePolicy.nameMax ||
    email.length > profilePolicy.emailMax ||
    (!(allowEmptyEmail && email === "") && !isValidEmail(email, profilePolicy.emailMax))
  )
    return null;
  return { name, email };
}
```

### File: `modules/helpers/media/drive-file-id.ts`

SHA-256: `71ddab98d633cd37cc7a474ce8f0b1408597d4dee155016b4d778f0d3892e2f4`

```typescript
export function driveFileId(value: string) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname !== "drive.google.com") return null;
    const id = url.pathname.match(/^\/file\/d\/([\w-]+)/)?.[1] ?? url.searchParams.get("id");
    return id && /^[\w-]{8,200}$/.test(id) ? id : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}
```

```typescript
/** Highlight every literal match without adding or dropping source text. */
export function highlightText(body: string, emphasis: string) {
  if (!emphasis) return [{ text: body, highlighted: false }];
  return body.split(emphasis).flatMap((text, index) =>
    index ? [{ text: emphasis, highlighted: true }, { text, highlighted: false }]
      : [{ text, highlighted: false }]);
}
```

```typescript
export function navigationRootMargin() {
  // IntersectionObserver resolves percentages against width, not viewport height.
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--personal-navigation-root-margin")
    .trim().split(/\s+/).map((value, index) => index % 2 === 0 && value.endsWith("%")
      ? `${parseFloat(value) / 100 * innerHeight}px` : value).join(" ");
}
```

### File: `modules/helpers/portfolio/observe-active-section.ts`

SHA-256: `564d7d8c56a2796cba69f1c3faf5cee530264eae058ae27c0f358a0ed3117e73`

```typescript
import { navigationRootMargin } from "./navigation-root-margin";
export function observeActiveSection(ids: readonly string[], onActive: (id: string) => void) {
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    const visible = entries.filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
      .sort((a, b) => b.boundingClientRect.top - a.boundingClientRect.top);
    if (visible[0]) onActive(visible[0].target.id);
  }, { rootMargin: navigationRootMargin() });
  ids.forEach((id) => {
    const section = document.getElementById(id);
    if (section) observer.observe(section);
  });
  return observer;
}
```

```typescript
import type { PortfolioAction } from "@platform/types/portfolio";
export function readPortfolioAction(action: { href: string; label: string; variant: string; icon: string; external?: boolean }): PortfolioAction {
  const { variant, icon } = action;
  if (variant !== "primary" && variant !== "secondary") throw new Error("Invalid portfolio action variant");
  if (icon !== "arrow" && icon !== "play" && icon !== "email" && icon !== "whatsapp") throw new Error("Invalid portfolio action icon");

}
```

```typescript
export function updatePortfolioHeader(header: HTMLElement, hero: HTMLElement | null) {
  const threshold = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(header).getPropertyValue("--personal-header-scroll-threshold"));
  header.classList.toggle("p-ref-is-scrolled", scrollY > threshold);
  header.querySelector(".p-ref-brand-name")?.classList.toggle("p-ref-is-hero-active",
    Boolean(hero && hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > header.getBoundingClientRect().bottom));
```

### File: `modules/helpers/portfolio/update-timeline.ts`

SHA-256: `f0f29340bb9190fecf5893a09bad006ef5f9ec15a93dacb8daa305048cdebf55`

```typescript
export function updatePortfolioTimeline(root: HTMLElement, reduced: boolean) {
  const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
  const threshold = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--personal-timeline-trigger"));
  const edge = innerHeight * threshold;
  root.style.setProperty("--personal-progress", String(reduced ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (edge - rect.top) / rect.height))));
  root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-timeline-item]").forEach((item) =>
    item.classList.toggle("is-active", reduced || item.getBoundingClientRect().top <= edge));
}
```

```typescript
import type { LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { validateProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
export function readLearningResponse(input: unknown): LearningState {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid learning response");
  const value = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  const profile = validateProfile(value.profile, { allowEmptyEmail: true });
  if (!profile || !Array.isArray(value.enrolled) || !Array.isArray(value.completed)
    || !value.enrolled.every((id): id is string => typeof id === "string")
    || !value.completed.every((id): id is string => typeof id === "string"))
    throw new Error("Invalid learning response");
  return { profile, enrolled: value.enrolled, completed: value.completed };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { createFrameScheduler } from "@khatab/design/helpers/browser/animation-frame";
import { updatePortfolioTimeline } from "@platform/helpers/portfolio/update-timeline";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
/** One frame per scroll batch; mutate decorative geometry without React renders. */
export function useTimelineProgress(ref: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const preference = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const update = () => updatePortfolioTimeline(root, preference.matches);
    const { schedule, dispose } = createFrameScheduler(update);
    update();
    addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    preference.addEventListener("change", schedule);
    return () => {
      dispose();
      removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
      preference.removeEventListener("change", schedule);
    };
  }, [ref]);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
export function useAdminSave(path: string, errorLabel: string, options: { refresh?: boolean } = {}) {
  const router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const save = async (body: unknown) => {
    setSaved(false);
    const result = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path, body, failureLabel: errorLabel, decode: value => {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("saved" in value) || value.saved !== true) throw new Error(errorLabel);
      return true;
    } }));
    if (result) { setSaved(true); if (options.refresh !== false) router.refresh(); }
    return Boolean(result);
  };
  return { save, pending: command.pending, error: command.error, saved };
}
```

### File: `modules/hooks/use-async-command.ts`

SHA-256: `89a32f35eebc94733edbda382f9fba4e1bed7fb50c3cc66cf46f518527e40fba`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
/** Own pending/error and exclusion for the entire workflow, not each HTTP step. */
export function useAsyncCommand(failureLabel: string) {
  const inFlight = useRef(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function run<T>(command: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null> {
    if (inFlight.current) return null;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try { return await command(); }
    catch (error) {
      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : failureLabel);
      return null;
    } finally { inFlight.current = false; setPending(false); }
  }
  return { pending, error, run };
}
```

### File: `modules/hooks/use-auth-form.ts`

SHA-256: `30db054f61613bbb9e81ae8ebbdbbe30122611f1bfaa15d3ed87fba9d0305a04`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate";
import { readAuthValues } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate-field";
import { readAuthResponse } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-response";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthPageModel } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function useAuthForm({ mode, endpoint, redirectTo, copy }: Pick<AuthPageModel, "mode" | "endpoint" | "redirectTo" | "copy">) {
  const command = useAsyncCommand(copy.requestError);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<AuthErrors>({});
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState(false);
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState(false);
  function change(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (field) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
    setEdited(true);
    setConfirmation(false);
  }
  function blur(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (!field) return;
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, readAuthValues(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(event.currentTarget))));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: issue }));
  }
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const result = validateAuth(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)), mode);
    setEdited(false);
    if (!result.valid) {
      setErrors(result.errors);
      const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => result.errors[field]);
      const input = field && form.elements.namedItem(field);
      if (input instanceof HTMLElement) input.focus();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    const response = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoint, body: result.values, failureLabel: copy.requestError, decode: (input) => readAuthResponse(input, copy.requestError) }));
    if (response?.status === "confirmation_required") { form.reset(); setConfirmation(true); }
    if (response?.status === "authenticated") { form.reset(); window.location.assign(redirectTo); }
  }
  return { submit, change, blur, errors, pending: command.pending, confirmation, error: edited ? "" : command.error };
}
```
