```typescript
"use client";
import { persistencePolicy } from "@platform/config/persistence";
import { useCallback, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
export function useLessonNotes(key: string) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const subscribe = useCallback((notify: () => void) => {
    window.addEventListener("storage", notify);
    window.addEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", notify);
      window.removeEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    };
  }, []);
  const snapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }, [key]);
  const value = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, () => "");
  function save(text: string) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, text);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(persistencePolicy.notesEvent));
      setFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }
  return { value, save, failed };
}
```

```typescript
import { readProfileResponse } from "@platform/helpers/read-profile-response";
import { validateProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/validation";
import { endpoints, routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
export function useProfileSubmission(entry: boolean, errorLabel: string) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { run, pending, error } = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState("");
  const [emailChangePending, setEmailChangePending] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaved(false);
    setValidationError("");
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    if (
      !validateProfile({ name: form.get("name"), email: form.get("email") })
    ) {
      setValidationError(errorLabel);
      return;
    }
    const result = await run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoints.profile,
      body: { name: form.get("name"), email: form.get("email") },
      failureLabel: errorLabel, decode: input => ({ profile: readProfileResponse(input), emailChangePending: Boolean(input && typeof input === "object" && "emailChangePending" in input && input.emailChangePending) }) }));
    if (result) {
      setSaved(true);
      setEmailChangePending(result.emailChangePending);
      if (entry) router.push(routes.dashboard);
      router.refresh();
    }
  }
  return { submit, pending, error: validationError || error, saved, emailChangePending };
}
```

SHA-256: `a7b2d7e396a04a0269d479c1100efe00b4cba0f8a01c6505c0dd4611061cc20e`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
export function useProtectedSession(pathname: string, endpoint: string, login: string) {
  const [verifiedPath, setVerifiedPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let controller: AbortController | undefined;
    const verify = async () => {
      controller?.abort();
      controller = new AbortController();
      const signal = controller.signal;
      setVerifiedPath(null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store", signal });
        if (!response.ok || (await response.json()).status !== "authenticated") {
          window.location.replace(login);
          return;
        }
        if (!signal.aborted) setVerifiedPath(pathname);
      } catch {
        if (!signal.aborted) window.location.replace(login);
      }
    };
    void verify();
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", verify);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", verify);
    return () => {
      controller?.abort();
      window.removeEventListener("pageshow", verify);
      window.removeEventListener("popstate", verify);
    };
  }, [pathname, endpoint, login]);
  return verifiedPath === pathname;
}
```

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "./error";
import { backendCopy } from "@platform/data/backend-copy";
export async function apiResponse(action: () => Promise<Response>) {
  try {
    const response = await action();
    response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    const missing = error instanceof Error && error.message === "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED";
    const status = error instanceof ApiError ? error.status : missing ? 503 : 500;
    const code = error instanceof ApiError ? error.code : missing ? "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED" : "INTERNAL_ERROR";

  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpError } from "./http-error";
export interface HttpRequestOptions<T> {
  path: string; body: unknown; failureLabel: string;
  decode: (input: unknown) => T;
  fetcher?: typeof fetch; signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export async function httpRequest<T>({ path, body, failureLabel, decode, fetcher = fetch, signal }: HttpRequestOptions<T>): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetcher(path, {
    method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body), signal,
  }).catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  const data: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = data && typeof data === "object" && "error" in data ? data.error : undefined;
    throw new HttpError(response.status, typeof error === "string" ? error : failureLabel);
  }
  return decode(data);
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/server-request.ts`

SHA-256: `a891eded91e4284d1ca62ee7ace9e1e162f11da5f141b380d2703b46ee307647`

```typescript
import { requestPolicy } from "@platform/config/request";
export async function readJson(request: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  if (!request.body) return null;
  const reader = request.body.getReader();
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let length = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      length += value.byteLength;
      if (length > requestPolicy.maxJsonBytes) { await reader.cancel(); return null; }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
  } catch { return null; }
  finally { reader.releaseLock(); }
}
export function sameOrigin(request: Request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return true;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(origin);
    const host = request.headers.get("host") ?? new URL(request.url).host;
    return (
      ["http:", "https:"].includes(parsed.protocol) && parsed.host === host
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) throw new Error("SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  return { url, key };
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`

SHA-256: `0539e5b42c077e6d1e93e420a74eb46921161a51e19f794d8a5511d8508b1142`

```typescript
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) return NextResponse.next();
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment();
  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const client = createServerClient(url, key, { cookies: {
    getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
    setAll(values, headers) {
      values.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
      response = NextResponse.next({ request });
      values.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options));
      Object.entries(headers).forEach(([name, value]) => response.headers.set(name, value));
    },
  } });
  if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/admin/") || request.nextUrl.pathname === routes.dashboard || request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${routes.dashboard}/`)) {
    const { data, error } = await client.auth.getUser();
    if (error || !data.user) {
      const target = request.nextUrl.clone();
      target.pathname = routes.login;
      target.search = "";
      const denied = NextResponse.redirect(target);
      response.cookies.getAll().forEach(cookie => denied.cookies.set(cookie));
      denied.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
      return denied;
    }
  } else await client.auth.getClaims();
  response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
  return response;
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/server.ts`

SHA-256: `ef3a18d0f0a3cca2f441086046339e65ba0005e64ef0bdbe66f5107ff8b31c10`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

/**
 * If using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a global variable. Always create a new client within each
 * function when using it.
 */
export async function createDatabaseClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment()

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    url,
    key,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing
            // user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}
```

```css
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-section-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-section-top .body-large {
  max-width: var(--size-54ch);
}
.lms-course-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-course-card {
  min-width: 0;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
.lms-course-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
}
.lms-course-art {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-135deg),
    var(--bg-surface-elevated),
    var(--bg-main)
  );
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.lms-course-art svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-art-top,
.lms-art-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-art-top > span:last-child {
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-unit);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-art-logo {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  letter-spacing: var(--lms-size-0_12em);
}
.lms-art-bottom {
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-art-large {
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
}
.lms-hero-preview .lms-art-large {
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-course-card-body {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
}
.lms-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-card-meta > span {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-5px);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-card-meta .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-heading-tight);
  height: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-benefits-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-3xl);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-benefit-list > div {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-benefit-list > div:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-benefit-list > div > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--size-44px);
  height: var(--size-44px);
  padding: var(--size-10px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-benefit-list h3 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-benefit-list p {
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-footer {
  background: var(--color-0b0e11);
  padding: var(--size-40px) 0 var(--space-lg);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-footer-grid {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-footer-grid p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-comfortable);
  max-width: var(--measure-footer-copy);
}
.lms-footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  padding-top: var(--size-20px);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-public-main {
  padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--size-80px);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-70vh);
}
.lms-page-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
  font-size: clamp(
    var(--lms-size-1_7rem),
    var(--lms-size-3vw),
    var(--lms-size-2_5rem)
  );
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-page-heading p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-64ch);
}
.lms-catalog-controls {
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-560px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-heading-tight);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-search > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-search input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  padding: var(--size-10px) 0;
  outline: 0;
}
.lms-search:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-search button {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-md);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-filter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a {
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-md);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a:hover,
.lms-filter-tabs > .is-active {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-results-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-empty {
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) dashed var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-empty > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  margin: 0 auto var(--size-20px);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-empty h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-empty p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-detail {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--size-360px);
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  align-items: start;
}
.lms-course-title {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-3_5vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-detail-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
}
.lms-detail-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
}
.lms-outcomes {
  margin: var(--space-xl) 0;
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-outcomes h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-comfortable);
}
.lms-outcomes ul,
.lms-enrollment-body ul,
.lms-takeaways {
  list-style: none;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-outcomes li,
.lms-enrollment-body li,
.lms-takeaways li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-outcomes .lms-icon,
.lms-enrollment-body li .lms-icon,
.lms-takeaways .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  width: var(--dimension-18);
  height: var(--dimension-18);
}
.lms-content-heading {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-content-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_4rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-content-heading p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}
.lms-curriculum {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-curriculum details {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-curriculum summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-comfortable);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.lms-curriculum summary::after {
  content: "+";
  margin-right: auto;
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
}
.lms-curriculum details[open] summary::after {
  content: "−";
}
.lms-curriculum summary > span {
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-curriculum summary b {
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}
.lms-curriculum summary small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-curriculum ul {
  list-style: none;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-curriculum li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-comfortable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-curriculum li:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-curriculum li > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-heading-tight);
  height: var(--space-heading-tight);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-curriculum time {
  margin-right: auto;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-preview-link {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.lms-enrollment-card {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-110px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-enrollment-body {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-enrollment-body h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-enrollment-body ul {
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
}
.lms-enrollment-body li {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-full-button {
  width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight) !important;
}
.lms-demo-note {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-app-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--layer-dashboard-header);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  min-height: var(--size-80px);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-navigation));
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-app-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-demo-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: var(--size-3px) var(--size-10px);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--size-38px);
  height: var(--size-38px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.lms-app-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-248px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-1600px);
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.lms-sidebar {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-80px);
  align-self: start;
  min-height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
  padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-comfortable);
  border-left: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-main);
}
.lms-sidebar-profile {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: 0 var(--space-unit) var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-sidebar-profile b {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  display: block;
}
.lms-sidebar-profile small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-sidebar nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-heading-tight);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a.is-active {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-sidebar-help {
  margin-top: var(--space-2xl);
  padding: var(--space-comfortable);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}
.lms-sidebar-help > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-sidebar-help b {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-sidebar-help p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin: var(--space-unit) 0 var(--space-control);
}
.lms-sidebar-help a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
}
.lms-sidebar-home {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-app-main {
  padding: var(--size-40px);
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
}
.lms-app-main .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
}
.lms-stat-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-stat-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}
.lms-stat-card > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  width: var(--size-40px);
  height: var(--size-40px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  padding: var(--size-9px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-stat-card b {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_8rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-compact);
  display: block;
}
.lms-stat-card span {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-continue-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-continue-card > .lms-course-art {
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  border-bottom: 0;
  min-height: var(--lms-size-270px);
}
.lms-continue-card > div:last-child {
  padding: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-continue-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-continue-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-continue-card .btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-progress {
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0 var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-progress-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-progress-label b {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-progress progress {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--size-5px);
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}
.lms-progress progress::-webkit-progress-bar {
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}
.lms-progress progress::-webkit-progress-value {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-progress progress::-moz-progress-bar {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-progress small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-unit);
  display: block;
}
.lms-dashboard-section {
  margin-top: var(--size-36px);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-dashboard-section h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
}
.lms-dashboard-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.lms-learn-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-320px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-1600px);
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.lms-lesson-outline {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-80px);
  align-self: start;
  height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
  overflow-y: auto;
  border-left: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-main);
}
.lms-outline-heading {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-outline-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-outline-module h3 {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--size-20px) var(--space-control);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-outline-module h3 span {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-outline-module a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight) var(--size-20px);
  border-right: var(--size-3px) solid transparent;
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-label);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-outline-module a small {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: var(--size-5px);
}
.lms-outline-module a.is-active {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.lms-outline-module a:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-outline-check {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-outline-check .lms-icon {
  width: var(--dimension-12);
  height: var(--dimension-12);
}
.lms-outline-check.is-complete {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  border-color: var(--accent-green-border);
  background: var(--accent-green-subtle);
}
.lms-lesson-main {
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  min-width: 0;
}
.lms-lesson-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-lesson-title h1 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_55rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-lesson-duration {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-lesson-player {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.lms-lesson-player iframe,
.lms-player-button {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  display: block;
}
.lms-player-button {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
}
.lms-player-button .lms-course-art {
  height: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
}
.lms-player-button .lms-course-art > svg {
  opacity: 0.4;
}
.lms-player-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-20-26-0-7);
}
.lms-player-overlay .video-play-button {
  margin: 0;
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.lms-player-overlay small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  max-width: 90%;
}
.lms-player-overlay > span:not(.video-play-button) {
  font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  max-width: 90%;
}
.lms-lesson-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-lesson-actions .btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-is-complete {
  border-color: var(--accent-green-border);
  color: var(--accent-green);
  background: var(--accent-green-subtle);
}
.lms-lesson-information {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-lesson-information h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-lesson-information p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-comfortable);
}
.lms-takeaways {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-takeaways li {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
}
.lms-resource-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
}
.lms-resource-link > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.lms-resource-link small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-xs);
}
.lms-resource-link > .lms-icon:last-child {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-notes {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  align-self: start;
}
.lms-notes label {
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-notes textarea,
.lms-profile-form input,
.lms-profile-form textarea,
.lms-profile-form select {
  display: block;
  resize: vertical;
  width: 100%;
  font-family: inherit;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-control);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
}
.lms-notes small {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-resource-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-resource-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.lms-resource-symbol {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-resource-card > small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-resource-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin: var(--size-10px) 0;
}
.lms-resource-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-resource-card .lms-secondary-button {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  align-self: stretch;
}
.lms-profile-card {
  max-width: var(--lms-size-640px);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-avatar-large {
  width: var(--size-60px);
  height: var(--size-60px);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
}
.lms-profile-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-profile-form label {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  margin-top: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-profile-form .btn-primary {
  justify-self: start;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card > .lms-demo-note {
  margin-top: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-error {
  color: var(--color-ffb3aa);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-success {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-login-page {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--size-80px);
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: var(--size-80px);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-80vh);
}
.lms-login-message h1 {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-4vw), var(--lms-size-3_4rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-login-steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-login-card {
  padding: var(--size-40px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-login-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0 var(--space-control);
}
.lms-login-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-login-card > small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-login-card .btn-primary {
  width: 100%;
}
.lms-certificate {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-align: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-certificate > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-certificate h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
}
.lms-certificate h3 {
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}
.lms-certificate small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-not-found {
  display: flex;
  min-height: var(--lms-size-90vh);
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  text-align: center;
}
.lms-not-found h1 {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}
.lms-not-found p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-loading {
  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-70vh);
}
.lms-skeleton {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  animation: lmsSkeleton var(--lms-size-1_6s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
.lms-skeleton-heading {
  width: 50%;
  height: var(--lms-size-70px);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-40px);
}
.lms-skeleton-card {
  height: var(--size-360px);
}
@keyframes lmsSkeleton {
  from {
    opacity: 0.45;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .lms-marketing-links {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-unit)));
    transition:
      opacity var(--transition-smooth),
      transform var(--transition-smooth),
      visibility var(--motion-duration-instant) linear var(--motion-duration-surface);
  }
  .lms-mobile-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
  .lms-marketing-links {
    display: flex;
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    right: 0;
    left: 0;
    padding: var(--size-20px) var(--space-lg);
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    background: var(--bg-main);
    border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-marketing-links.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: none;
    transition-delay: var(--motion-duration-instant);
  }
  .lms-marketing-links a {
    padding: var(--space-unit) 0;
  }
  .lms-course-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .lms-course-detail {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--lms-size-320px);
    gap: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-app-grid {
    grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-210px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .lms-app-main {
    padding: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-app-header {
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-comfortable);
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-stat-card > .lms-icon {
    width: var(--space-xl);
    height: var(--space-xl);
    padding: var(--size-7px);
  }
  .lms-continue-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-continue-card > .lms-course-art {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-resource-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .lms-learn-grid {
    grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-280px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .lms-lesson-information {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-lesson-main {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-login-page {
    gap: var(--size-40px);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container > span {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .lms-site-header .site-navbar {
    padding: var(--space-control) 0;
  }
  .lms-navbar {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-nav-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-nav-actions > .lms-text-link {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-nav-button {
    padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control) !important;
    font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  }
  .lms-brand {
    font-size: var(--size-1_45rem);
  }
  .lms-brand-mark {
    font-size: var(--size-1_2rem);
  }
  .lms-brand small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-landing-hero {
    padding-top: var(--size-40px);
    padding-bottom: var(--size-40px);
  }
  .lms-landing-hero .hero-headline {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--lms-size-1_8rem),
      var(--size-5vw),
      var(--size-2_75rem)
    );
  }
  .lms-landing-hero .hero-support-text {
    font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  }
  .lms-hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    margin: var(--space-lg) auto var(--space-md);
    max-width: var(--size-360px);
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-hero-actions .btn-primary {
    font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  }
  .lms-hero-preview {
    margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  }
  .lms-preview-body {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-preview-body > .lms-course-art {
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons {
    border-right: 0;
    border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons h2 {
    font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons h2 br {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-section-top {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-course-grid {
    gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  }
  .lms-benefits-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-footer-grid {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .lms-footer-links {
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-course-detail {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-xl);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-card {
    position: static;
    order: -1;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-card > .lms-course-art {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body ul {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body h2 {
    font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body .lms-demo-note {
    margin-top: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-public-main {
    padding-top: var(--space-xl);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  }
  .lms-page-heading {
    margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-results-meta {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-app-header {
    padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);
    min-height: var(--size-72px);
  }
  .lms-app-header-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-app-header-actions > .lms-text-link {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-app-grid,
  .lms-learn-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-sidebar {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-sidebar.is-open {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: var(--size-72px) 0 0;
    z-index: var(--layer-sidebar);
    overflow: auto;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .lms-app-main {
    padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-stat-grid {
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-control);
    gap: var(--space-unit);
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-stat-card span {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-stat-card b {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  }
  .lms-continue-card > div:last-child {
    padding: var(--size-22px);
  }
  .lms-continue-card h2 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  }
  .lms-resource-grid {
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-resource-card {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-lesson-outline {
    position: static;
    height: auto;
    order: 2;
    border-left: 0;
    border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  }
  .lms-lesson-main {
    padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title {
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title h1 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  }
  .lms-lesson-duration {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-lesson-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .lms-lesson-information {
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay .video-play-button {
    width: var(--size-50px);
    height: var(--size-50px);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay > span:not(.video-play-button) {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay {
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-login-page {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-xl);
    padding-top: var(--size-40px);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  }
  .lms-login-message h1 {
    font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  }
  .lms-login-card {
    padding: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-profile-card {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-not-found h1 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lms-course-grid,
  .lms-resource-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-course-card-body {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-filter-tabs > a {
    padding: var(--size-7px) var(--size-10px);
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-app-header .lms-demo-label {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-search {
    padding: var(--size-6px) var(--size-10px);
    gap: var(--space-unit);
  }
  .lms-search input {
    font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  }
  .lms-search button {
    padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-preview-titlebar {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
    padding: var(--size-10px) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip b {
    font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container {
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-curriculum li {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .lms-curriculum li > span {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary {
    gap: var(--space-unit);
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary b {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-detail-meta {
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-course-title {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_7rem);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-player-overlay small {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-stat-card span {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2),
  .lms-app-main .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
    font-size: var(--size-1_6rem);
  }
  .lms-footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-hero-actions .btn-primary {
    padding: var(--space-heading-tight) var(--space-comfortable) !important;
  }
  .lms-brand {
    gap: var(--size-6px);
  }
  .lms-nav-button > .lms-icon {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lms-skeleton {
    animation: none;
  }
  .lms-course-card:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Course cards: title → clean cover → information right / price left → action. */
.lms-course-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: var(--size-3px) solid var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-card:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-card > a .lms-course-art {
  aspect-ratio: 16/7;
}
.lms-course-card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-card-title a {
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-smooth);
}
.lms-card-title a:hover,
.lms-card-title a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.lms-course-price {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-course-price > div {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.lms-price-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-course-price strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-control);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.lms-course-price strong small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
}
.lms-price-caption {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  text-align: end;
  max-width: 50%;
}
.lms-card-action {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  min-height: var(--size-50px);
}
#course-enrollment {
  scroll-margin-top: var(--size-110px);
}

.lms-card-title {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  margin: 0;
}
.lms-card-cover {
  display: block;
}
.lms-card-summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-card-summary .lms-card-meta {
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-price-compact {
  margin: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  text-align: left;
}
.lms-course-card-body > .lms-card-action {
  margin-top: auto;
}

/* Bold, large labels preserve the approved white-on-red main action identity. */
.btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-action);
}
.btn-primary,
.btn-primary:hover {
  color: var(--text-on-action);
  background: var(--primary-red);
}
/* Compact actions require the normal-text contrast threshold. */
.btn-primary.lms-nav-button,
.lms-search button {
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  color: var(--text-on-compact-action);
  background: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-search input::placeholder,
.lms-notes textarea::placeholder,
.lms-profile-form input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Context is optional prose, not a repeating section badge. */
.lms-heading-context,
.lms-page-heading .lms-heading-context {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-label);
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}
.lms-landing-hero .hero-headline {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Explicit properties keep interaction transitions predictable and lightweight. */
.lms-marketing-links a,
.lms-text-link,
.lms-footer-links a,
.lms-breadcrumb a,
.lms-preview-lessons > a,
.lms-preview-link,
.lms-sidebar-help a {
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a,
.lms-sidebar nav a,
.lms-outline-module a,
.lms-resource-link,
.lms-search,
.lms-search button,
.lms-mobile-toggle,
.lms-profile-form input,
.lms-notes textarea {
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
.btn-primary,
.lms-secondary-button {
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
.btn-primary:active,
.lms-secondary-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
  transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-press);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .lms-player-button:hover .video-play-button {
    transform: scale(var(--motion-play-hover-scale));
  }
}
.lms-player-button:active .video-play-button {
  transform: scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn-primary:active,
  .lms-secondary-button:active,
  .lms-player-button:hover .video-play-button,
  .lms-player-button:active .video-play-button {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Entrance wrappers keep reveal transforms separate from card hover transforms. */
.lms-card-entrance {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
}
.lms-card-entrance > .lms-course-card {
  width: 100%;
}
.lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg,
.btn-primary > [data-icon="arrow"],
.lms-secondary-button > [data-icon="arrow"] {
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .lms-course-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-card-lift));
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-course-hover);
  }
  .lms-course-card:hover .lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg {
    transform: scale(var(--motion-cover-scale));
  }
  .btn-primary:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-button-lift));
  }
  .btn-primary:hover > [data-icon="arrow"],
  .lms-secondary-button:hover > [data-icon="arrow"] {
    transform: translateX(var(--motion-arrow-shift));
  }
  .btn-primary:active,
  .lms-secondary-button:active {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lms-course-card:hover,
  .btn-primary:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover,
  .lms-course-card:hover .lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg,
  .btn-primary:hover > [data-icon="arrow"],
  .lms-secondary-button:hover > [data-icon="arrow"] {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Match supporting motion to the longer shared surface timing. */
.stage-column,
.highlight-editors {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
.stage-num-badge,
.faq-chevron {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.video-play-button {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.lms-hero-video {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.lms-admin-checkbox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-control); }
.lms-admin-checkbox input { width: auto; accent-color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-admin-form .lms-form-field { margin: 0; }
```

```typescript
import type { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
export type SuspensionPeriod = typeof suspensionPeriods[number]["id"];
export type UserModeration = { action: "suspend"; period: SuspensionPeriod } | { action: "ban" | "restore" | "remove" | "promote" };
export interface AdminUser {
  id: string; name: string; username: string; email: string; avatarUrl: string | null;
  admin: boolean; confirmed: boolean; suspendedUntil: string | null; permanentlyBanned: boolean;
}
export interface AdminUserPage { users: AdminUser[]; page: number; hasNext: boolean; }
export interface UserSubscription { slug: string; title: string; enrolledAt: string; delivery: "recorded" | "live"; }

import type { adminUsersCopy } from "@platform/data/admin-users";
export type AdminUsersLabels = { [K in keyof typeof adminUsersCopy]: string };
```

```typescript
export type AuthMode = "login" | "signup";
export type AuthField = "name" | "email" | "password" | "confirmPassword";
export type AuthIssue = "nameRequired" | "nameLength" | "emailRequired" | "emailInvalid" | "passwordRequired" | "passwordLength" | "confirmationRequired" | "confirmationMismatch";
export type AuthErrors = Partial<Record<AuthField, AuthIssue>>;
export interface AuthValues { name: string; email: string; password: string; confirmPassword: string }
export type AuthValidation = { valid: true; values: AuthValues } | { valid: false; errors: AuthErrors };
export interface AuthFieldCopy { label: string; placeholder: string; hint?: string }
export interface AuthCopy {
  fields: Record<AuthField, AuthFieldCopy>;
  errors: Record<AuthIssue, string>;
  show: string; hide: string; requestError: string; invalidRequest: string;
}
export interface AuthPageModel {
```

```typescript
import { workshopCourseConfig } from "./config/workshop-course";
import type { NextConfig } from "next";
import { projectRoutes, legacyLearningNamespaces } from "./config/project-navigation";

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  poweredByHeader: false,
  output: "standalone",
  async redirects() {
    return [
      { source: `/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
      { source: `/courses/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
      ...legacyLearningNamespaces.flatMap((namespace) => [
        { source: `/${namespace}/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}/courses/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}`, destination: projectRoutes.learning, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}/:path+`, destination: "/:path+", permanent: true },
      ]),
      { source: "/portfolio", destination: projectRoutes.portfolio, permanent: false },
      { source: "/workshop", destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: false },
    ];
  },
};

export default nextConfig;
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/browser/animation-frame.ts`

SHA-256: `3844775a3ee4fa3060964ed9ae4480d543a995c86e885cb30ceacfca15c5ff2a`

```typescript
/** Coalesce events and release scheduled work when its owning effect ends. */
export function createFrameScheduler(update: () => void) {
  let frame = 0, disposed = false;
  const schedule = () => {
    if (!disposed && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      frame = 0;
      update();
    });
  };
  const dispose = () => {
    disposed = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  };
  return { schedule, dispose };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/bounded-number.ts`

SHA-256: `6c0b17f3a337888819f5e650c7f1159f471932d10dfcc0443704eb36a64ea376`

```typescript
/** Return a finite clamped value, or null when either boundary is invalid. */
export function boundedNumber(value: number, maximum: number): number | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isFinite(maximum) || maximum < 0) return null;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, value));
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/format-time.ts`

SHA-256: `4baa6943879b7f90a36aff557d4b51164a7a28013959371fcd5ab6469bd51561`

```typescript
export function formatPlayerTime(seconds: number) {
  const value = Number.isFinite(seconds) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds)) : 0;
  const hours = Math.floor(value / 3600),
    minutes = Math.floor((value % 3600) / 60),
    rest = String(value % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  return hours
    ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${rest}`
    : `${minutes}:${rest}`;
}
```

```typescript
/** Playback coordination can be limited to a panel, document or shadow root. */
export function pauseOtherVideos(video: HTMLVideoElement, scope: ParentNode = video.ownerDocument) {
  scope.querySelectorAll("video").forEach((other) => {
    if (other !== video) other.pause();
  });
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/play.ts`

SHA-256: `982e883d2a9257aed3f56daaf7d2e54e614a9aacfde2b0ff1adf5901a60820f5`

```typescript
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function playNativeVideo(getVideo: () => HTMLVideoElement | null, publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>) {
  const video = getVideo();
  if (!video) return;
  void video.play().catch((error) => {
    if (getVideo() !== video || !video.hasAttribute("src") || error.name === "AbortError") return;
    publish((previous) => ({ ...previous, status: error.name === "NotAllowedError" ? "paused" : "error" }));
  });
}
```

```typescript
export function readNativeSnapshot(video: HTMLVideoElement, previous: PlayerSnapshot): PlayerSnapshot {
  const status = video.error ? "error" : video.ended ? "ended" : video.paused ? "paused"
    : video.readyState < 3 ? "buffering" : "playing";
  return {
    status: video.readyState === 0 && !video.error ? previous.status : status,
    ready: video.readyState >= 1 && !video.error,
    time: Number.isFinite(video.currentTime) ? video.currentTime : 0,
    duration: Number.isFinite(video.duration) ? video.duration : 0,
    volume: Math.round(video.volume * 100), muted: video.muted,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { boundedNumber } from "../bounded-number";
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function seekNativeVideo(video: HTMLVideoElement | null, time: number, publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>) {
  if (!video) return;
  const value = boundedNumber(time, video.duration);
  if (value === null) return;
  video.currentTime = value;
  // Publish immediately so consecutive keyboard seeks use the requested position.
  publish((previous) => ({ ...previous, time: video.currentTime }));
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/subscribe.ts`

SHA-256: `3f38c57d3df33f2560bfd3208b4f334204a8c7fcdd14e04ab88aa14e42ab659d`

```typescript
import { pauseOtherVideos } from "./pause-other-videos";
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
import { readNativeSnapshot } from "./read-snapshot";
import { releaseVideoSource } from "./release-source";
export interface NativeSubscriptionOptions {
  video: HTMLVideoElement;
  sourceUrl: string;
  publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>;
  playbackScope?: ParentNode;
}
export function subscribeNativePlayer({ video, sourceUrl, publish, playbackScope }: NativeSubscriptionOptions) {
  // Restore the source after development-mode effect replay.
  if (video.getAttribute("src") !== sourceUrl) video.setAttribute("src", sourceUrl);
  const update = () => publish((previous) => readNativeSnapshot(video, previous));
  const playing = () => {
    pauseOtherVideos(video, playbackScope);
    update();
  };
  const waiting = () => publish((previous) => ({ ...previous, status: "buffering" }));
  const events = ["loadedmetadata", "durationchange", "timeupdate", "seeking", "seeked", "pause", "playing", "ended", "volumechange", "error", "canplay"];
  events.forEach((name) => video.addEventListener(name, update));
  video.addEventListener("play", playing);
  video.addEventListener("waiting", waiting);
  update();
  return () => {
    events.forEach((name) => video.removeEventListener(name, update));
    video.removeEventListener("play", playing);
    video.removeEventListener("waiting", waiting);
    releaseVideoSource(video);
  };
}
```

```typescript
) {

        : playing
```

SHA-256: `d1d29dbbb6a424660822d6c21ca428b979d410c40e34075414dc3f8d8f95611c`

```typescript
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import type { PlayerController } from "../../types/video-player";
import { playerPolicy } from "../../config/player";
export function handlePlayerKey(event: KeyboardEvent, controller: PlayerController, toggleFullscreen: () => Promise<void>) {
  if (event.target instanceof Element && event.target.closest("button,input,select,a")) return;
  if (event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || !controller.snapshot.ready) return;
  const actions: Record<string, () => void> = {
    " ": controller.toggle,
    k: controller.toggle,
    arrowleft: () => controller.seek(controller.snapshot.time - playerPolicy.seekStepSeconds),
    arrowright: () => controller.seek(controller.snapshot.time + playerPolicy.seekStepSeconds),
    m: controller.toggleMute,
    f: () => void toggleFullscreen(),
  };
  const action = actions[event.key.toLowerCase()];
  if (action) {
    event.preventDefault();
    action();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { getYouTubeEmbedUrl } from "../../../lib/video";
export function getControlledYouTubeUrl(
  url: string,
  origin: string,
): string | null {
  const base = getYouTubeEmbedUrl(url);
  if (!base) return null;
  const source = new URL(base);
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries({
    controls: "0",
    enablejsapi: "1",
    disablekb: "1",
    fs: "0",
    rel: "0",
    origin,
  }))
    source.searchParams.set(key, value);
  return source.href;
}
```

```typescript
import type { YouTubeAPI } from "../../../types/video-player";
import { requestYouTubeAPI } from "./request-api";
let pending: Promise<YouTubeAPI> | undefined;
/** One SDK request shared by players; a rejected request can be retried. */
export function loadYouTubeAPI(): Promise<YouTubeAPI> {
  const scope = window as Window & { YT?: YouTubeAPI };
  if (scope.YT?.Player) return Promise.resolve(scope.YT);
  if (!pending) pending = requestYouTubeAPI(scope).catch((error) => {
    pending = undefined;
    throw error;
  });
  return pending;
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/youtube/mount.ts`

SHA-256: `80678953a2246cffc660fd33ad665240c416f3b66f71883666e6ab5d19303976`

```typescript
import type { YouTubeSession } from "./session";
import { loadYouTubeAPI } from "./load-api";
import { youtubePlayerPolicy } from "../../../config/youtube-player";
import { createYouTubeIframe } from "./iframe";
import { youtubePlayerEvents } from "./events";
import { failYouTubeSession } from "./fail";
import { stopYouTubePolling } from "./polling";
/** SDK owns the iframe; the component owns the empty host and session. */
export interface YouTubeMountOptions {
  host: HTMLDivElement;
  url: string;
  title: string;
  session: YouTubeSession;
  loadAPI?: typeof loadYouTubeAPI;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}
export function mountYouTubePlayer({ host, url, title, session, loadAPI = loadYouTubeAPI, timeoutMs = youtubePlayerPolicy.timeoutMs }: YouTubeMountOptions) {
  session.timeout = window.setTimeout(() => failYouTubeSession(session), timeoutMs);
  const iframe = createYouTubeIframe(url, title);
  host.append(iframe);
  loadAPI().then((api) => {
    if (!session.disposed) session.player = new api.Player(iframe, { events: youtubePlayerEvents(session) });
  }).catch(() => failYouTubeSession(session));
  return () => {
    session.disposed = true;
    clearTimeout(session.timeout);
    stopYouTubePolling(session);
    session.playerRef.current = null;
    session.player?.destroy();
    host.replaceChildren();
  };
}
```

SHA-256: `ed7fcaeac59777b50b73491d4d54b11158d682ec4da2fffe4a3bffa720838210`

```typescript
import type { YouTubePlayerInstance } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function readPlayerTime(player: YouTubePlayerInstance) {
  const rawDuration = player.getDuration(),
    rawTime = player.getCurrentTime();
  const duration = Number.isFinite(rawDuration) ? Math.max(0, rawDuration) : 0;
  const time = Number.isFinite(rawTime)
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(duration, rawTime))
    : 0;
  return { duration, time };
}
```

```typescript
import { readPlayerTime } from "./read-time";
import { initialPlayerSnapshot } from "../initial-snapshot";
export function readyYouTubePlayer(session: YouTubeSession, target: YouTubePlayerInstance) {
  if (session.disposed) return;
  clearTimeout(session.timeout);
  session.playerRef.current = target;
  session.player = target;
  session.publish({ ...initialPlayerSnapshot(), ...readPlayerTime(target), ready: true,
    status: "paused", volume: target.getVolume(), muted: target.isMuted() });
  target.playVideo();
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/youtube/request-api.ts`

SHA-256: `48c001fa6d7ad09dff6150e9f1e50f8e3de2416a53e8cac15e42acb5d525a611`

```typescript
import type { YouTubeAPI } from "../../../types/video-player";
import { youtubePlayerPolicy } from "../../../config/youtube-player";
type APIWindow = Window & { YT?: YouTubeAPI; onYouTubeIframeAPIReady?: () => void };
export function requestYouTubeAPI(scope: APIWindow): Promise<YouTubeAPI> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const previous = scope.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady;
    const script = document.getElementById(youtubePlayerPolicy.scriptId) as HTMLScriptElement | null ?? document.createElement("script");
    const cleanup = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      script.removeEventListener("error", failed);
      if (scope.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady === ready) scope.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = previous;
    };
    const failed = () => {
      cleanup();
      script.remove();
      reject(new Error("YouTube API unavailable"));
    };
    const ready = () => {
      cleanup();
      if (scope.YT?.Player) resolve(scope.YT);
      else reject(new Error("YouTube API missing"));
      previous?.();
    };
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(failed, youtubePlayerPolicy.timeoutMs);
    scope.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = ready;
    script.addEventListener("error", failed, { once: true });
    if (!script.isConnected) {
      script.id = youtubePlayerPolicy.scriptId;
      script.src = youtubePlayerPolicy.apiUrl;
      script.async = true;
      document.head.append(script);
    }
  });
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/youtube/state-change.ts`

SHA-256: `cf0cc74aae61de240a11ac0a41d166d59689a958d87f1eae67edf0199fbeaba0`

```typescript
import type { YouTubeSession } from "./session";
import { youtubePlayerPolicy } from "../../../config/youtube-player";
import { sampleYouTubePlayer } from "./sample";
import { stopYouTubePolling } from "./polling";
export function changeYouTubeState(session: YouTubeSession, data: number | undefined) {
  if (session.disposed) return;
  const status = data === 1 ? "playing" : data === 3 ? "buffering" : data === 0 ? "ended" : "paused";
  session.publish((current) => ({ ...current, status }));
  stopYouTubePolling(session);
  sampleYouTubePlayer(session);
  if (status === "playing") {
    session.interval = window.setInterval(() => sampleYouTubePlayer(session), youtubePlayerPolicy.sampleMs);
    session.onPlay?.();
  }
  if (status === "ended") session.onEnded?.();
}
```

```typescript
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot, YouTubePlayerInstance } from "../../../types/video-player";
import { youtubePlayerPolicy } from "../../../config/youtube-player";
export function toggleYouTubeMute(player: YouTubePlayerInstance | null, publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>) {
  if (!player) return;
  if (player.isMuted()) {
    player.unMute();
    if (player.getVolume() === 0) player.setVolume(youtubePlayerPolicy.initialVolume);
  } else player.mute();
  publish((current) => ({ ...current, muted: player.isMuted(), volume: player.getVolume() }));
}
```

SHA-256: `e7297156f263a55efe3572132d4236bdb8ca62df300556f5e8ba8829eba5baef`

```typescript
import type { RevealGroup } from "../../types/interactions";
export function createEntrance(target: Element, group: RevealGroup, index: number, easing: string) {
  const animation = target.animate([
    { opacity: 0, transform: `translate3d(${group.x ?? 0}px,${group.y ?? 0}px,0) scale(${group.scale ?? 1})` },
    { opacity: 1, transform: "none" },
  ], { duration: group.duration, delay: (group.delay ?? 0) + index * (group.stagger ?? 0), easing, fill: "both" });
  animation.pause();
  return animation;
}
```

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { releaseReveal } from "./reveal-ownership";
export function disposeReveals(session: RevealSession) {
  session.disposed = true;
  session.observer?.disconnect();
  session.active.forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
  session.active.clear();
  session.pending.clear();
  for (const target of session.owned) releaseReveal(session, target);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/observe-reveals.ts`

SHA-256: `456320412fce72a737a280eeee2ce5721a05e79a7389b6502f8ef760e458aecb`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
function reveal(session: RevealSession, target: Element) {
  session.pending.get(target)?.forEach((animation) => animation.play());
  session.pending.delete(target);
  session.observer?.unobserve(target);
}
export function observeReveals(session: RevealSession) {
  session.observer?.disconnect();
  if (session.preference.matches || session.disposed) return;
  const threshold = window.innerHeight * session.options.viewportThreshold;
  session.observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => entries.forEach((entry) => { if (entry.isIntersecting) reveal(session, entry.target); }),
    { rootMargin: `0px 0px -${window.innerHeight - threshold}px 0px`, threshold: 0 },
  );
  session.pending.forEach((_, target) => {
    if (target.getBoundingClientRect().top <= threshold) reveal(session, target);
    else session.observer?.observe(target);
  });
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/register-reveal-target.ts`

SHA-256: `4fef0a4cbc4379bbfb957fb6e6f831465e39a6c2b768936e5364eaaa2b3c3f0f`

```typescript
import type { RevealGroup } from "../../types/interactions";
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { belongsToReveal, claimReveal } from "./reveal-ownership";
import { createEntrance } from "./create-entrance";
export function registerRevealTarget(session: RevealSession, target: Element, group: RevealGroup, index: number) {
  if (!belongsToReveal(session, target) || session.seen.has(target) || session.active.has(target)) return;
  claimReveal(session, target);
  if (session.preference.matches) {
    if (target.getBoundingClientRect().top <= window.innerHeight * session.options.viewportThreshold)
      session.seen.add(target);
    return;
  }
  const animation = createEntrance(target, group, index, session.options.easing);
  session.active.set(target, animation);
  animation.onfinish = () => {
    animation.cancel();
    session.active.delete(target);
    session.seen.add(target);
  };
  if (group.immediate) animation.play();
  else session.pending.set(target, [animation]);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/register-reveals.ts`

SHA-256: `15559f07bb903c26124d01663bb864b5fdb4ab571f6774cd1667631d04942b9a`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { releaseReveal } from "./reveal-ownership";
import { registerRevealTarget } from "./register-reveal-target";
import { observeReveals } from "./observe-reveals";
export function registerReveals(session: RevealSession) {
  if (session.disposed) return;
  for (const target of session.owned) if (!session.root.contains(target)) releaseReveal(session, target);
  for (const group of session.options.groups) {
    for (const trigger of session.root.querySelectorAll(group.trigger)) {
      const targets = group.children ? Array.from(trigger.children)
        : group.target ? Array.from(trigger.querySelectorAll(group.target)) : [trigger];
      targets.forEach((target, index) => registerRevealTarget(session, target, group, index));
    }
  }
  observeReveals(session);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/reveal-ownership.ts`

SHA-256: `0d6c246e9d487010a43b357000b96a0dfbcc633fff2dde347e4f5e2ae84b3efe`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
const owners = new WeakMap<Element, object>();
export function belongsToReveal(session: RevealSession, target: Element) {
  const scope = target.closest("[data-reveal-scope]");
  return (!scope || scope === session.root || !session.root.contains(scope)) &&
    (!owners.has(target) || owners.get(target) === session.owner);
}
export function claimReveal(session: RevealSession, target: Element) {
  owners.set(target, session.owner);
  session.owned.add(target);
}
export function releaseReveal(session: RevealSession, target: Element) {
  session.active.get(target)?.cancel();
  session.active.delete(target);
  session.pending.delete(target);
  session.seen.delete(target);
  session.observer?.unobserve(target);
  if (owners.get(target) === session.owner) owners.delete(target);
  session.owned.delete(target);
}
```

```typescript
import type { RevealOptions } from "../../types/interactions";
export interface RevealSession {
  root: HTMLElement;
  options: RevealOptions;
  preference: MediaQueryList;
  owner: object;
  seen: WeakSet<Element>;
  owned: Set<Element>;
  active: Map<Element, Animation>;
  pending: Map<Element, Animation[]>;
  observer?: IntersectionObserver;
  disposed: boolean;
}
export function createRevealSession(root: HTMLElement, options: RevealOptions, preference: MediaQueryList): RevealSession {
  return { root, options, preference, owner: {}, seen: new WeakSet(), owned: new Set(),
    active: new Map(), pending: new Map(), disposed: false };
}
```
