### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/update-reveal-children.ts`

SHA-256: `f2c7d22bf46f97c68ed7a0e8634d2ce68bd79e0984940b726c5b1bf5b6bd50fa`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { releaseReveal } from "./reveal-ownership";
import { registerReveals } from "./register-reveals";
export function updateRevealChildren(session: RevealSession, records: MutationRecord[]) {
  // Reinsertion in the same mutation batch still starts a new DOM occurrence.
  for (const record of records)
    for (const removed of record.removedNodes)
      for (const target of session.owned)
        if (removed === target || removed.contains(target)) releaseReveal(session, target);
  registerReveals(session);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/motion/update-reveal-preference.ts`

SHA-256: `48af511dbde652ddf4187dd2bcdc1ed9909e64866709db967fcd2b591e22c8b9`

```typescript
import type { RevealSession } from "./reveal-session";
import { registerReveals } from "./register-reveals";
export function updateRevealPreference(session: RevealSession) {
  if (session.preference.matches) {
    session.observer?.disconnect();
    session.active.forEach((animation, target) => {
      if (animation.playState === "running") session.seen.add(target);
      animation.cancel();
    });
    session.active.clear();
    session.pending.clear();
  }
  registerReveals(session);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/navigation/subscribe-dismissal.ts`

SHA-256: `3253eaf3460110a0e79d60a3c1878ff73b053f7251d0341857e4ea5dc73c4468`

```typescript
export interface DismissalOptions {
  root: HTMLElement;
  onClose: () => void;
  toggle?: HTMLElement | null;
  desktopQuery?: string;
  restoreFocus?: boolean;
}
/** Subscribe only while open; the owner controls state and supplies layout policy. */
export function subscribeDismissal({ root, toggle, onClose, desktopQuery, restoreFocus = true }: DismissalOptions) {
  const media = desktopQuery ? window.matchMedia(desktopQuery) : undefined;
  const key = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
    onClose();
    if (restoreFocus) toggle?.focus();
  };
  const outside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (event.target instanceof Node && !root.contains(event.target) && !toggle?.contains(event.target)) onClose();
  };
  const desktop = () => { if (media?.matches) onClose(); };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", key);
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
  media?.addEventListener("change", desktop);
  return () => {
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
    document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    media?.removeEventListener("change", desktop);
  };
}
```

```typescript
export function parseThemeTime(value: string, name: string) {
  // Optimized CSS may use .5s instead of 500ms.
  if (!/^(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?:ms|s)$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid motion time ${name}`);
  return parseFloat(value) * (value.endsWith("ms") ? 1 : 1000);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/theme/read-reveal-options.ts`

SHA-256: `6859484c28b716ee680d9f3564046ea63eee2698d89da8222ced0ed34236afe5`

```typescript
import { parseThemeTime } from "./parse-time";
import { parseThemeNumber } from "./parse-number";
import type { RevealOptions } from "../../types/interactions";

/** Resolve inherited theme tokens on the client; keep motion values in theme.css. */
export function readRevealOptions(root: HTMLElement): RevealOptions {
  const style = getComputedStyle(root);
  const token = (name: string) => style.getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  const number = (name: string) => parseThemeNumber(token(name), name);
  const milliseconds = (name: string) => parseThemeTime(token(name), name);
  const entrance = {
    y: number("--motion-reveal-distance"),
    duration: milliseconds("--motion-duration-reveal"),
  };
  return {
    viewportThreshold: number("--motion-reveal-viewport"),
    easing: token("--motion-easing"),
    groups: [
      {
        trigger: "[data-reveal-group=hero]",
        children: true,
        stagger: milliseconds("--motion-reveal-stagger"),
        ...entrance,
      },
      {
        trigger: "[data-reveal]:not([data-reveal-group=hero] > *)",
        ...entrance,
      },
    ],
  };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

/** Read a theme breakpoint without changing the server's initial markup. */
export function useBelowBreakpoint(token: string) {
  const query = useCallback(() => window.matchMedia(
    `(width <= ${getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(token).trim()})`,
  ), [token]);
  const subscribe = useCallback((notify: () => void) => {
    const media = query();
    media.addEventListener("change", notify);
    return () => media.removeEventListener("change", notify);
  }, [query]);
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => query().matches, () => false);
}
```

SHA-256: `ead7aac6ed4d3d49a480ccb0c1c161d799dcde8a457e555afbb3374ee9acebda`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const activationEvent = "khatab:player-activation";

/** Claim playback before retrieval starts, resetting other deferred instances. */
export function useExclusivePlayer(reset: () => void) {
  const identity = useRef(Symbol("player"));
  useEffect(() => {
    const onActivation = (event: Event) => {
      if ((event as CustomEvent<symbol>).detail !== identity.current) reset();
    };
    document.addEventListener(activationEvent, onActivation);
    return () => document.removeEventListener(activationEvent, onActivation);
  }, [reset]);
  return useCallback(() => {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(activationEvent, { detail: identity.current }));
  }, []);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { usePlayerFullscreen } from "./use-player-fullscreen";
import { usePlayerViewportReset } from "./use-player-viewport-reset";
export function useMediaPlayerSession(resetOnScrollOut: boolean) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fullscreen = usePlayerFullscreen(ref);
  const { exitFullscreen } = fullscreen;
  const [generation, setGeneration] = useState(0);
  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    void exitFullscreen();
    setGeneration((value) => value + 1);
  }, [exitFullscreen]);
  usePlayerViewportReset(ref, reset, resetOnScrollOut);
  return { ref, generation, ...fullscreen };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
import { subscribeDismissal } from "../helpers/navigation/subscribe-dismissal";
export interface MenuDismissalOptions {
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  toggleRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  focusSelector?: string;
  breakpointToken?: string;
  inclusiveBreakpoint?: boolean;
  restoreFocus?: boolean;
}
export function useMenuDismissal({ rootRef, toggleRef, open, onClose, focusSelector, breakpointToken, inclusiveBreakpoint = false, restoreFocus = true }: MenuDismissalOptions) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!open || !root) return;
    const breakpoint = breakpointToken && getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(breakpointToken).trim();
    return subscribeDismissal({
      root, onClose, restoreFocus,
      toggle: toggleRef?.current ?? (focusSelector ? root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(focusSelector) : undefined),
      desktopQuery: breakpoint ? `(width ${inclusiveBreakpoint ? ">=" : ">"} ${breakpoint})` : undefined,
    });
  }, [rootRef, toggleRef, open, onClose, focusSelector, breakpointToken, inclusiveBreakpoint, restoreFocus]);
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-player-fullscreen.ts`

SHA-256: `f700ea3c465416d10fd700d39b7ee845caec0e1e900f6a830823ae98a78bccaa`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
export function usePlayerFullscreen(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [supported, setSupported] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setFullscreen(document.fullscreenElement === ref.current);
      setSupported(
        Boolean(document.fullscreenEnabled && ref.current?.requestFullscreen),
      );
    };
    document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", update);
    update();
    return () => document.removeEventListener("fullscreenchange", update);
  }, [ref]);
  const enterFullscreen = useCallback(async () => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!element?.requestFullscreen || !document.fullscreenEnabled) return;
    try {
      if (document.fullscreenElement !== element)
        await element.requestFullscreen();
      element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } catch {
      /* Keep inline playback usable if browser policy rejects fullscreen. */
    }
  }, [ref]);
  const exitFullscreen = useCallback(async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement !== ref.current) return;
    try { await document.exitFullscreen(); } catch { /* Already exiting. */ }
  }, [ref]);
  const toggleFullscreen = async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement === ref.current) await exitFullscreen();
    else await enterFullscreen();
  };
  return { fullscreen, supported, toggleFullscreen, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/hooks/use-player-viewport-reset.ts`

SHA-256: `20725ab34fed1fb8c8e06727a70c62fa92e5deef5956f446dd70f9988b231442`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";

/** Release playback only after a visible player leaves the viewport. */
export function usePlayerViewportReset(
  ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  reset: () => void,
  enabled: boolean,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current;
    if (!enabled || !element) return;
    let wasVisible = false;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      const visible = entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0;
      if (wasVisible && !visible && !element.contains(document.fullscreenElement))
        reset();
      wasVisible = visible;
    });
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [ref, reset, enabled]);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
import type { RevealOptions } from "../types/interactions";
import { createScrollReveals } from "../lib/scroll-reveals";
import { readRevealOptions } from "../helpers/theme/read-reveal-options";
export interface ScrollRevealHookOptions {
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  options?: RevealOptions;
  enabled?: boolean;
}
/** Defaults read inherited theme tokens; an explicit options object replaces them. */
export function useScrollReveals({ rootRef, options, enabled = true }: ScrollRevealHookOptions) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!enabled || !root || !window.IntersectionObserver || !Element.prototype.animate) return;
    return createScrollReveals({ root, options: options ?? readRevealOptions(root),
      preference: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") });
  }, [rootRef, options, enabled]);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import type { YouTubePlayerInstance } from "../types/video-player";
import { initialPlayerSnapshot } from "../helpers/media/initial-snapshot";
import { mountYouTubePlayer } from "../helpers/media/youtube/mount";
import { toggleYouTubePlayer } from "../helpers/media/youtube/toggle";
import { seekYouTubePlayer } from "../helpers/media/youtube/seek";
import { toggleYouTubeMute } from "../helpers/media/youtube/toggle-mute";
import { setYouTubeVolume } from "../helpers/media/youtube/set-volume";
export function useYouTubePlayer(hostRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, url: string, title: string, callbacks: { onPlay?: () => void; onEnded?: () => void } = {}) {
  const { onPlay, onEnded } = callbacks;
  const playerRef = useRef<YouTubePlayerInstance | null>(null);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState(initialPlayerSnapshot);

    seek: (time: number) => seekYouTubePlayer(playerRef.current, snapshot.duration, time, setSnapshot),

    volume: (value: number) => setYouTubeVolume(playerRef.current, value, setSnapshot),
    retry: () => {
      setSnapshot(initialPlayerSnapshot());
      setAttempt((value) => value + 1);
    },
  };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals.ts`

SHA-256: `09393f442a137865ccd9400aea46401d929b5edb71e8493064c6633f43d6785f`

```typescript
import type { RevealOptions } from "../types/interactions";
import { createRevealSession } from "../helpers/motion/reveal-session";
import { registerReveals } from "../helpers/motion/register-reveals";
import { observeReveals } from "../helpers/motion/observe-reveals";
import { updateRevealChildren } from "../helpers/motion/update-reveal-children";
import { updateRevealPreference } from "../helpers/motion/update-reveal-preference";
import { disposeReveals } from "../helpers/motion/dispose-reveals";
/** One lifecycle coordinates focused reveal helpers without owning their details. */
export interface ScrollRevealLifecycle {
  root: HTMLElement;
  options: RevealOptions;
  preference: MediaQueryList;
}
export function createScrollReveals({ root, options, preference }: ScrollRevealLifecycle) {
  const session = createRevealSession(root, options, preference);
  const observe = () => observeReveals(session);
  const onPreferenceChange = () => updateRevealPreference(session);
  const mutations = new MutationObserver((records) => updateRevealChildren(session, records));
  mutations.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  preference.addEventListener("change", onPreferenceChange);
  window.addEventListener("resize", observe, { passive: true });
  registerReveals(session);
  return () => {
    disposeReveals(session);
    mutations.disconnect();
    preference.removeEventListener("change", onPreferenceChange);
    window.removeEventListener("resize", observe);
  };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/lib/theme.cjs`

SHA-256: `acac3700bee50f00f4748a48633f4cffb20b0b1e2544a08475c0f4b8c93f682b`

```typescript
/** Controlled token contract: root declarations, recursive var aliases, literal values. */
function parseTokens(sources) {
  const tokens = {};
  for (const source of sources) {
    const clean = source.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
    for (const block of clean.matchAll(/:root\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g))
      for (const entry of block[1].matchAll(/(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);/g))
        tokens[entry[1]] = entry[2].trim();
  }
  return tokens;
}
function resolveToken(tokens, name, trail = []) {
  if (trail.includes(name))
    throw new Error(`Cyclic token: ${[...trail, name].join(" -> ")}`);
  if (!Object.hasOwn(tokens, name))
    throw new Error(`Missing theme token ${name}`);
  const result = tokens[name].replace(/var\((--[\w-]+)\)/g, (_, alias) =>
    resolveToken(tokens, alias, [...trail, name]),
  );
  if (/var\(|(?:color-mix|calc)\(/.test(result))
    throw new Error(`Unsupported export expression: ${name}`);
  return result;
}
module.exports = { parseTokens, resolveToken };
```

```typescript
/** Validate a YouTube ID and normalize it to the privacy-enhanced iframe host. */
export function getYouTubeEmbedUrl(rawUrl: string): string | null {
  try {
    const url = new URL(rawUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    const hosts = [
      "youtube.com",
      "www.youtube.com",
      "youtube-nocookie.com",
      "www.youtube-nocookie.com",
    ];
    const id =
      url.hostname === "youtu.be"
        ? url.pathname.slice(1)
        : hosts.includes(url.hostname)
          ? url.pathname === "/watch"
            ? url.searchParams.get("v")
            : url.pathname.match(/^\/(?:embed|shorts)\/([\w-]{11})\/?$/)?.[1]
          : null;
    if (!id || !/^[\w-]{11}$/.test(id)) return null;
    return `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1&playsinline=1`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/styles/coming-soon.css`

SHA-256: `ddeea8f09f7ed5d8d4d7d2a466ea20ff51b4b61a1d48fe4397dc891fc9c483e1`

```css
.coming-soon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  container-type: inline-size;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: var(--font-arabic);
}
.coming-soon-art {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}
.coming-soon-ghost {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--coming-soon-ghost-top);
  inset-inline-start: var(--space-md);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: var(--coming-soon-ghost-size);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: var(--size-1px) var(--border-subtle);
  direction: ltr;
}
.coming-soon-ribbon {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--coming-soon-ribbon-bottom);
  left: -15%;
  width: 130%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  padding-block: var(--space-sm);
  background: var(--coming-soon-accent, var(--primary-red));
  color: var(--bg-main);
  transform: rotate(var(--coming-soon-ribbon-angle));
  font-size: var(--coming-soon-ribbon-size);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
  direction: ltr;
}
.coming-soon-ribbon > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.coming-soon-ribbon i {
  width: var(--space-xs);
  height: var(--space-xs);
  background: currentColor;
  transform: rotate(var(--coming-soon-mark-angle));
}
.coming-soon-copy {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  text-align: center;
  transform: translateY(var(--coming-soon-copy-offset));
}
.coming-soon-label {
  font-size: var(--coming-soon-title-size);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.coming-soon-detail {
  font-size: var(--coming-soon-detail-size);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
  letter-spacing: var(--coming-soon-detail-tracking);
}
```

```css
.project-navigation {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.project-navigation a {
  transition: color var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing);
}

.project-navigation a[aria-current="page"] {
  color: var(--text-accent-readable, var(--primary-red));
}
```

```css
/* Shared visual foundation of the two client-approved reference sites.
   CSS breakpoint conditions remain literals because native @media cannot resolve var().

:root {
  /* Reusable teaser-poster artwork; type scales with its container. */
  --coming-soon-title-size: clamp(2rem, 14cqi, 5.5rem);
  --coming-soon-ghost-size: clamp(3rem, 19cqi, 10rem);
  --coming-soon-detail-size: clamp(.65rem, 2.2cqi, .875rem);
  --coming-soon-detail-tracking: .18em;
  --coming-soon-ribbon-size: clamp(.75rem, 2.7cqi, 1.125rem);
  --coming-soon-ribbon-angle: -10deg;
  --coming-soon-mark-angle: 45deg;
  --coming-soon-ribbon-bottom: 14%;
  --coming-soon-ghost-top: -7%;
  --coming-soon-copy-offset: -18%;
  /* Shared interaction roles: quick feedback, slower surface settling. */
  --motion-easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --motion-duration-control: 300ms;
  --motion-duration-surface: 500ms;
  --motion-duration-press: 120ms;
  --motion-duration-reveal: 500ms;
  --motion-duration-instant: 0ms;
  --motion-reveal-distance: 32px;
  --motion-reveal-stagger: 80ms;

/* Semantic roles preserve approved values independently of radius and product content.
   Heavy/black weights intentionally retain the reference synthetic-weight treatment. */
:root {
  --dimension-12: 12px;
  --dimension-14: 14px;
  --dimension-18: 18px;
  --dimension-4: 4px;
  --dimension-8: 8px;
  --easing-reference: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --easing-responsive: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  --font-quotation: Georgia, serif;
  --layer-base: 0;
  --layer-content: 1;
  --layer-dashboard-header: 30;
  --layer-decoration: 2;
  --layer-navigation: 1000;
  --layer-navigation-menu: 1001;
  --layer-sidebar: 25;
  --layer-timeline: 10;
  --layer-timeline-badge: 12;
  --layer-timeline-label: 14;
  --layer-timeline-top: 15;
  --layer-toast: 999;
  --leading-1-52: 1.52;
  --leading-body: 1.7;
  --leading-compact: 1.2;
  --leading-control: 1.4;
  --leading-copy: 1.75;
  --leading-headline: 1.1;
  --leading-label: 1.35;
  --leading-longform: 1.85;
  --leading-normal: 1.5;
  --leading-relaxed: 1.6;
  --leading-solid: 1;
  --leading-spacious: 1.8;
  --leading-summary: 1.45;
  --leading-tight: 1.25;
  --leading-title: 1.3;
  --measure-footer-copy: 44ch;
  --scale-decoration-1-08: 1.08;
  --scale-decoration-1-15: 1.15;
  --scale-decoration-1-3: 1.3;
  --shadow-offset-12: 12px;
  --shadow-offset-14: 14px;
  --shadow-offset-18: 18px;
  --shadow-offset-4: 4px;
  --shadow-offset-8: 8px;
  --space-comfortable: 18px;
  --space-control: 12px;
  --space-detail: 14px;
  --weight-black: 900;
  --weight-bold: 700;
  --weight-heavy: 800;
  --weight-medium: 500;
  --weight-regular: 400;
  --weight-semibold: 600;
}

/* Original workshop entrance roles; exported at build time for its supplied motion contract. */
:root {
  --workshop-reveal-viewport: 0.75;
  --workshop-reveal-easing: var(--motion-easing);
  --workshop-reveal-distance-card: 24px;
  --workshop-reveal-distance-text: 20px;

  --workshop-reveal-duration-card: var(--motion-duration-reveal);

}

/* Personal portfolio interaction geometry. */
:root {

}
```

```css
.hero-video-shell:has(.custom-video-player:not(.custom-video-player--overlay)) {
  min-height: calc(
    var(--player-min-video-height) + var(--player-controls-height) + 2 *
      var(--size-1px)
  );
}
.custom-video-player {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  position: relative;
}
.custom-video-stage {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: var(--player-min-video-height);
}
.custom-video-iframe-host {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}
.custom-video-iframe-host iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  display: block;
}
.custom-video-controls {
  flex: none;
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control);
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.custom-video-control-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
}
.custom-video-control {
  width: var(--player-control-size);
  height: var(--player-control-size);
  flex: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.custom-video-control svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
}
.custom-video-control:disabled {
  opacity: var(--player-disabled-opacity);
  cursor: default;
}
.custom-video-control:not(:disabled):hover,
.custom-video-control:focus-visible {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.custom-video-time {
  font-size: var(--player-time-size);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  direction: ltr;
}
.custom-video-volume-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  margin-left: auto;
}
.custom-video-seek,
.custom-video-volume {
  accent-color: var(--primary-red);
  cursor: pointer;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--player-range-height);
}
.custom-video-seek {
  width: 100%;
}
.custom-video-volume {
  width: var(--player-volume-width);
}
.custom-video-status {
  position: static;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-unit);
  background: var(--bg-main);
  font-size: var(--player-time-size);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.custom-video-error {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.custom-video-error p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.custom-video-retry {
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
}
.custom-video-player:fullscreen {
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
}
.custom-video-player:fullscreen .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .custom-video-controls {
    padding-inline: var(--space-unit);
    gap: var(--space-xs);
  }
  .custom-video-control-row {
    gap: var(--space-xs);
  }
  .custom-video-volume {
    width: var(--player-volume-compact-width);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .custom-video-control {
    transition: none;
  }
}

.custom-video-element {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.reel-video-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.reel-video-placeholder img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.reel-video-placeholder .reel-play-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.reel-video-placeholder:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red);
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--space-xs));
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-volume {
  display: none;
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-control-row {
  gap: var(--space-xs);
}
.reel-preview .custom-video-controls {
  padding-inline: var(--space-unit);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .reel-video-placeholder .reel-play-btn {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}

.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 0;
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
  margin: 0;
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--text-primary);
  outline-offset: var(--space-xs);
}
.custom-video-overlay-toggle:disabled {
  opacity: var(--player-disabled-opacity);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}
.custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-status {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--space-control);
  left: var(--space-control);
}

.hero-video-placeholder img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.hero-video-placeholder .video-play-button {
  position: relative;
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.hero-video-shell .custom-video-overlay-toggle svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
}

/* Public player wrapper owns sizing and accent overrides for each instance. */
.media-player {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.media-player-poster {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.media-player-poster img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.media-player-toggle,
.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
  width: var(--player-overlay-size);
  height: var(--player-overlay-size);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
}

/* New views fade in without retaining the old video's stream for an exit effect. */
.media-player-poster,
.media-player .custom-video-player,
.custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  animation: playerFadeIn var(--motion-duration-surface) var(--motion-easing);
}
@keyframes playerFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .media-player-poster,
  .media-player .custom-video-player,
  .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    animation: none;
  }
  .media-player-toggle,
  .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
    transition: none;
  }
}
.media-player-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.media-player-toggle svg {
  width: var(--player-icon-size);
  height: var(--player-icon-size);
  fill: currentColor;
}
.media-player .custom-video-player--overlay .custom-video-stage {
  min-height: 0;
}
.media-player-poster:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--space-xs));
}
.media-player .custom-video-seek,
.media-player .custom-video-volume {
  accent-color: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
.media-player .custom-video-retry {
  border-color: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
/* Reference hover styling must preserve the configured accent and centered icon. */
.media-player .media-player-toggle {
  background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle {
  position: absolute;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .media-player-poster:hover .media-player-toggle {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-08));
  }
  .client-work-card:hover .media-player-toggle.reel-play-btn {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
  }
}

.media-player .media-player-toggle,
.media-player .custom-video-overlay-toggle {
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px)
    color-mix(
      in srgb,
      var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red)) var(--player-glow-strength),
      transparent
    );
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.hero-video-placeholder .media-player-toggle svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .media-player-poster:hover .media-player-toggle {
    background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red-hover));
  }
  .client-work-card:hover .media-player-poster .media-player-toggle {
    background: var(--media-player-accent, var(--primary-red));
  }
}

/* Fullscreen keeps the intrinsic portrait/landscape frame, never crops footage. */
.media-player:fullscreen {
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  max-width: none;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  animation: none;
}
.media-player:fullscreen .custom-video-stage { min-height: 0; }
.media-player-fullscreen {
  cursor: pointer;
  position: absolute;
  top: max(var(--space-md), env(safe-area-inset-top));
  right: max(var(--space-md), env(safe-area-inset-right));
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}
.media-player-fullscreen:not(:disabled):hover,
.media-player-fullscreen:focus-visible {
  background: transparent;
}
.media-player-fullscreen svg {
  stroke: none;
  filter:
    drop-shadow(0 var(--size-1px) var(--size-1px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-8))
    drop-shadow(0 0 var(--size-3px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-8));
}

.media-player-fullscreen {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-smooth), background-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
}
.media-player:hover .media-player-fullscreen,
.media-player-fullscreen:focus-visible,
.media-player-fullscreen.is-fullscreen {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
@media (hover: none) {
  .media-player-fullscreen { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .media-player-fullscreen { transition: none; }
}
/* Keep the thumbnail caption clear of the top-right fullscreen action. */
.reel-video-placeholder .reel-tag {
  right: auto;
  left: var(--size-10px);
}
```

```css
  pointer-events: none;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .highlight-editors:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-1px));
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-85);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-42),
      inset 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
  }
}

.highlight-editors:hover::before {
  left: 160%;
}

.highlight-editors .badge-sparkle-icon {
  color: var(--color-ffa59c);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 var(--size-6px) var(--primary-red));
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .highlight-editors:hover .badge-sparkle-icon {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15)) rotate(var(--size-15deg));
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
}

@keyframes softTextGlow {
  0%,
  100% {
    text-shadow: 0 0 var(--dimension-8) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
  }
  50% {
    text-shadow: 0 0 var(--dimension-18) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  }
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  display: inline-block;
  animation: softTextGlow var(--size-4s) ease-in-out infinite;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    text-shadow var(--transition-smooth),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--size-0px);
  right: 0;
  width: 0%;
  height: var(--size-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-90deg),
    var(--primary-red),
    var(--color-ffa59c)
  );
  border-radius: var(--size-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-8) var(--primary-red);
  transition: width var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-headline .highlight-red:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-1px));
    text-shadow:
      0 0 var(--size-22px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-7),
      0 0 var(--size-35px) var(--primary-red-border);
  }
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red:hover::after {
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-support-text {
  font-size: var(--size-1_12rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-longform);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-34px);
  max-width: var(--size-840px);
  width: 100%;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-video-centered {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
  align-self: center;
}

@keyframes videoShellCalmGlow {
  0%,
  100% {
    border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12),
      0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  }
  50% {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--size-38px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-24),
      0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  }
}

.hero-video-shell {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12),
    0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  animation: videoShellCalmGlow var(--size-4_5s) ease-in-out infinite;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-video-shell iframe,
.hero-video-shell video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
  display: block;
}

.hero-video-placeholder {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-1c232c) 0%,
    var(--color-12161d) 100%
  );
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.hero-video-placeholder:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-222b36) 0%,
    var(--color-151a22) 100%
  );
}

.video-play-button {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-30px) var(--primary-red-glow);
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.video-play-button svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
  margin-right: var(--size-negative-3px);
  fill: currentColor;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-video-placeholder:hover .video-play-button {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-08));
    background-color: var(--primary-red-hover);
  }
}

.video-meta-label {
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.video-meta-time {
  font-size: var(--size-0_82rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.hero-bottom-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.clients-section {
  text-align: center;
}

.clients-header {
  max-width: var(--size-1050px);
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-2xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.clients-header p.body-large {
  max-width: var(--size-980px);
  text-wrap: balance;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.clients-single-line {
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}

.creators-marquee {
  direction: ltr;
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-detail) 0;
  background: var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-25);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.creators-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: center;
  width: max-content;
  animation: marqueeScroll var(--size-38s) linear infinite;
}

@keyframes marqueeScroll {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(calc(-50% - var(--space-md) / 2), 0, 0);
  }
}
.creators-marquee .creator-chip {
  direction: rtl;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .creators-marquee:hover .creators-track {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
}

.creator-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-20-26-0-7);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .creator-chip:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
  }
}

.creator-avatar {
  width: var(--space-xl);
  height: var(--space-xl);
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-strong);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.creator-avatar-photo,
.creator-avatar img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: block;
}

.creator-name {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}

.creator-platform {
  font-size: var(--size-0_75rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-right: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-15);
  padding-right: var(--space-sm);
}

.clients-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.client-work-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  transform: none;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-5px));
    box-shadow:
      0 var(--space-md) var(--size-36px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-55),
      0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12);
  }
}

.client-work-preview {
  aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
  background-color: var(--color-0c0e11);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.client-work-tag {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--size-10px);
  right: var(--size-10px);
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background-color: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--dimension-8));

  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--size-0_72rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}


.reel-placeholder-box {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md);
  text-align: center;
}

.reel-play-btn {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-92);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}

.reel-play-btn svg {
  width: var(--dimension-18);
  height: var(--dimension-18);
  margin-right: var(--size-negative-2px);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .reel-play-btn {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
    background-color: var(--primary-red);
    box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-28px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-75);
  }
}

.proof-placeholder-text {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.client-work-info {
  padding: var(--space-detail) var(--space-control);
}

.client-work-title {
  font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
  line-height: var(--leading-label);
}

.client-work-sub {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-summary);
}

.transformation-section {
  text-align: center;
}

.transform-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.transformation-frame-card {
  background: var(--color-rgba-22-27-34-0-75);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--size-36px);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-36px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-4);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.transformation-frame-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 15%;
  left: 15%;
  height: var(--size-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-90deg),
    transparent,
    var(--primary-red),
    transparent
  );
}

.transform-headline {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1_35rem), var(--size-2_6vw), var(--size-2_05rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.trans-from {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
}

.trans-arrow {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-weight: var(--weight-black);
  font-size: var(--size-1_25em);
}

.trans-to {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.transform-lead-text {
  max-width: var(--size-820px);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.transform-stages-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  position: relative;
  text-align: right;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.stage-column {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-lg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  transform: none;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .stage-column:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-5px));
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
    box-shadow:
      0 var(--space-md) var(--size-36px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5),
      0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--primary-red-subtle);
  }
}

.stage-num-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--size-1_2rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .stage-column:hover .stage-num-badge {
    border-color: var(--primary-red);
    color: var(--primary-red);
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-08));
  }
}

.stage-title {
  font-size: var(--size-1_45rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.stage-desc {
  font-size: var(--size-1_02rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-copy);
  flex-grow: 1;
  margin: 0;
}

.roadmap-section {
  text-align: center;
}

.roadmap-header {
  max-width: var(--size-840px);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.roadmap-highlight-box {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--color-rgba-22-27-34-0-7);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-comfortable) var(--space-xl);
  margin: var(--size-28px) auto;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 var(--size-10px) var(--size-30px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-35);
  position: relative;
}

.roadmap-highlight-title {
  font-size: var(--size-0_92rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--color-ffa59c);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-0_03em);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.roadmap-highlight-pills {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.formula-line-inputs,
.formula-line-result {
  display: contents;
}

.pill-item {
  background: var(--color-rgba-22-27-34-0-85);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-12);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pill-item:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-3);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
  }
}

.pill-item-accent {
  background: var(--primary-red) !important;
  color: var(--text-primary) !important;
  border-color: var(--primary-red) !important;
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--space-md) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .pill-item-accent:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-65);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
  }
}

.pill-sep {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
}

.roadmap-timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  position: relative;
  max-width: var(--size-920px);
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: right;
}

.timeline-track {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--size-41px);
  width: var(--size-2px);
  background: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-1);
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.timeline-progress {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--size-41px);
  width: var(--size-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--primary-red) 0%,
    var(--color-ff6854) 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-10px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-75);
  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
  pointer-events: none;
  transform-origin: top center;
  transform: scaleY(0);
  will-change: transform;
}

.day-item {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-timeline);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--size-84px) 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  align-items: start;
}

.timeline-marker.day-number-col,
.day-number-col {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  background-color: transparent;
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-timeline);
  width: var(--size-84px);
}

.day-badge-num {
  width: var(--size-78px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--bg-main) !important;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--size-3px);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-xs);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-timeline-badge);
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}

.day-badge-digit {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  line-height: var(--leading-solid);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-0_02em);
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-timeline-label);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}

.day-badge-text {
  font-size: var(--size-0_72rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-negative-0_01em);
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-timeline-label);
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}

.day-item.is-passed .day-badge-num {
  border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-6) !important;
  background-color: var(--color-181213) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--space-md) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
}

.day-item.is-active .day-badge-num,
.day-item:hover .day-badge-num {
  border-color: var(--primary-red) !important;
  background-color: var(--color-221211) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
}

.day-item.is-passed .day-badge-digit,
.day-item.is-active .day-badge-digit,
.day-item:hover .day-badge-digit {
  color: var(--primary-red) !important;
}

.day-item.is-passed .day-badge-text,
.day-item.is-active .day-badge-text,
.day-item:hover .day-badge-text {
  color: var(--text-primary) !important;
}

.day-badge-sub {
  display: none !important;
}

.day-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .day-item:hover .day-card,
  .day-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55) !important;
    transform: translateX(var(--size-negative-4px));
    box-shadow:
      0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--space-xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5),
      0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-15);
  }
}

.day-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.day-card-title {
  font-size: var(--size-1_35rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.day-card-type-tag {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--size-10px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.day-lessons-list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
}

.day-lessons-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: var(--size-20px);
  font-size: var(--size-0_98rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}

.day-lessons-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: var(--size-10px);
  width: var(--size-6px);
  height: var(--size-6px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.day-item-pause .day-card {
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-135deg),
    var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-03) 0%,
    var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-01) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) dashed var(--border-strong);
}

.day-item-pause .day-badge-num {
  border-style: dashed;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.day-pause-banner {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
}

.day-pause-banner h4 {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
}

.day-pause-banner p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--size-0_98rem);
}

.day-item-practical .day-card {
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-05) 0%,
    var(--bg-surface) 100%
  );
}

.day-item-practical .day-card-type-tag {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  color: var(--color-ffa59c);
}

.day-item-career .day-card {
  border-color: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-22);
}

.day-item-career .day-card-type-tag {
  background: var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.roadmap-bottom-cta {
  margin-top: var(--space-4xl);
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.testimonials-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
}

.featured-review-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: var(--space-3xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  position: relative;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}

.featured-review-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-14) var(--size-34px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-45);
}

.featured-quote-mark {
  font-size: var(--size-4rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-solid);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  opacity: 0.35;
  font-family: var(--font-quotation);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-negative-16px);
  transition:
    opacity var(--transition-smooth),
    text-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
  transform: none !important;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.featured-review-card:hover .featured-quote-mark {
  color: var(--primary-red) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  text-shadow: 0 0 var(--dimension-18) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
}

.featured-review-text {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1_2rem), var(--size-2vw), var(--size-1_6rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.featured-author-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
}

.author-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-detail);
}

.author-avatar-flag {
  width: var(--size-46px);
  height: var(--size-46px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--size-2px) solid var(--border-strong);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-4) var(--shadow-offset-12)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-4);
}

.author-avatar-flag img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.author-name {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.author-country {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.testimonials-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  align-items: stretch;
}

.review-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transform: none;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .review-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-4);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-5px));
    box-shadow:
      0 var(--space-md) var(--size-36px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5),
      0 0 var(--shadow-offset-18) var(--primary-red-subtle);
  }
}

.review-card-text {
  font-size: var(--size-0_98rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-copy);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.review-card-author {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

.review-author-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.review-avatar-flag {
  width: var(--size-38px);
  height: var(--size-38px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--size-1_5px) solid var(--border-strong);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-4) var(--size-10px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-35);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.review-avatar-flag img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.review-author-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-2px);
  text-align: right;
}

.review-card-name {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_98rem);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--leading-tight);
}

.review-card-country {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-compact);
}

.author-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-3px);
  text-align: right;
}

.instructor-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr;
  gap: var(--space-4xl);
  align-items: center;
}

.instructor-photo-column {
  position: relative;
}

.instructor-photo-frame {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 30%,
    var(--primary-red) 0%,
    var(--color-d42010) 45%,
    var(--color-8a1208) 85%,
    var(--bg-section-alt) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  box-shadow:
    0 var(--space-lg) var(--size-60px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-55),
    0 0 var(--size-50px) var(--primary-red-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--size-36px) var(--size-20px) 0 var(--size-20px);
}

.instructor-photo-frame img,
.instructor-photo-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: drop-shadow(
    0 var(--shadow-offset-14) var(--size-28px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-65)
  );
  display: block;
}

.instructor-photo-placeholder {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-1c2229) 0%,
    var(--bg-main) 100%
  );
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  text-align: center;
}

.instructor-avatar-icon {
  width: var(--space-3xl);
  height: var(--space-3xl);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.instructor-badges-float {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--space-md);
  right: var(--space-md);
  left: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--size-10px) var(--space-detail);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--size-10px));
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.instructor-badge-label {
  font-size: var(--size-0_8rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.instructor-exp-stat {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.instructor-name {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-3_5vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.instructor-tagline {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.instructor-manifesto {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  max-width: var(--size-54ch);
}

.instructor-manifesto b {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.instructor-actions {
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.instructor-stats-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.inst-stat-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.inst-stat-num {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
}

.inst-stat-lbl {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.guarantee-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-right: var(--dimension-4) solid var(--primary-red);
  padding: var(--space-3xl);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--size-80px) 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  align-items: center;
}

.guarantee-icon-box {
  width: var(--size-72px);
  height: var(--size-72px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.guarantee-icon-box svg {
  width: var(--size-36px);
  height: var(--size-36px);
  fill: currentColor;
}

.guarantee-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.guarantee-headline {
  font-size: var(--size-1_65rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.guarantee-text {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
}

.faq-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
}

.faq-accordion {
  max-width: var(--container-narrow);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.faq-item {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.faq-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
}

.faq-item.is-active {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.faq-question-btn {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--size-1_125rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: right;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.faq-chevron {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.faq-item.is-active .faq-chevron {
  transform: rotate(var(--size-negative-180deg));
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.faq-answer-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    grid-template-rows var(--transition-smooth),
    opacity var(--transition-smooth);
}
.faq-answer-inner {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.faq-answer-content {
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg) var(--size-22px) var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
}

.final-cta-section {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
}

.final-cta-box {
  max-width: var(--container-narrow);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--space-4xl) var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--bg-surface) 0%,
    var(--color-12161c) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--space-xl) var(--size-80px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5);
}

.final-cta-headline {
  max-width: var(--size-20ch);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.final-cta-sub {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: var(--size-52ch);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
}

.final-btn-wrapper {
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.final-btn-wrapper .btn-primary {
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-28px);
  font-size: var(--size-1_12rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-30px) var(--primary-red-glow);
}

.final-btn-wrapper .cta-microcopy {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.site-footer {
  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background-color: var(--color-0b0e11);
}

.footer-layout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}

.footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
}

.footer-brand-title {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
  cursor: pointer !important;
  width: fit-content;
}

.footer-brand-title:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red) !important;
}

.footer-copy-text {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.footer-social-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.footer-designer-credit {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--weight-regular);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}

.footer-social-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  list-style: none;
}

.social-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--size-44px);
  height: var(--size-44px);

.reel-play-btn {

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  .nav-cta-btn:active,

}

  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);

}

.testimonials-more-button:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red);
  outline-offset: var(--space-xs);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);

.review-revealed { animation: playerFadeIn var(--motion-duration-surface) var(--motion-easing); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .review-revealed { animation: none; } }
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/action.tsx`

SHA-256: `c28b82f07e28289692b4d61887908beb85cf8c861dc080af12c16b576bb0a608`

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import type { ComponentPropsWithoutRef, ReactNode } from "react";
type Common = { children: ReactNode; className?: string };
export type ActionProps = Common &
  (
    | ({ kind: "button" } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"button">,
        "children"
      >)
    | ({ kind: "link"; href: string } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Link>,
        "children"
      >)
    | ({ kind: "anchor"; href: string } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"a">,
        "children"
      >)
  );
export default function Action(props: ActionProps) {
  if (props.kind === "button") {
    const { kind, ...rest } = props;
    void kind;
    return <button type="button" {...rest} />;
  }
  if (props.kind === "link") {
    const { kind, ...rest } = props;
    void kind;
    return <Link {...rest} />;
  }
  const { kind, ...rest } = props;
  void kind;
  return <a {...rest} />;
}
```

```tsx
const variants = {
  featured: {
    root: "author-info",
    image: "author-avatar-flag",
    meta: "author-meta",
    name: "author-name",
    country: "author-country",
    tag: "div",

    root: "review-author-info",
    image: "review-avatar-flag",

  },

  author,

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

export interface ComingSoonProps {
  label: string;
  detail?: string;
  className?: string;
  width?: CSSProperties["width"];
  height?: CSSProperties["height"];
  aspectRatio?: CSSProperties["aspectRatio"];
  color?: string;
}

/** Theme-aware artwork for any upcoming course, feature or release. */
export default function ComingSoon({
  label,
  detail,
  className = "",
  width = "100%",
  height,
  aspectRatio = "16 / 9",
  color,
}: ComingSoonProps) {
  const style: CSSProperties & { "--coming-soon-accent"?: string } = {
    width,
    height,
    aspectRatio: height === undefined ? aspectRatio : undefined,
    "--coming-soon-accent": color,
  };
  return (
    <div className={`coming-soon ${className}`.trim()} style={style}>
      <div className="coming-soon-art" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="coming-soon-ghost">{detail ?? label}</span>
        <div className="coming-soon-ribbon">
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (
            <span key={index}>{detail ?? label}<i /></span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="coming-soon-copy">
        <span className="coming-soon-label">{label}</span>
        {detail && <span className="coming-soon-detail">{detail}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/deferred-video-player.tsx`

SHA-256: `eb564db7d2ce6770ad80e81a87dd9572cd934aa8032bc8fa57d8a592b664289b`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useCallback, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useExclusivePlayer } from "../hooks/use-exclusive-player";
import { getControlledYouTubeUrl } from "../helpers/media/youtube/controlled-url";
import NativeVideoPlayer from "./native-video-player";
import type {
  VideoSourceProps,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
import YouTubePlayer from "./youtube-player";
export default function DeferredVideoPlayer({
  url,
  source,
  controlsVariant,
  returnToPosterOnEnd = false,
  onActivate,
  onDeactivate,
  title,
  labels,
  playLabel,
  placeholderClassName,
  children,
}: {
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
  returnToPosterOnEnd?: boolean;
  onActivate?: () => void;
  onDeactivate?: () => void;
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  playLabel: string;
  placeholderClassName: string;
  children: ReactNode;
} & VideoSourceProps) {
  const [activation, setActivation] = useState<{
    url: string;
    embed: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setActivation(null);
    onDeactivate?.();
  }, [onDeactivate]);
  const claimPlayback = useExclusivePlayer(reset);
  const resolvedUrl = source?.url ?? url ?? "";
  if (activation?.url === resolvedUrl && source)
    return (
      <NativeVideoPlayer
        key={resolvedUrl}
        source={source}
        onEnded={returnToPosterOnEnd ? reset : undefined}
        onPlay={claimPlayback}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        title={title}
        labels={labels}
      />
    );
  if (activation?.url === resolvedUrl)
    return (
      <YouTubePlayer
        key={activation.embed}
        url={activation.embed}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        onEnded={returnToPosterOnEnd ? reset : undefined}
        onPlay={claimPlayback}
        title={title}
        labels={labels}
      />
    );
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={placeholderClassName}
      onClick={() => {
        const embed = source
          ? resolvedUrl
          : getControlledYouTubeUrl(resolvedUrl, window.location.origin);
        if (embed) {
          onActivate?.();
          claimPlayback();
          setActivation({ url: resolvedUrl, embed });
        }
      }}
      aria-label={playLabel}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  buttonId,
  panelId,

}: {
  item: FaqItemData;
  open: boolean;
  buttonId: string;
  panelId: string;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {

      <button
        className="faq-question-btn"
        type="button"
        id={buttonId}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={panelId}
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        <span>{item.question}</span>
        <Icon name="chevron" className="faq-chevron" />
      </button>
      <div
        className="faq-answer-panel"
        id={panelId}
        role="region"
        aria-labelledby={buttonId}
        aria-hidden={!open}
        inert={!open}
      >
        <div className="faq-answer-inner">
          <div className="faq-answer-content">{item.answer}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

```tsx
import { preload } from "react-dom";

/** Register resource hints during server rendering, including streamed layouts. */
export default function FontPreloads({
  assets,
}: {
  assets: readonly string[];
}) {
  for (const href of assets) {
    preload(href, { as: "font", type: "font/ttf", crossOrigin: "anonymous" });
  }
  return null;
}
```
