### File: `packages/design-system/ui/media-player.tsx`

SHA-256: `dfcedc30a83667fcca76ecd52d2edaedfacfffb8f136f5a15e108ae97f3d72ce`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useMediaPlayerSession } from "../hooks/use-media-player-session";
import { mediaPlayerStyle } from "../helpers/media/appearance";
import type { MediaPlayerProps } from "../types/media-player";
import { arabicPlayerLabels } from "../lib/player-labels";
import DeferredVideoPlayer from "./deferred-video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";

/** Portable native-file player: configuration changes appearance, not playback logic. */
export default function MediaPlayer({
  videoUrl,
  thumbnailUrl,
  title,
  width,
  height,
  aspectRatio = "16 / 9",
  color,
  controlsVariant = "overlay",
  returnToPosterOnEnd = true,
  fullscreenOnPlay = false,
  resetOnScrollOut = true,
  labels = arabicPlayerLabels,
  playLabel,
  className = "",
  placeholderClassName = "",
  playButtonClassName = "",
  thumbnailLoading = "lazy",
  children,
}: MediaPlayerProps) {
  const { ref, generation, fullscreen, supported, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen } = useMediaPlayerSession(resetOnScrollOut);
  const style = mediaPlayerStyle({ width, height, aspectRatio, color });
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`media-player ${className}`.trim()} style={style}
      tabIndex={-1}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && fullscreen) {
          event.preventDefault();
          void exitFullscreen();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DeferredVideoPlayer
        key={`${videoUrl}:${generation}`}
        source={{ kind: "file", url: videoUrl, poster: thumbnailUrl }}
        title={title ?? labels.controls}
        labels={labels}
        playLabel={playLabel ?? labels.play}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        returnToPosterOnEnd={returnToPosterOnEnd}
        onActivate={fullscreenOnPlay ? () => void enterFullscreen() : undefined}
        onDeactivate={exitFullscreen}
        placeholderClassName={`media-player-poster ${placeholderClassName}`.trim()}
      >
        {/* Arbitrary thumbnail URLs stay portable and bypass Next image-host configuration. */}
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={thumbnailUrl}
          alt=""
          loading={thumbnailLoading}
          decoding="async"
          fetchPriority={thumbnailLoading === "eager" ? "high" : undefined}
        />
        <span
          className={`media-player-toggle ${playButtonClassName}`.trim()}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <PlayerIcon name="play" />
        </span>
        {children}
      </DeferredVideoPlayer>
      {supported ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`media-player-fullscreen custom-video-control${fullscreen ? " is-fullscreen" : ""}`}
          aria-label={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          title={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          onClick={() => void (fullscreen ? exitFullscreen() : enterFullscreen())}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={fullscreen ? "exit-fullscreen" : "fullscreen"} />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { useNativeVideoPlayer } from "../hooks/use-native-video-player";
import type {
  FileVideoSource,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerShell from "./player-shell";
export default function NativeVideoPlayer({
  source,
  title,
  labels,
  controlsVariant,
  onEnded,
  onPlay,
}: {
  source: FileVideoSource;
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
  onEnded?: () => void;
  onPlay?: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const controller = useNativeVideoPlayer(ref, source.url);
  return (
    <PlayerShell
      title={title}
      labels={labels}
      controller={controller}
      controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
    >
      <video
        ref={ref}
        className="custom-video-element"
        src={source.url}
        poster={source.poster}
        aria-label={title}
        autoPlay
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        controls={false}
        onEnded={onEnded}
        onPlay={onPlay}
        controlsList="nodownload"
        disablePictureInPicture
      />
    </PlayerShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export type PlayerIconName =
  | "play"
  | "pause"
  | "replay"
  | "volume"
  | "muted"
  | "fullscreen"
  | "exit-fullscreen";
const paths: Record<PlayerIconName, string> = {
  play: "M8 5v14l11-7z",
  pause: "M6 5h4v14H6zM14 5h4v14h-4z",
  replay: "M12 5a7 7 0 1 1-6.7 9H3.2A9 9 0 1 0 12 3V0L7 4l5 4V5z",
  volume:
    "M3 9v6h4l5 4V5L7 9H3zm12-1a6 6 0 0 1 0 8v-3a3 3 0 0 0 0-2V8zm3-3a10 10 0 0 1 0 14v-3a7 7 0 0 0 0-8V5z",
  muted:
    "M3 9v6h4l5 4V5L7 9H3zm12-1 3 3 3-3 1 1-3 3 3 3-1 1-3-3-3 3-1-1 3-3-3-3 1-1z",
  fullscreen:
    "M3 3h7v2H5v5H3V3zm11 0h7v7h-2V5h-5V3zM3 14h2v5h5v2H3v-7zm16 0h2v7h-7v-2h5v-5z",
  "exit-fullscreen":
    "M8 3h2v7H3V8h5V3zm6 0h2v5h5v2h-7V3zM3 14h7v7H8v-5H3v-2zm11 0h7v2h-5v5h-2v-7z",
};
export default function PlayerIcon({ name }: { name: PlayerIconName }) {
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/player-shell.tsx`

SHA-256: `ab7523d136189c5ab23690f8548cef6b87000929009b3ab7a5aac91ad59969c9`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePlayerFullscreen } from "../hooks/use-player-fullscreen";
import { getPlaybackAction } from "../helpers/media/playback-action";
import { handlePlayerKey } from "../helpers/media/player-keyboard";
import type {
  PlayerController,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import VideoControls from "./video-controls";
export default function PlayerShell({
  title,
  labels,
  controller,
  children,
  controlsVariant = "full",
}: {
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  controller: PlayerController;
  children: ReactNode;
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
}) {
  const shellRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { snapshot, toggle, retry } = controller;
  const { fullscreen, supported, toggleFullscreen } =
    usePlayerFullscreen(shellRef);
  const action = getPlaybackAction(snapshot, labels);
  return (
    <div
      className={`custom-video-player${controlsVariant === "overlay" ? " custom-video-player--overlay" : ""}`}
      ref={shellRef}
      tabIndex={0}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      onKeyDown={(event) => handlePlayerKey(event, controller, toggleFullscreen)}
    >
      <div className="custom-video-stage" onClick={(event) => {
        if (event.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement && snapshot.ready) {
          shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          toggle();
        }
      }}>
        {children}
        {controlsVariant === "overlay" && (snapshot.status === "paused" || snapshot.status === "ended") ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="custom-video-overlay-toggle"
            aria-label={action.label}
            title={action.label}
            disabled={!snapshot.ready}
            onClick={() => {
              shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
              toggle();
            }}
          >
            <PlayerIcon name={action.icon} />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {controlsVariant === "full" ? (
        <VideoControls
          state={snapshot}
          labels={labels}
          toggle={toggle}
          seek={controller.seek}
          toggleMute={controller.toggleMute}
          volume={controller.volume}
          fullscreen={fullscreen}
          fullscreenSupported={supported}
          toggleFullscreen={() => void toggleFullscreen()}
        />
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "buffering" ? (
        <span className="custom-video-status" role="status">
          {labels.loading}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "error" ? (
        <div className="custom-video-error" role="alert">
          <p>{labels.error}</p>
          <button type="button" className="custom-video-retry" onClick={retry}>
            {labels.retry}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { TestimonialsContent } from "../types/marketing";
import ReviewCard from "./review-card";

export default function ReviewList({ reviews, expansion }: Pick<TestimonialsContent, "reviews" | "expansion">) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const id = useId();
  const count = expansion ? Math.max(0, expansion.initialCount) : reviews.length;
  const visibleReviews = expanded ? reviews : reviews.slice(0, count);
  return (
    <>
      <div id={id} className="testimonials-grid">
        {visibleReviews.map((review, index) => (
          <div key={`${review.name}:${index}`} className={expanded && index >= count ? "review-revealed" : undefined}>
            <ReviewCard {...review} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {expansion && !expanded && count < reviews.length ? (
        <div className="testimonials-more">
          <button type="button" className="testimonials-more-button" aria-controls={id} aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>
            {expansion.showMoreLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/rich-text.tsx`

SHA-256: `e675e0fbfcbbf9115b1d717081df89f72cd709ed6511a293f480b6e178a7d76f`

```tsx
import { Fragment } from "react";
import Icon from "./ui-icon";
import type { RichTextContent } from "../types/ui";

export default function RichText({ content }: { content: RichTextContent }) {
  return content.map((part, index) => {
    if (typeof part === "string")
      return <Fragment key={index}>{part}</Fragment>;
    if (part.kind === "break") return <br key={index} />;
    const Tag = part.kind === "strong" ? "b" : "span";
    return (
      <Tag
        key={index}
        className={part.className}
        aria-hidden={part.decorative || undefined}
      >
        {part.icon && <Icon {...part.icon} fill="currentColor" />}
        <RichText content={part.children} />
      </Tag>
    );
  });
```

```tsx
  arrow: "M20 11H7.83l5.59-5.59L12 4l-8 8 8 8 1.41-1.41L7.83 13H20v-2z",
  sparkle: "M12 2l2.4 7.2L22 12l-7.6 2.8L12 22l-2.4-7.2L2 12l7.6-2.8z",
  shield:
    "M12 1L3 5v6c0 5.55 3.84 10.74 9 12 5.16-1.26 9-6.45 9-12V5l-9-4zm-2 16l-4-4 1.41-1.41L10 14.17l6.59-6.59L18 9l-8 8z",
  play: "M8 5v14l11-7z",
} as const;

  name,
  ...props
}: { name: IconName } & ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"svg">) {

        strokeWidth="2"
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/video-controls.tsx`

SHA-256: `e97fc6a9e5f5856d253e9604450080e107fe296c24fbe9364d8231642a74f3ed`

```tsx
"use client";
import { formatPlayerTime } from "../helpers/media/format-time";
import { getPlaybackAction } from "../helpers/media/playback-action";
import type { PlayerSnapshot, VideoPlayerLabels } from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import VideoVolumeControls from "./video-volume-controls";
export default function VideoControls({
  state,
  labels,
  toggle,
  seek,
  toggleMute,
  volume,
  fullscreen,
  fullscreenSupported,
  toggleFullscreen,
}: {
  state: PlayerSnapshot;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  toggle: () => void;
  seek: (time: number) => void;
  toggleMute: () => void;
  volume: (value: number) => void;
  fullscreen: boolean;
  fullscreenSupported: boolean;
  toggleFullscreen: () => void;
}) {
  const action = getPlaybackAction(state, labels);
  return (
    <div
      className="custom-video-controls"
      role="group"
      aria-label={labels.controls}
      dir="ltr"
    >
      <input
        className="custom-video-seek"
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={state.duration || 1}
        step="0.1"
        value={state.time}
        aria-label={labels.seek}
        aria-valuetext={`${formatPlayerTime(state.time)} / ${formatPlayerTime(state.duration)}`}
        disabled={!state.ready || state.duration <= 0}
        onChange={(event) => seek(Number(event.target.value))}
      />
      <div className="custom-video-control-row">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="custom-video-control"
          aria-label={action.label}
          title={action.label}
          disabled={!state.ready}
          onClick={toggle}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={action.icon} />
        </button>
        <span className="custom-video-time">
          <time>{formatPlayerTime(state.time)}</time>
          <span aria-hidden="true"> / </span>
          <time>{formatPlayerTime(state.duration)}</time>
        </span>
        <VideoVolumeControls state={state} labels={labels} toggleMute={toggleMute} volume={volume} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="custom-video-control"
          aria-label={
            fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen
          }
          title={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          disabled={!fullscreenSupported}
          onClick={toggleFullscreen}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={fullscreen ? "exit-fullscreen" : "fullscreen"} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

export default function VideoVolumeControls({ state, labels, toggleMute, volume }: {
  state: PlayerSnapshot; labels: VideoPlayerLabels; toggleMute: () => void; volume: (value: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="custom-video-volume-group">
      <button type="button" className="custom-video-control"

      </button>
      <input className="custom-video-volume" type="range" min={0} max={100}

        disabled={!state.ready} onChange={(event) => volume(Number(event.target.value))} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { useYouTubePlayer } from "../hooks/use-youtube-player";
import type { VideoPlayerLabels, PlayerControlsVariant } from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerShell from "./player-shell";
export default function YouTubePlayer({
  url,
  title,
  labels,
  controlsVariant,
  onPlay,
  onEnded,
}: {
  url: string;
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
  onPlay?: () => void;

}) {

    </PlayerShell>
  );
}
```

### File: `scripts/architecture-boundaries.cjs`

SHA-256: `e453e00064fc8d46b6c444c81641c43cb520102c06f7ae4fbd6f6a3ccf4b44fa`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Test/build AST boundary inspection. */
const { inspectFunctionSizes } = require("./architecture/function-size.cjs");
const ts = require("typescript"),
  fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path");
const normalize = (file) => path.normalize(file).replaceAll("\\", "/");
function inspect(input) {
  const files = new Map(input.map(([file, text]) => [normalize(file), text]));
  const failures = new Set(),
    graph = new Map(),
    sources = new Map();
  const fail = (file, rule, target = "") =>
    failures.add(`${file}: ${rule}${target ? " " + target : ""}`);
  const resolve = (file, request) => {
    let base;
    if (request.startsWith("@/app/")) base = request.slice(2);
    else if (request.startsWith("@platform/")) base = "modules/" + request.slice(10);
    else if (request.startsWith("@/"))
      base = request.slice(2);
    else if (request.startsWith("@khatab/design/"))
      base =
        "packages/design-system/" + request.slice("@khatab/design/".length);
    else if (request.startsWith("."))
      base = path.join(path.dirname(file), request);
    else return request;
    base = normalize(base);
    return (
      [
        base,
        base + ".ts",
        base + ".tsx",
        base + ".json",
        base + "/index.ts",
        base + "/index.tsx",
      ].find((candidate) => files.has(candidate)) ?? base
    );
  };
  for (const [file, text] of files) {
    if (file.endsWith(".css")) {
      if (/^(?:app|modules)\/styles\//.test(file) && !file.endsWith("/theme.css") && /^@import ['"].*packages\/design-system\/styles\/[^'"]+['"];?$/.test(text.trim()))
        fail(file, "redundant shared stylesheet adapter");
      if (/transition\s*:\s*all\b/.test(text)) fail(file, "transition all");
      if (
        file !== "packages/design-system/styles/theme.css" &&
        /--(?:primary-red|bg-main)\s*:/.test(text)
      )
        fail(file, "copied base token ownership");
      continue;
    }
    inspectFunctionSizes(file, text).forEach((failure) => failures.add(failure));
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(
      file,
      text,
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
      file.endsWith(".tsx") ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS,
    );
    const declarations = source.statements.filter((node) => !(ts.isExpressionStatement(node) && ts.isStringLiteral(node.expression)));
    if (/^(?:app|modules)\//.test(file) && declarations.length && declarations.every((node) =>
      ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier) && /^(?:packages\/design-system\/|config\/)/.test(resolve(file, node.moduleSpecifier.text))))
      fail(file, "redundant shared forwarding file");
    sources.set(file, source);
    const edges = [];
    source.forEachChild((node) => {
      if (
        !(ts.isImportDeclaration(node) || ts.isExportDeclaration(node)) ||
        !node.moduleSpecifier ||
        node.isTypeOnly ||
        node.importClause?.isTypeOnly
      )
        return;
      const clause = node.importClause?.namedBindings ?? node.exportClause;
      if (
        clause &&
        ts.isNamedImports(clause) &&
        !node.importClause.name &&
        clause.elements.every((item) => item.isTypeOnly)
      )
        return;
      const request = node.moduleSpecifier.text;
      edges.push(resolve(file, request));
      if (
        /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|types|helpers)/.test(file) &&
        /features|\/app\//.test(request)
      )
        fail(file, "app dependency", request);
    });
    graph.set(file, edges);
    const visit = (node) => {
      if (
        ts.isCallExpression(node) &&
        (node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword ||
          (ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) &&
            node.expression.text === "require")) &&
        node.arguments.length &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0])
      ) {
        edges.push(resolve(file, node.arguments[0].text));
      }
      if (
        ts.isJsxAttribute(node) &&
        node.name.getText(source) === "href" &&
        node.initializer &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.initializer) &&
        /^\/(?:[a-z0-9-]+\/)?(?:courses|learn|api|dashboard)(?:\/|$)/.test(
          node.initializer.text,
        ) &&
        file.startsWith("modules/components/")
      )
        fail(file, "literal internal destination", node.initializer.text);
      if (
        file.startsWith("modules/") &&
        file !== "modules/config/navigation.ts" &&
        ts.isTemplateExpression(node) &&
        /^\/(?:[a-z0-9-]+\/)?(?:courses|learn|api)\//.test(node.head.text)
      )
        fail(file, "duplicated route builder");
      if (
        /\/app\/.*page\.tsx$/.test(file) &&
        ts.isJsxAttribute(node) &&
        node.name.getText(source) === "className" &&
        node.initializer &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.initializer) &&
        /\blms-(?:course-card|resource-card|certificate)\b/.test(
          node.initializer.text,
        )
      )
        fail(file, "page owns reusable card markup");
      ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    };
    visit(source);
  }
  function reachable(start, predicate) {
    const visited = new Set();
    const walk = (file, chain) => {
      if (predicate(file)) return [...chain, file];
      if (visited.has(file)) return;
      visited.add(file);
      for (const edge of graph.get(file) ?? []) {
        const found = walk(edge, [...chain, file]);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    };
    return walk(start, []);
  }
  for (const [file, source] of sources) {
    const renderer =
      /components\//.test(file) || /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|helpers)/.test(file);
    const pure =
      /(?:selectors|view-models|renderer|sanitize|validation)\.ts$/.test(file) ||
      /(?:modules\/helpers\/|features\/(?:catalog|learning)\/helpers\/)/.test(file);
    if (renderer || pure) {
      const chain = reachable(
        file,
        (target) => target !== file && /\/data\//.test(target),
      );
      if (chain)
        fail(
          file,
          "transitive concrete content dependency",
          chain.join(" -> "),
        );
    }
    const client = source.statements.some(
      (node) =>
        ts.isExpressionStatement(node) &&
        ts.isStringLiteral(node.expression) &&
        node.expression.text === "use client",
    );
    if (client || pure || /design-system\/(?:ui|hooks|helpers)/.test(file)) {
      const chain = reachable(
        file,
        (target) =>
          /^(?:next\/headers|node:fs|fs|server-only)$/.test(target) ||
          /certificate-font\.json$/.test(target),
      );
      if (chain) fail(file, "transitive server dependency", chain.join(" -> "));
    }
  }
  const visiting = new Set(),
    done = new Set();
  const cycle = (file, chain) => {
    if (visiting.has(file)) {
      fail(file, "runtime import cycle", [...chain, file].join(" -> "));
      return;
    }
    if (done.has(file) || !graph.has(file)) return;
    visiting.add(file);
    for (const edge of graph.get(file)) cycle(edge, [...chain, file]);
    visiting.delete(file);
    done.add(file);
  };
  for (const file of graph.keys()) cycle(file, []);
  return [...failures];
}
function collect(directories) {
  const files = [];
  const visit = (directory) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (["node_modules", ".next", "test-results"].includes(entry.name))
        continue;
      const file = path.join(directory, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) visit(file);
      else if (/\.(tsx?|css)$/.test(file))
        files.push([file, fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")]);
    }
  };
  directories.forEach(visit);
  return files;
}
module.exports = { inspect, collect };
if (require.main === module) {
  const files = collect([
    "app",
    "modules/components",
    "modules/config",
    "modules/data",
    "modules/features",
    "modules/hooks",
    "modules/helpers",
    "modules/lib",
    "modules/styles",
    "modules/types",
    "config",
    "packages/design-system",
  ]);
  const errors = inspect(files);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ files: files.length, errors }, null, 2));
  process.exitCode = errors.length ? 1 : 0;
}
```

### File: `scripts/architecture/function-size.cjs`

SHA-256: `a0a3370e692076897cc8b11e2936823550f86d36c3aa624d0ef49e6decb0c6e9`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- AST-backed production function budgets. */
const ts = require("typescript");
const helper = /\/helpers\//, hook = /\/hooks\//;
function containsMarkup(node) {
  if (ts.isJsxElement(node) || ts.isJsxSelfClosingElement(node) || ts.isJsxFragment(node)) return true;
  return Boolean(ts.forEachChild(node, containsMarkup));
}
function inspectFunctionSizes(file, text) {
  if (/\/(?:data|types|styles)\//.test(file)) return [];
  const source = ts.createSourceFile(file, text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
  const failures = [], lines = text.trimEnd().split("\n").length;
  const fileLimit = helper.test(file) ? 80 : hook.test(file) ? 60 : /(?:\/components\/|\/ui\/|\/app\/|^app\/.*page\.tsx$)/.test(file) ? 100 : undefined;
  if (fileLimit && lines > fileLimit) failures.push(`${file}: file exceeds ${fileLimit} lines (${lines})`);
  const visit = (node) => {
    if (ts.isFunctionLike(node) && node.body && !containsMarkup(node.body)) {
      const start = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.body.getStart(source)).line;
      const count = source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.body.end).line - start + 1;
      const limit = hook.test(file) ? 45 : 35;
      if (count > limit) failures.push(`${file}:${start + 1}: function exceeds ${limit} lines (${count})`);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(source);
  return failures;
}
module.exports = { inspectFunctionSizes };
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Checks commit candidates without exposing secrets. */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
if (fs.existsSync('.env.local')) process.loadEnvFile('.env.local');
const secrets = Object.entries(process.env).filter(([name,value]) => /(?:DB_URL|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY|SECRET_KEY|PASSWORD|ACCESS_TOKEN)$/.test(name) && value?.length >= 8).map(([,value]) => value);
if (process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL) secrets.push(decodeURIComponent(new URL(process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL).password));
const paths = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']).toString().split('\0').filter(Boolean);
const violations = [];
for (const path of paths) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(path) || !fs.lstatSync(path).isFile()) continue;
  const content = fs.readFileSync(path);
  if (secrets.some(value => content.includes(Buffer.from(value))) || /-----BEGIN (?:RSA |OPENSSH |EC )?PRIVATE KEY-----/.test(content.toString())) violations.push(path);
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ filesChecked: paths.length, violations },null,2));
process.exitCode = violations.length ? 1 : 0;
```

```typescript
import accounts from "../../config/admin-accounts.json";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { courses } from "../../modules/data/courses";
import { resources } from "../../modules/data/resources";
const quote = (value: unknown) => `'${String(value).replaceAll("'", "''")}'`;
const statements = ["-- Generated by npm run backend:seed:generate. Public metadata excludes playback URLs."];
for (const [position, course] of courses.entries()) {
  const metadata = { ...course, modules: course.modules.map(section => ({ ...section, lessons: section.lessons.map(lesson => ({ ...lesson, videoUrl: "" })) })) };
  statements.push(`insert into public.courses(slug,metadata,amount,published,position) values (${quote(course.slug)},${quote(JSON.stringify(metadata))}::jsonb,${course.offer.amount},true,${position}) on conflict(slug) do nothing;`);
  for (const section of course.modules) for (const lesson of section.lessons) {
    statements.push(`insert into public.lessons(course_slug,id,preview,video_url) values (${quote(course.slug)},${quote(lesson.id)},${Boolean(lesson.preview)},${quote(lesson.videoUrl)}) on conflict(course_slug,id) do nothing;`);
  }
}
for (const resource of resources) statements.push(`insert into public.resources(id,title,description,type,content) values (${[resource.id,resource.title,resource.description,resource.type,resource.content].map(quote).join(",")}) on conflict(id) do update set title=excluded.title,description=excluded.description,type=excluded.type,content=excluded.content;`);
for (const course of courses) for (const section of course.modules) for (const lesson of section.lessons) for (const id of lesson.resourceIds)
  statements.push(`insert into public.lesson_resources(resource_id,course_slug,lesson_id) values (${[id,course.slug,lesson.id].map(quote).join(",")}) on conflict do nothing;`);
for (const account of accounts) statements.push(`insert into public.admin_allowlist(email) values (${quote(account.email)}) on conflict do nothing;`);
statements.push("insert into public.admin_users(user_id) select id from auth.users where email_confirmed_at is not null and lower(email) in (select email from public.admin_allowlist) on conflict do nothing;");
writeFileSync("supabase/seed.sql", statements.join("\n") + "\n");
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- One-time Auth provisioning; secrets remain local. */
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const accounts = require('../../config/admin-accounts.json');
process.loadEnvFile('.env.local');
const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
if (!key) throw new Error('Set SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY in ignored .env.local');
const client = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
(async () => {
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.admin.listUsers({ perPage: 1000 });
  if (error) throw new Error('Cannot access hosted Auth admin API');
  for (const account of accounts) {
    const password = process.env[account.passwordEnvironment];
    if (!password) throw new Error('Missing local account password');
    const existing = data.users.find(user => user.email?.toLowerCase() === account.email);
    const values = { email: account.email, password, email_confirm: true, user_metadata: { name: account.name } };
    const result = existing ? await client.auth.admin.updateUserById(existing.id, values) : await client.auth.admin.createUser(values);
    if (result.error || !result.data.user) throw new Error('Admin provisioning failed; credentials omitted');
    const user = result.data.user;
    const profile = await client.from('profiles').upsert({ id: user.id, name: account.name }, { ignoreDuplicates: true });
    const membership = await client.from('admin_users').upsert({ user_id: user.id });
    if (profile.error || membership.error) throw new Error('Admin membership provisioning failed');
    console.log(`Provisioned verified admin: ${account.email}`);
  }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Build-time generation from canonical CSS; no runtime source parsing. */
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const {
  parseTokens,
  resolveToken,
} = require("../packages/design-system/lib/theme.cjs");
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const base = fs.readFileSync(
  path.join(root, "packages/design-system/styles/theme.css"),
  "utf8",
);
for (const entry of ["app/styles", "modules/styles"]) {
  const tokens = parseTokens([
    base,
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, entry, "theme.css"), "utf8"),
  ]);
  const theme = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries({
      primary: "--primary-red",
      background: "--bg-main",
      text: "--text-primary",
      font: "--font-arabic",
    }).map(([key, name]) => [key, resolveToken(tokens, name)]),
  );
  if (entry === "app/styles") {
    theme.workshopMotion = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(tokens)
        .filter((name) => name.startsWith("--workshop-reveal-"))
        .map((name) => {
          const key = name
            .slice("--workshop-reveal-".length)
            .replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
          const raw = resolveToken(tokens, name);
          return [
            key,
            key === "easing"
              ? raw
              : parseFloat(raw) *
                (raw.endsWith("s") && !raw.endsWith("ms") ? 1000 : 1),
          ];
        }),
    );
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(root, entry, "theme-server.json"),
    JSON.stringify(theme, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
}
// Server-only export asset: baked into the server bundle, independent of runtime cwd.
const certificateFont = fs
  .readFileSync(
    path.join(root, "public/assets/fonts/ibm-plex-arabic-700.ttf"),
  )
  .toString("base64");
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(root, "modules/styles/certificate-font.json"),
  JSON.stringify({ base64: certificateFont }) + "\n",
);
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Production browser measurements, separate from screenshot capture. */
const fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path"),
  { chromium } = require("@playwright/test");
const destination = path.resolve(
  __dirname,
  "../docs/evidence/architecture-acceptance/final",
);
const routes = [
  "/",
  "/courses",
  "/courses?category=motion",
  "/courses?q=missing-term",
  "/courses/editing-foundations",
  "/courses/motion-essentials",
  "/login",
  "/dashboard",
  "/dashboard/courses",
  "/dashboard/profile",
  "/dashboard/resources",
  "/dashboard/certificates",
  "/learn/editing-foundations/first-cut",
  "/courses/unknown-course",
];
(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  const rows = [];
  for (const [app, url, paths] of [
    ["workshop", "http://localhost:3040", ["/7days-freelance"]],
    ["lms", "http://localhost:3040", routes],
  ])
    for (const route of paths) {
      for (let run = 0; run < 5; run++) {
        const context = await browser.newContext({
            viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
          }),
          page = await context.newPage();
        await page.addInitScript(() => {
          window.__audit = {
            cls: 0,
            longTasks: [],
            frames: [],
            scrollStart: 0,
            scrollEnd: 0,
          };
          new PerformanceObserver((list) =>
            list.getEntries().forEach((entry) => {
              if (!entry.hadRecentInput) window.__audit.cls += entry.value;
            }),
          ).observe({ type: "layout-shift", buffered: true });
          new PerformanceObserver((list) =>
            window.__audit.longTasks.push(
              ...list
                .getEntries()
                .map((entry) => ({
                  start: entry.startTime,
                  duration: entry.duration,
                })),
            ),
          ).observe({ type: "longtask", buffered: true });
        });
        await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/**", (route) =>
          route.fulfill({ body: "Preview deliberately deferred" }),
        );
        await page.goto(url + route);
        await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
        await page.evaluate(async () => {
          window.__audit.scrollStart = performance.now();
          let last = performance.now();
          for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++)
            await new Promise((resolve) =>
              requestAnimationFrame((now) => {
                window.__audit.frames.push(now - last);
                last = now;
                scrollBy(0, 60);
                resolve();
              }),
            );
          window.__audit.scrollEnd = performance.now();
          await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
        });
        rows.push({
          app,
          route,
          run,
          ...(await page.evaluate(() => ({
            ...window.__audit,
            resources: performance
              .getEntriesByType("resource")
              .filter((entry) => /\.(js|css)(\?|$)/.test(entry.name))
              .map((entry) => ({
                url: entry.name.replace(location.origin, ""),
                bytes: entry.encodedBodySize,
              })),
          }))),
        });
        await context.close();
      }
      console.log(`${app} ${route}: five runs`);
    }
  await browser.close();
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(destination, "route-performance.json"),
    JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
  const median = (values) =>
    values.sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(values.length / 2)];
  const p95 = (values) =>
    [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(values.length * 0.95)];
  const summaries = [];
  for (const key of new Set(rows.map((row) => row.app + " " + row.route))) {
    const runs = rows.filter((row) => row.app + " " + row.route === key);
    summaries.push({
      route: key,
      cls: median(runs.map((row) => row.cls)),
      p95FrameMs: median(runs.map((row) => p95(row.frames))),
      jsBytes: median(
        runs.map((row) =>
          row.resources
            .filter((r) => r.url.includes(".js"))
            .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.bytes, 0),
        ),
      ),
      cssBytes: median(
        runs.map((row) =>
          row.resources
            .filter((r) => r.url.includes(".css"))
            .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.bytes, 0),
        ),
      ),
      scrollLongTasks: runs.map(
        (row) =>
          row.longTasks.filter(
            (task) =>
              task.start >= row.scrollStart && task.start <= row.scrollEnd,
          ).length,
      ),
    });
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(
    path.join(destination, "route-performance-summary.json"),
    JSON.stringify(summaries, null, 2) + "\n",
  );
  console.log(JSON.stringify(summaries, null, 2));
  if (
    summaries.some(
      (row) => row.cls > 0.1 || row.scrollLongTasks.some((count) => count > 1),
    )
  )
    process.exitCode = 1;
})().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Deterministic portable source snapshot, never screenshot regeneration. */
const fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path"),
  crypto = require("node:crypto");
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, ".."),
  prompt = path.join(root, "DESIGN_REPRODUCTION_PROMPT.md");
const hash = (text) => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(text).digest("hex");
const files = [];
function collect(relative) {
  const location = path.join(root, relative),
    stat = fs.lstatSync(location);
  if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) return;
  if (stat.isDirectory()) {
    if (
      [
        "node_modules",
        ".next",
        "test-results",
        "test-results-development",
        ".git",
      ].includes(path.basename(relative))
    )
      return;
    for (const name of fs.readdirSync(location).sort())
      collect(path.join(relative, name));
  } else if (
    /\.(ts|tsx|css|json|cjs|mjs|fixture)$/.test(relative) &&
    !relative.endsWith("certificate-font.json") &&
    !relative.endsWith("next-env.d.ts")
  )
    files.push(relative.replaceAll("\\", "/"));
}
for (const directory of [
  "app",
  "config",
  "packages/design-system",
  "modules/components",
  "modules/config",
  "modules/data",
  "modules/features",
  "modules/hooks",
  "modules/helpers",
  "modules/lib",
  "modules/styles",
  "modules/types",
  "scripts",
  "tests",
])
  collect(directory);
for (const file of [
  "package.json",
  "next.config.ts",
  "tsconfig.json",
  "eslint.config.mjs",
  "playwright.config.ts",
  "playwright.development.config.ts",
  "playwright.crossbrowser.config.ts",
])
  if (!files.includes(file)) files.push(file);
files.sort();
const original = fs.readFileSync(prompt, "utf8");
const begin = original.indexOf(
    "## 14. Exact embedded implementation and verification files",
  ),
  end = original.lastIndexOf("\n## 15. Embedded text assets\n");
if (begin < 0 || end < 0) throw new Error("Missing source appendix boundaries");
const appendix = [
  "## 14. Exact embedded implementation and verification files",
  "",
  "Current shared architecture snapshot. Materialize all paths together; run npm ci once at the root using the companion lockfile, then prebuild generation. The separate test fixture is not a shipped application route. Generated .next/node_modules and server font JSON are excluded. Source hashes verify reconstruction, not visual approval.",
  "",
];
for (const file of files) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), "utf8");
  const ext = path.extname(file).slice(1);
  appendix.push(
    `### File: \`${file}\``,
    "",
    `SHA-256: \`${hash(text)}\``,
    "",
    `\`\`\`${ext === "tsx" ? "tsx" : ext === "css" ? "css" : ext === "json" ? "json" : "typescript"}`,
    text.trimEnd(),
    "```",
    "",
  );
}
let result =
  original.slice(0, begin) + appendix.join("\n") + "\n" + original.slice(end);
const lock = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "package-lock.json"));
result = result.replace(
  /Companion `package-lock.json`: \*\*\d+ bytes\*\*; SHA-256 `[a-f0-9]+`/,
  `Companion \`package-lock.json\`: **${lock.length} bytes**; SHA-256 \`${hash(lock)}\``,
);
result = result.replace(/\n+LMS companion lockfile:[^\n]+\n+/g, "\n");
if (process.argv.includes("--check")) {
  if (result !== original) throw new Error("Source snapshot is stale");
} else fs.writeFileSync(prompt, result);
console.log(
  `${files.length} source files ${process.argv.includes("--check") ? "verified" : "snapshotted"}`,
);

### File: `scripts/verify-visual.cjs`

SHA-256: `6ccc6795cdd718fdf1d164ea68b71f5a72bb3136b69f684ffc643929f19df5cd`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Narrow, recorded baseline exceptions; never update baseline images. */
const fs = require("node:fs"),
  path = require("node:path"),
  { PNG } = require("../node_modules/playwright-core/lib/utilsBundle.js");
const root = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    "../docs/evidence/architecture-acceptance",
  ),
  phase = process.argv[2] || "final";
const baseline = JSON.parse(
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "baseline/screens.json")),
  ),
  current = JSON.parse(
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, phase + "/screens.json")),
  );
const raw = JSON.parse(
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, phase + "/comparison.json")),
  ),
  results = [];
const near = (a, b) => Math.abs(a - b) <= 1;
for (const before of baseline) {
  const after = current.find((item) => item.name === before.name),
    comparison = raw.find((item) => item.name === before.name);
  if (!after) throw new Error(`Missing screen ${before.name}`);
  const faq =
    before.app === "lms" &&
    before.route === "/" &&
    [320, 390, 768].includes(before.width);
  const duration =
    before.app === "lms" &&
    before.route === "/ta3allam/courses/editing-foundations" &&
    before.width === 320;
  const a = PNG.sync.read(
      fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "baseline", before.name + ".png")),
    ),
    b = PNG.sync.read(
      fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, phase, before.name + ".png")),
    );
  const cuts = faq
    ? before.geometry
        .filter((item) => item.class === "faq-answer-panel")
        .map((item) => [Math.round(item.y), Math.round(item.y + item.height)])
    : duration
      ? [[727, 765]]
      : [];
  const rowMap = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < a.height; y++)
    if (!cuts.some(([start, end]) => y >= start && y < end)) rowMap.push(y);
  if (a.width !== b.width || rowMap.length !== b.height)
    throw new Error(`Unexpected dimensions ${before.name}`);
  for (let index = 0; index < before.geometry.length; index++) {
    const old = before.geometry[index],
      next = after.geometry[index];
    if (!next || old.class !== next.class)
      throw new Error(`Unexpected geometry class ${before.name} ${old.class}`);
    let expectedY = old.y,
      expectedHeight = old.height;
    if (faq && old.id === "faq") expectedHeight -= 80;
    if (faq && old.class === "faq-answer-panel") {
      const position = before.geometry
        .filter((item) => item.class === "faq-answer-panel")
        .indexOf(old);
      expectedY -= position * 16;
      expectedHeight = 0;
    }
    if (faq && old.class === "section final-cta-section") expectedY -= 80;
    if (
      !near(old.x, next.x) ||
      !near(old.width, next.width) ||
      !near(expectedY, next.y) ||
      !near(expectedHeight, next.height)
    )
      throw new Error(`Unexpected geometry ${before.name} ${old.class}`);
  }
  let changed = 0,
    total = 0;
  const notes = [];
  if (faq)
    notes.push(
      "Five erroneous 16px collapsed FAQ gaps removed; lower pixels aligned by those exact rows.",
    );
  if (duration)
    notes.push(
      "Numeric duration now two hours: metadata reflows by 38px; only its text region is excepted, lower raster edges allow the documented 1px geometry tolerance.",
    );
  if (faq && before.width === 320)
    notes.push(
      "Baseline capture missed the instructor portrait despite matching frame geometry. Asset-load region is excluded from comparison; current loaded source is separately verified against the approved asset.",
    );
  for (let y = 0; y < b.height; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < b.width; x++) {
      if (duration && y >= 660 && y < 730) continue;
      if (
        faq &&
        before.width === 320 &&
        x >= 16 &&
        x < 304 &&
        y >= 4185 &&
        y < 4550
      )
        continue;
      const j = (y * b.width + x) * 4;
      let delta = 255;
      for (const offset of duration && y >= 727 ? [-1, 0, 1] : [0]) {
        const yy = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.height - 1, rowMap[y] + offset)),
          i = (yy * a.width + x) * 4;
        delta = Math.min(
          delta,
          Math.max(
            Math.abs(a.data[i] - b.data[j]),
            Math.abs(a.data[i + 1] - b.data[j + 1]),
            Math.abs(a.data[i + 2] - b.data[j + 2]),
          ),
        );
      }
      total++;
      if (delta > 25.5) changed++;
    }
  const ratio = changed / total,
    pass = ratio <= 0.001 && after.overflow <= 1 && !after.errors.length;
  results.push({
    name: before.name,
    pass,
    pixelRatio: ratio,
    notes,
    rawPixelRatio: comparison.pixelRatio,
  });
}
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(root, phase + "/visual-gate.json"),
  JSON.stringify(results, null, 2) + "\n",
);
const failures = results.filter((item) => !item.pass);
console.log(
  `${results.length - failures.length}/${results.length} screens passed; ${results.filter((item) => item.notes.length).length} narrowly documented baseline exceptions.`,
);
if (failures.length) {
  console.error(failures);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
```

```typescript
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import ts from "typescript";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

function sources(directory: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = join(directory, entry.name);
    return entry.isDirectory()
      ? sources(path)
      : /\.tsx?$/.test(path)
        ? [path]
        : [];
  });
}

test("renderers and hooks do not import page data or configuration", () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const path of [...sources("app/components"), ...sources("app/hooks")]) {
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(
      path,
      readFileSync(path, "utf8"),
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
    );
    source.forEachChild((node) => {
      if (
        !ts.isImportDeclaration(node) ||
        !ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)
      )
        return;
      const target = node.moduleSpecifier.text;
      if (/\/(data|config)\//.test(target))
        violations.push(`${path}: ${target}`);
      if (path.includes("components/ui/") && /workshop/.test(target))
        violations.push(`${path}: feature dependency ${target}`);
    });
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

test("component content and asset destinations are supplied through props", () => {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const path of sources("app/components")) {
    const source = ts.createSourceFile(
      path,
      readFileSync(path, "utf8"),
      ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
      true,
    );
    const visit = (node: ts.Node) => {
      if (
        (ts.isStringLiteral(node) || ts.isJsxText(node)) &&
        /[\u0600-\u06ff]|https?:\/\/|\/assets\//.test(node.text)
      )
        violations.push(`${path}: ${node.text}`);
      ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
    };
    visit(source);
  }
  expect(violations).toEqual([]);
});

test("reusable modules do not create accidental Next.js special-file routes", () => {
  const specialFiles =
    /^(page|route|layout|template|default|loading|error|not-found|global-error|icon|apple-icon|opengraph-image|twitter-image)\.tsx?$/;
  expect(
    [
      "app/components",
      "app/hooks",
      "app/data",
      "app/lib",
      "packages/design-system/types",
      "app/config",
    ]
      .flatMap(sources)
      .filter((path) => specialFiles.test(path.split("/").at(-1)!)),
  ).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
  expect(validateAuth({}, "signup")).toEqual({ valid: false, errors: { name: "nameRequired", email: "emailRequired", password: "passwordRequired", confirmPassword: "confirmationRequired" } });

  expect(validateAuth({ ...demo, name: "a".repeat(authPolicy.nameMax + 1), password: "a".repeat(authPolicy.passwordMax + 1) }, "signup")).toMatchObject({ valid: false, errors: { name: "nameLength", password: "passwordLength" } });
```

```typescript
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function userManagementBrowser({ manager, target, verify, url }) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage();
    const errors = []; page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(manager.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(manager.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    verify(true, 'Administrator login automatically opens administrator dashboard');
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'المستخدمون', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'الدورات', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await page.goto(url + '/dashboard');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    verify(true, 'Generic dashboard link resolves to administrator dashboard');
    await page.goto(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'إدارة المستخدمين', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: target.email });
    await expect(row).toContainText('Moderation Student');
    await row.getByRole('button', { name: 'إدارة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    const management = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'إدارة الحساب', exact: true });
    await expect(management).toBeVisible();
    await management.getByRole('combobox').selectOption('week');
    await management.getByRole('button', { name: 'تعليق الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'تأكيد الإجراء', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'تأكيد الإجراء', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(management.getByRole('button', { name: 'تعليق الحساب', exact: true })).toBeFocused();
    await management.getByRole('button', { name: 'تعليق الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تأكيد', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(row).toContainText('المتبقي:');
    await row.getByRole('link', { name: 'عرض المستخدم', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'الدورات المشترك بها', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('المتبقي:', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إدارة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'استعادة الوصول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByText('نشط', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
    verify(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), 'User detail fits mobile viewport');
    await page.goto(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    await expect(page.getByRole('table')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: target.email })).toBeVisible();
    for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      const viewport = await page.evaluate(() => ({ root: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, body: document.body.scrollWidth, width: innerWidth }));
      verify(Math.max(viewport.root, viewport.body) <= viewport.width, `Account records fit viewport (${JSON.stringify(viewport)})`);
      if (width <= 1024) {
        const name = await row.locator('.lms-admin-name').boundingBox();
        verify(name.width >= 150, `Account identity has readable width at ${width}px`);
      }
      await row.getByRole('button', { name: 'إدارة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(management).toBeVisible();
      const bounds = await management.boundingBox();
      verify(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= width && bounds.y >= 0 && bounds.y + bounds.height <= 900, `Management dialog fits ${width}px viewport`);
      const targets = await management.locator('button, select').evaluateAll(elements => elements.map(element => element.getBoundingClientRect().height));
      verify(targets.every(height => height >= 44), `Dialog controls have 44px touch targets at ${width}px`);
      await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
      verify(await management.evaluate(element => element.contains(document.activeElement)), `Keyboard focus remains inside dialog at ${width}px`);
      if (width === 390) await page.screenshot({ path: 'docs/evidence/backend/admin-users-management-390.png', fullPage: true });
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
      await expect(management).not.toBeVisible();
      await expect(row.getByRole('button', { name: 'إدارة الحساب', exact: true })).toBeFocused();
    }
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'docs/evidence/backend/admin-users-390.png', fullPage: true });
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Admin users dashboard has no browser JavaScript errors');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الخروج', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(target.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(target.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/dashboard');
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'المستخدمون', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    verify(true, 'Student login stays on student dashboard without administrator navigation');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real Auth, API, RLS and browser acceptance tests. */
module.exports = async function userManagementChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, student, verify, url }) {
  const manager = await provision('User Manager'), target = await provision('Moderation Student');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const base = '/api/admin/users', endpoint = `${base}/${target.id}`;
  const json = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
  verify((await anonymous(base)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot list private users');
  verify((await anonymous('/admin/dashboard')).headers.get('location')?.includes('/login'), 'Anonymous admin dashboard redirects to login');
  verify((await student.api(base)).status === 403, 'Student cannot list private users');
  const deniedPage = await student.api('/admin/dashboard');
  verify(deniedPage.headers.get('location')?.endsWith('/dashboard') || (deniedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT') && deniedPage.data.includes('/dashboard')), 'Student admin page redirects to private student dashboard');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint)).status === 403, 'Student cannot read another user detail');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 403, 'Student cannot promote users');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('promote_admin_user',{ target_id: student.id })).error), 'Database rejects direct student role promotion');
  const list = await manager.api(base);
  verify(list.status === 200 && json(list).users.some(user => user.id === target.id && user.email === target.email), 'Admin sees names usernames and emails');
  verify(!list.data.includes('encrypted_password') && !list.data.includes('access_token'), 'User listing exposes only selected public account fields');
  verify(/no-store/.test(list.headers.get('cache-control')), 'User data is never cached');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=-1')).status === 400, 'Invalid pagination rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).status === 200 && json(await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).users.length === 0, 'Empty pagination is handled');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/not-an-id`)).status === 400, 'Malformed user ID rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`)).status === 404, 'Unknown user returns 404');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'suspend', period: 'forever' })).status === 400, 'Unsupported suspension duration rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'remove' }, { headers: { Origin: 'https://attacker.example' } })).status === 403, 'Cross-origin user deletion rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'remove' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot delete self');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot ban self');
  verify(Boolean((await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(manager.id,{ ban_duration: '24h' })).error), 'Database prevents administrator ban races');
  await admin.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: target.id, course_slug: 'editing-foundations' });
  const detail = json(await manager.api(endpoint));
  verify(detail.user.name === 'Moderation Student' && detail.user.username.startsWith('user-'), 'User detail contains real profile and username');
  verify(detail.subscriptions.some(course => course.slug === 'editing-foundations'), 'User detail reads actual subscribed courses');
  for (const [period, hours] of [['day',24],['week',168],['month',720],['year',8760]]) {
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'suspend', period })).status === 200, `${period} suspension succeeds`);
    const until = json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.suspendedUntil;
    verify(Math.abs((Date.parse(until)-Date.now())/3600000-hours) < 0.01, `${period} suspension has correct expiry`);
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Suspension blocks previously issued API session');
    verify((await target.direct.from('enrollments').select('*')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct Data API with existing JWT');
    verify((await target.direct.from('lessons').select('*').eq('course_slug','editing-foundations')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct course playback retrieval');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' })).status === 200, 'Admin restores access before expiry');
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Restored account regains authorized session access');
  }
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 200, 'Permanent ban succeeds');
  verify(json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.permanentlyBanned, 'Permanent ban has separate status from suspension');
  const denied = await target.direct.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: target.email, password: target.password });
  verify(Boolean(denied.error), 'Banned account cannot sign in');
  await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' });
  await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(target.id,{ ban_duration: '1s' });
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Expired suspension automatically restores access');
  await require('./admin-users-browser.cjs')({ manager, target, verify, url });
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'remove' })).status === 200, 'Admin can delete student account');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint)).status === 404, 'Deleted user disappears from private detail');
  verify((await admin.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id',target.id)).data.length === 0, 'Delete cascades subscribed courses');
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Deleted user existing session is denied');
  verify((await target.direct.rpc('account_access_allowed')).data !== true, 'Deleted user old JWT cannot pass database access check');
  const promoted = await provision('Promoted User');
  try {
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 200, 'Admin promotes confirmed student');
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promoted user gains admin access');
    await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(promoted.id,{ email_confirm: true });
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promotion persists after provider email confirmation updates');
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Other administrators are protected');
  } finally { await admin.from('admin_allowlist').delete().eq('email',promoted.email); }
};
```

```typescript
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
const fs = require('node:fs');
module.exports = async function browserChecks({ url, config, admin, identities, verify, student }) {

    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(student.email);

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();

    verify(true, 'Browser login navigates to protected dashboard');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الخروج', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Browser logout returns to login');
    await page.goto(url + '/signup');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إنشاء حساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('اسمك', { exact: true })).toBeFocused();
    verify(true, 'Invalid browser signup focuses first field');
    const email = `signup-browser-${Date.now()}@example.com`, password = 'Local-Test-Password-19!';
    await page.getByLabel('اسمك', { exact: true }).fill('طالب جديد');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByLabel('تأكيد كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إنشاء حساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'راجع بريدك الإلكتروني' })).toBeVisible();
    verify(!page.url().endsWith('/dashboard'), 'Signup waits for email confirmation');
    const users = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers();
    const created = users.data.users.find(user => user.email === email);
    if (created) identities.push(created.id);
    verify(Boolean(created && !created.email_confirmed_at), 'Signup creates an unconfirmed real account');
    const messages = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/messages')).json();
    const message = messages.messages.find(message => message.To.some(recipient => recipient.Address === email));
    verify(Boolean(message), 'Supabase sends confirmation email to local Mailpit');
    const mail = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/message/' + message.ID)).json();
    const link = mail.HTML.match(/href="([^"]+\/auth\/v1\/verify[^\"]+)"/)?.[1].replaceAll('&amp;', '&');
    verify(Boolean(link), 'Confirmation email includes valid Auth verification link');
    await page.goto(link);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
    verify(true, 'Email verification and PKCE callback establish browser session');
    for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      await page.goto(url + '/login');
      await expect(page.locator('.lms-auth-card')).toBeVisible();
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `Auth layout fits ${width}px`);
      await page.screenshot({ path: `docs/evidence/backend/login-${width}.png`, fullPage: true });
    }
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Real authentication browser flows have no JavaScript errors');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real-account access regression. */
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function dashboardAccess({ url, student, verify }) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext();
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const login = async () => {
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(student.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(student.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
  };
  try {
    await login();
    const admin = await context.request.get(url + '/api/admin/courses/7days-freelance');
    verify(admin.status() === 403, 'Signed-in student cannot use admin course APIs');
    await context.clearCookies();
    await page.locator('a[href="/dashboard/profile"]').first().click();
    await expect(page, 'Lost session navigation').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Lost session cannot navigate through a retained dashboard layout');
    await login();
    await page.locator('a[href="/dashboard/profile"]').first().click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard\/profile$/);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الخروج', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page, 'Logout navigation').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await page.waitForLoadState('load');
    await page.goBack();
    await expect(page, 'Back navigation after logout').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Back after logout cannot restore cached dashboard content');
    const response = await context.request.get(url + '/dashboard', { maxRedirects: 0 });
    verify(response.status() === 307 && !(await response.text()).includes('lms-dashboard'), 'Logout removes access before dashboard rendering');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { offerConfig } from "../app/config/offer";
import { splitCountdown } from "../app/lib/countdown";

test("countdown splits day boundaries and stops at zero", () => {
  expect(splitCountdown(86400)).toEqual({
    days: "01",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
  expect(splitCountdown(-1)).toEqual({
    days: "00",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
});

test("reference countdown ticks and keeps its deadline after refreshing", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-03T10:00:00Z");
  const remaining = 3 * 86400 + 19 * 3600 + 27 * 60 + 13;
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(now);
  await page.addInitScript(
    ({ key, deadline }) => {
      if (!localStorage.getItem(key))
        localStorage.setItem(key, String(deadline));
    },
    { key: offerConfig.storageKey, deadline: now.getTime() + remaining * 1000 },
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const timer = page.getByRole("timer");
  await expect(
    page.getByText("ينتهي الخصم خلال :", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("03");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="hours"]')).toHaveText("19");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="minutes"]')).toHaveText(
    "27",
  );
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "13",
  );
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(now.getTime() + 1000));
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  const deadline = await page.evaluate(
    (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(
      (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
      offerConfig.storageKey,
    ),
  ).toBe(deadline);
});

test("expired discount stays expired and blocked storage does not crash", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(
    (key) => localStorage.setItem(key, "1"),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "00",
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  const errors: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  await page.addInitScript(() =>
    Object.defineProperty(window, "localStorage", {
      get() {
        throw new Error("Storage blocked");
      },
    }),
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole("timer")).toBeVisible();
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("hero thumbnail activates original MP4 with only centered play/pause", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const errors: string[] = [],
    providerRequests: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on("request", (request) => {
    if (/youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/.test(request.url()))
      providerRequests.push(request.url());
  });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder img")).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/images/workshop-intro-poster.jpg",
  );
  await expect(hero.locator("video,iframe")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو التعريفي", exact: true })
    .click();
  const video = hero.locator("video");
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState))
    .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  await expect(video).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4",
  );
  expect(
    await video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).controls),
  ).toBe(false);
  await expect(
    hero.locator(".custom-video-controls,input,iframe,a"),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-stage button")).toHaveCount(0);
  await video.click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(true);
  await hero
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(false);
  await video.evaluate((node) => {
    const v = node as HTMLVideoElement;
    v.currentTime = v.duration - 0.1;
    void v.play();
  });
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(video).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(providerRequests).toEqual([]);
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1440])
  test(`hero thumbnail and overlay fit 16:9 at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
    await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
    const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("img")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder").click();

    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-controls")).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth),
    ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(width);
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("video")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    await hero.locator("video").click();
    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")).toBeVisible();
    const geometry = await hero.evaluate((node) => {
      const v = node.querySelector("video")!.getBoundingClientRect(),
        b = node
          .querySelector(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")!
          .getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        heightError: Math.abs(v.height - (v.width * 9) / 16),
        intrinsicRatio:
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoWidth /
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoHeight,
        dx: Math.abs(v.left + v.width / 2 - b.left - b.width / 2),
        dy: Math.abs(v.top + v.height / 2 - b.top - b.height / 2),
      };
    });
    // The existing 1px shell border affects its inner viewport by under 1px.
    expect(geometry.heightError).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.intrinsicRatio).toBeCloseTo(16 / 9, 5);
    expect(geometry.dx).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.dy).toBeLessThan(1);
  });
```

### File: `tests/dashboard-access.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `3e1bf1b46d0af2bccc0f7ddccdd4771add4a3c9220f17718f3ce981f16394abe`

```typescript
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import { routes } from "../modules/config/navigation";
const protectedPages = [routes.dashboard, routes.library, routes.profile, routes.resources, routes.certificates, routes.admin, routes.adminCourse("7days-freelance")];
for (const path of protectedPages) test(`logged-out requests cannot render ${path}`, async ({ request, page }) => {
  const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
  expect(await response.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  const rsc = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { RSC: "1" } });
  expect(rsc.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(await rsc.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  await page.goto(path);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-dashboard-stats")).toHaveCount(0);
});
test("forged session and old demo cookies cannot unlock the dashboard", async ({ request }) => {
  const response = await request.get(routes.dashboard, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { Cookie: "ta3allam-session=forged; ta3allam-learning=forged; sb-tatseklsvfdpuxuepbfo-auth-token=forged" } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
});
```

### File: `tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs`

SHA-256: `8a9b4ffbaf48683adcd452cf4ccd9936fbb64535d8e806cdfc43ee6de19199a5`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Bundle the real helper graph for browser lifecycle tests. */
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), ts = require("typescript");
function bundleBrowserModule(entry) {
  const modules = {};
  function collect(file) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(modules, file)) return;
    modules[file] = "";
    const code = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"), {
      compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020 },
    }).outputText;
    modules[file] = code.replace(/require\("([^\"]+)"\)/g, (_, request) => {
      if (!request.startsWith(".")) throw new Error(`Unsupported browser dependency: ${request}`);
      const dependency = path.resolve(path.dirname(file), `${request}.ts`);
      collect(dependency);
      return `require(${JSON.stringify(dependency)})`;
    });
  }
  const root = path.resolve(entry);
  collect(root);
  return `const sources=${JSON.stringify(modules)},cache={};
    function load(id){if(cache[id])return cache[id];const result=cache[id]={};
      new Function('require','exports',sources[id])(load,result);return result;}
    Object.assign(exports,load(${JSON.stringify(root)}));`;
}
module.exports = { bundleBrowserModule };
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Test-only transpilation of maintained source with real React JSX. */
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), Module = require("node:module"), ts = require("typescript");
const resolve = Module._resolveFilename;
Module._resolveFilename = function (request, ...args) {
  const target = request.startsWith("@platform/") ? path.resolve("modules", request.slice(10))
    : request.startsWith("@/") ? path.resolve(request.slice(2)) : request;
  return resolve.call(this, target, ...args);
};
for (const extension of [".ts", ".tsx"]) {
  require.extensions[extension] = (module, filename) => {
    if (!["app", "modules", "config", "packages/design-system"].some((root) => filename.startsWith(path.resolve(root) + path.sep))) throw new Error("Only maintained source is compiled");
    module._compile(ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(filename, "utf8"), {
      compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, esModuleInterop: true },
    }).outputText, filename);
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { expect,test } from "@playwright/test";
test("body tolerance leaves child hydration warnings enabled in development", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const target = baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance";
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
      message.type() === "error" &&
      /hydrat|didn't match/i.test(message.text())
    )
      warnings.push(message.text());
  });
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      const heading = document.querySelector("h1");
      if (!heading) return;
      heading.setAttribute("data-test-child-mismatch", "injected");
      observer.disconnect();
    });
    observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  });
  await page.goto(target);

    .poll(() =>
      warnings.some((message) => message.includes("data-test-child-mismatch")),
    )

});
```
