### File: `tests/hydration.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `caf6ded8d001e77c46aaffc0c27585ab532987834ae87898d9a68035de761355`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("extension-injected body attributes do not warn or prevent hydration", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const hydrationWarnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
      message.type() === "error" &&
      /hydrat|didn't match/i.test(message.text())
    )
      hydrationWarnings.push(message.text());
  });
  // Simulate a document-start extension without altering Next's streamed response.
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const inject = () => {
      if (!document.body) return false;
      document.body.setAttribute("cz-shortcut-listen", "true");
      return true;
    };
    if (!inject()) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (inject()) observer.disconnect();
      });
      observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  });
  // Next's dev-origin guard permits localhost by default, unlike its IP alias.
  await page.goto(baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toHaveAttribute(
    "cz-shortcut-listen",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
  await page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first().click();
  await expect(page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first()).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-expanded",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
});
```

### File: `tests/learning-command-contracts.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `6da1ce81f66e6390faa5046e2ebd15c72a0c5b4c7f462c570eb1e7e7997ef437`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { startCourse } from "../modules/features/learning/client/start-course";
import { setLessonCompletion } from "../modules/features/learning/client/complete-lesson";
import { httpRequest } from "../modules/lib/http-request";
import { readLearningResponse } from "../modules/helpers/read-learning-response";

test("R07 workflows order enrollment, progress and navigation and stop on failures", async () => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const enroll = async () => { calls.push("enroll"); };
  const navigation = { push: () => { calls.push("push"); }, refresh: () => { calls.push("refresh"); } };
  const model = { slug: "course", firstLesson: "lesson", enrolled: true, enroll, lessonHref: () => "/lesson", navigation };
  await startCourse(model);
  expect(calls).toEqual(["push"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "push", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false, enroll: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); } })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  const progress = async () => { calls.push("progress"); };
  await setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true, enroll, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: true, completed: true, enroll, progress: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); }, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true,
    enroll: async () => { throw new Error("ENROLL FAILED"); }, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("ENROLL FAILED");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
});

test("R07 successful HTTP responses require decoding and transport allows cancellation/substitution", async () => {
  const signal = new AbortController().signal;
  let passedSignal: AbortSignal | null | undefined;
  const fetcher: typeof fetch = async (_input, init) => { passedSignal = init?.signal; return Response.json({ enrolled: [], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "student@example.com" } }); };
  const options = { path: "/custom", body: {}, failureLabel: "FAIL", decode: readLearningResponse, fetcher, signal };
  expect((await httpRequest(options)).profile.name).toBe("Student");
  expect(passedSignal).toBe(signal);
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ enrolled: "bad" }) })).rejects.toThrow("Invalid learning response");
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ error: "REJECTED" }, { status: 400 }) })).rejects.toThrow("REJECTED");
});

test("R07 completion locks the entire two-request workflow and allows retry after failure", async ({ page }) => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  let release = () => {};
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
  const state = { enrolled: ["first-client"], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "" } };
  await page.route("**/api/enrollments", async (route) => {
    calls.push("enroll");
    await gate;
    await route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(state) });
  });
  await page.route("**/api/progress", async (route) => {
    calls.push("progress");
    await route.fulfill({ status: 400, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "TRY AGAIN" }) });
  });
  await page.goto("/learn/first-client/portfolio");
  const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: "أتممت هذا الدرس", exact: true });
  await button.evaluate((element) => { (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); });
  await expect.poll(() => calls).toEqual(["enroll"]);
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "جارٍ الحفظ…", exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
  release();
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-error[role=alert]")).toHaveText("TRY AGAIN");
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress"]);
  await expect(button).toBeEnabled();
  await button.click();
  await expect.poll(() => calls.length).toBe(4);
});
```

```typescript
  test(`${trigger} reset aborts an unfinished media response while buffering`, async ({ page }) => {

    response.writeHead(request.headers.range ? 206 : 200, {
      "Content-Type": "video/mp4", "Content-Length": bytes.length - start,

      ...(request.headers.range ? { "Content-Range": `bytes ${start}-${bytes.length - 1}/${bytes.length}` } : {}),
    });
    active.add(response);
    let offset = start;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const end = Math.min(offset + 32768, bytes.length);
      response.write(bytes.subarray(offset, end));
      offset = end;
      if (offset === bytes.length) response.end();
    }, 100);
    response.on("close", () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      active.delete(response);
      if (offset < bytes.length) aborted++;
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("Missing media server port");
  try {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    await page.getByLabel("Video URL").fill(`http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/slow.mp4`);
    const player = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const before = aborted;
    if (trigger === "scroll")
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight));
    else
      await page.locator('[data-player="other"]').getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(player.locator("video")).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => aborted).toBeGreaterThan(before);
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBe(0);
    await player.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await expect(player.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    expect(active.size).toBe(0);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
  }
});


for (const previousState of ["playing", "paused"] as const)
  test(`starting another video restores the ${previousState} player's thumbnail and releases its source`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    const first = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    const second = page.locator('[data-player="other"]');
    await first.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    const video = first.locator("video");
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    if (previousState === "paused") {
      await video.click();
      await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(true);
    }
    const previousVideo = await video.elementHandle();
    await second.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(first.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(first.locator("img")).toHaveAttribute("src", "/assets/images/workshop-video-poster.jpg");
    await expect(video).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await previousVideo!.evaluate((node) => ({
      src: node.getAttribute("src"), paused: (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused,
      ready: (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState,
    }))).toEqual({ src: null, paused: true, ready: 0 });
    await expect.poll(() => second.locator("video").evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    const secondVideo = await second.locator("video").elementHandle();
    await first.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(second.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(second.locator("video")).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await secondVideo!.getAttribute("src")).toBeNull();
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    expect(await video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).currentTime)).toBeLessThan(3);
    await expect(page.locator("video")).toHaveCount(1);
  });
```

```tsx
import EmptyState from "../../modules/components/ui/empty-state";
import Symbol from "../../modules/components/ui/symbol";

/** Compile-only negative contracts; unexpected acceptance fails TypeScript. */
export function verifyTypeContracts(course:Course){
 // @ts-expect-error a navigation action cannot be an unlabeled empty-state link
 const empty=<EmptyState title="EMPTY" description="BODY" href="/courses"/>;
 // @ts-expect-error a button cannot receive a navigation destination

}
```

### File: `tests/platform/engine-lifecycle.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `34dca361f985126fb8752933e80468036f99d053f2a9f8ec6bebce594dfc2d65`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type { createScrollReveals } from "../../packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals";
const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));
const { bundleBrowserModule } = require("./tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs");
const compiled = bundleBrowserModule("packages/design-system/lib/scroll-reveals.ts");
test("T25 T26 T27 T28 engine owns targets, future motion and ten clean lifecycles", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
  await page.setContent(
    "<style>body{margin:0;padding-bottom:1000px}[data-reveal]{height:40px}</style>",
  );
  const result = await page.evaluate(async (code) => {
    const create = new Function(
      "exports",
      code + ";return exports.createScrollReveals;",
    )({}) as typeof createScrollReveals;
    const frame = () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
    const tick = async () => {
      await frame();
      await frame();
    };
    const observers = new Set<object>();
    const NativeIntersection = window.IntersectionObserver;
    const NativeMutation = window.MutationObserver;
    window.IntersectionObserver = class extends NativeIntersection {
      observe(target: Element) {
        observers.add(this);
        super.observe(target);
      }
      disconnect() {
        observers.delete(this);
        super.disconnect();
      }
    };
    window.MutationObserver = class extends NativeMutation {
      observe(target: Node, options: MutationObserverInit) {
        observers.add(this);
        super.observe(target, options);
      }
      disconnect() {
        observers.delete(this);
        super.disconnect();
      }
    };
    const listeners = new Set<EventListenerOrEventListenerObject>();
    const preference = new EventTarget() as EventTarget & { matches: boolean };
    preference.matches = false;
    const add = preference.addEventListener.bind(preference),
      remove = preference.removeEventListener.bind(preference);
    preference.addEventListener = (type, listener, options) => {
      if (listener) listeners.add(listener);
      add(type, listener, options);
    };
    preference.removeEventListener = (type, listener, options) => {
      if (listener) listeners.delete(listener);
      remove(type, listener, options);
    };
    const media = preference as unknown as MediaQueryList;
    const options = {
      viewportThreshold: 0.9,
      easing: "linear",
      groups: [{ trigger: "[data-reveal]", y: 32, duration: 1000 }],
    };
    let occurrences = 0,
      duplicate = false,
      offscreenPremature = false,
      intermediate = false,
      reinsertion = false;
    for (let cycle = 0; cycle < 10; cycle++) {
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      const root = document.createElement("div");
      root.dataset.revealScope = "outer";
      root.innerHTML =
        '<div data-reveal>ONE</div><div data-reveal-scope="inner"><div data-reveal>TWO</div></div><div data-reveal style="margin-top:2000px">FUTURE</div>';
      document.body.append(root);
      const one = root.children[0],
        inner = root.children[1] as HTMLElement,
        future = root.children[2];
      const cleanup = create({ root, options, preference: media }),
        cleanupInner = create({ root: inner, options, preference: media });
      await tick();
      const animation = one.getAnimations()[0];
      occurrences += one.getAnimations().length;
      duplicate ||= inner.children[0].getAnimations().length !== 1;
      offscreenPremature ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "paused";
      animation.pause();
      animation.currentTime = 500;
      const opacity = Number(getComputedStyle(one).opacity);
      intermediate ||= opacity > 0 && opacity < 1;
      animation.play();
      // Reduction settles current content and leaves the future occurrence eligible.
      preference.matches = true;
      preference.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= root.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).length !== 0;
      preference.matches = false;
      preference.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= one.getAnimations().length !== 0;
      offscreenPremature ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "paused";
      future.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant" });
      await tick();
      duplicate ||= future.getAnimations()[0]?.playState !== "running";
      // Reusing the same DOM object after removal is a new occurrence.
      future.remove();
      root.append(future);
      await tick();
      reinsertion ||= future.getAnimations().length === 1;
      cleanupInner();
      cleanup();
      root.remove();
      await tick();
      if (observers.size || listeners.size || document.getAnimations().length)
        duplicate = true;
    }
    return {
      occurrences,
      duplicate,
      offscreenPremature,
      intermediate,
      reinsertion,
      observers: observers.size,
      listeners: listeners.size,
    };
  }, compiled);
  expect(result).toEqual({
    occurrences: 10,
    duplicate: false,
    offscreenPremature: false,
    intermediate: true,
    reinsertion: true,
    observers: 0,
    listeners: 0,
  });
});
```

```typescript
import {expect,test} from "@playwright/test";
for(const width of [320,390,768,1440])test(`T29 FAQ expansion, collapse and rapid keyboard toggles at ${width}`,async({page})=>{
 await page.setViewportSize({width,height:900});await page.goto("/");
 const button=page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first(),panel=page.locator(".faq-answer-panel").first();
 await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert","");
 expect(await panel.evaluate(element=>element.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
 await button.press("Enter");await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
 await expect.poll(()=>panel.evaluate(element=>element.getAnimations().length)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
 const opening=await panel.evaluate(element=>{const animation=element.getAnimations()[0];animation.pause();const duration=Number(animation.effect!.getTiming().duration);animation.currentTime=duration/2;const height=element.getBoundingClientRect().height;animation.play();return {duration,height};});
 expect(opening.duration).toBe(500);expect(opening.height).toBeGreaterThan(1);
 await expect.poll(()=>panel.evaluate(element=>element.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
 const full=await panel.evaluate(element=>element.getBoundingClientRect().height);expect(opening.height).toBeLessThan(full);
 await button.press("Space");await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
 await expect.poll(()=>panel.evaluate((element,maximum)=>{const height=element.getBoundingClientRect().height;return height>1&&height<maximum;},full)).toBe(true);
 await expect.poll(()=>panel.evaluate(element=>element.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
 await button.press("Enter");await button.press("Enter");await button.press("Enter");
 await expect(button).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded","true");await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
 await button.press("Enter");await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert","");
 await expect.poll(()=>panel.evaluate(element=>element.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
});

 await page.goto("/courses?category=motion");const item=page.locator(".lms-card-entrance").first();
 await expect.poll(()=>item.evaluate(element=>element.getAnimations().some(animation=>animation.playState==="running"))).toBe(true);
 await expect.poll(()=>item.evaluate(element=>element.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
 const original=await item.elementHandle();
 await page.getByRole("link",{name:"كل الدورات",exact:true}).last().click();
 await expect(page.locator(".lms-course-card")).toHaveCount(6);
 expect(await original!.evaluate(element=>({connected:element.isConnected,count:element.getAnimations().length}))).toEqual({connected:true,count:0});
 await page.getByRole("link",{name:"مونتاج الفيديو",exact:true}).click();await expect(page.locator(".lms-course-card")).toHaveCount(3);
 expect(await original!.evaluate(element=>({connected:element.isConnected,count:element.getAnimations().length}))).toEqual({connected:false,count:0});

 await page.goto("http://localhost:3040/ta3allam");const entrance=page.locator(".lms-card-entrance").first();

 await entrance.evaluate(element=>element.scrollIntoView({behavior:"instant"}));
 await expect.poll(()=>entrance.evaluate(element=>Number(getComputedStyle(element).opacity)>0&&Number(getComputedStyle(element).opacity)<1)).toBe(true);
```

```typescript
test("API validation, isolation, downloads and earned certificates", async ({
  request,
  playwright,
}) => {
  expect(
    (await (await request.get("/api/courses?category=motion")).json()).courses,
  ).toHaveLength(1);
  expect((await request.get("/api/courses/missing")).status()).toBe(404);
  expect(
    (
      await request.post("/api/profile", {
        data: { name: "a", email: "invalid" },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(400);
  expect(
    (
      await request.post("/api/enrollments", {
        headers: { origin: "https://other.test" },
        data: { courseSlug: "motion-essentials" },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(403);
  expect(
    (
      await request.post("/api/progress", {
        data: {
          courseSlug: "motion-essentials",
          lessonId: "keyframes",
          completed: true,
        },
      })
    ).status(),
  ).toBe(403);
  expect(
    (await request.get("/api/certificates/editing-foundations")).status(),
  ).toBe(403);
  const course = (
    await (await request.get("/api/courses/editing-foundations")).json()
  ).course;
  for (const courseModule of course.modules)
    for (const lesson of courseModule.lessons)
      expect(
        (
          await request.post("/api/progress", {
            data: {
              courseSlug: course.slug,
              lessonId: lesson.id,
              completed: true,
            },
          })
        ).ok(),
      ).toBeTruthy();
  expect(
    (await request.get("/api/certificates/editing-foundations")).status(),
  ).toBe(200);
  const other = await playwright.request.newContext({
    baseURL: process.env.TEST_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3040",
  });
  expect(
    (await other.get("/api/certificates/editing-foundations")).status(),
  ).toBe(403);
  await other.dispose();
  const resource = await request.get("/api/resources/project-checklist");
  expect(resource.headers()["content-disposition"]).toContain("attachment");
  expect(await resource.text()).toContain("\n\n");
});

test("readable action labels, metadata and lesson status on mobile", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
  const readability = async (selector: string) =>
    page
      .locator(selector)
      .first()
      .evaluate((element) => {
        const parse = (value: string) => value.match(/[\d.]+/g)!.map(Number);
        const composite = (foreground: number[], background: number[]) =>
          foreground
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map(
              (value, index) =>
                value * (foreground[3] ?? 1) +
                background[index] * (1 - (foreground[3] ?? 1)),
            );
        const luminance = (color: number[]) =>
          color.slice(0, 3).reduce((sum, value, index) => {
            const channel = value / 255;
            return (
              sum +
              (channel <= 0.04045
                ? channel / 12.92
                : ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4) *
                [0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722][index]
            );
          }, 0);
        const ancestors: Element[] = [];
        for (
          let node: Element | null = element;
          node;
          node = node.parentElement
        )
          ancestors.unshift(node);
        const background = ancestors.reduce(
          (color, node) =>
            composite(parse(getComputedStyle(node).backgroundColor), color),
          [255, 255, 255],
        );
        const style = getComputedStyle(element);
        const foreground = composite(parse(style.color), background);
        const a = luminance(foreground),
          b = luminance(background);
        return {
          size: parseFloat(style.fontSize),
          weight: Number(style.fontWeight),
          contrast: (Math.max(a, b) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, b) + 0.05),
        };
      });
  await page.goto("/courses");
  const action = page.locator(".lms-card-action").first();
  for (const hover of [false, true]) {
    if (hover) await action.hover();
    const label = await readability(".lms-card-action");
    expect(label.contrast).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(label.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20);
    expect(label.weight).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(700);
    await expect(action).toHaveCSS("color", "rgb(255, 255, 255)");
  }
  expect((await readability(".lms-card-meta")).size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(14);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-nav-button")).contrast,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  expect((await readability(".lms-search input")).size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
    16,
  );
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-search button")).contrast,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  await page.goto("/learn/editing-foundations/first-cut");
  const status = await readability(".lms-outline-module a small");
  expect(status.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(14);
  expect(status.contrast).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  const lessonTitle = await readability(".lms-outline-module a");
  expect(lessonTitle.size).toBeGreaterThan(status.size);
  expect(lessonTitle.weight).toBeGreaterThan(status.weight);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-lesson-information p")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-notes textarea")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
  await page.goto("/dashboard/profile");
  expect(
    (await readability(".lms-profile-form input")).size,
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(16);
});

test("FAQ transitions finish and reduced motion exposes reveal content", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const question = page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first();
  const panel = page.locator(".faq-answer-panel").first();
  await question.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
  const opening = await question.evaluate(async (button) => {
    const panel = document.getElementById(
      button.getAttribute("aria-controls")!,
    )!;
    panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    (button as HTMLButtonElement).click();
    await Promise.resolve();
    panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    return panel
      .getAnimations()
      .some((animation) => animation.playState === "running");
  });
  expect(opening).toBe(true);
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await panel.boundingBox())?.height ?? 0)
    .toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await question.click();
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await panel.boundingBox())?.height ?? 0)
    .toBe(0);
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await question.click();
  await expect(panel).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await expect
    .poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.getAnimations().length))
    .toBe(0);
  const opacity = await page
    .locator(".lms-reveal")
    .evaluateAll((elements) =>
      elements.map((element) => getComputedStyle(element).opacity),
    );
  expect(opacity.every((value) => value === "1")).toBe(true);
});

test("landing hero visibly enters on load and respects reduced motion", async ({
  page,
}) => {

    .poll(() =>
      heading.evaluate((element) => {

test("course entrances and hover movement are visible and independent", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 720 });
  await page.goto("/courses");
  const entrance = page.locator(".lms-card-entrance").last();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      entrance.evaluate((element) =>
        element
          .getAnimations()
          .some((animation) => animation.playState === "paused"),
      ),
    )
    .toBe(true);
  await entrance.evaluate((element) =>
    element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant" }),
  );
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      entrance.evaluate((element) =>
        element
          .getAnimations()
          .some((animation) => animation.playState === "running"),
      ),
    )
    .toBe(true);
  await expect
    .poll(() => entrance.evaluate((element) => element.getAnimations().length))
    .toBe(0);
  const card = entrance.locator(".lms-course-card");
  await card.hover();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      card.evaluate(
        (element) => new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(element).transform).m42,
      ),
    )
    .toBe(-8);
  const artwork = card.locator(".lms-card-cover svg");
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      artwork.evaluate(
        (element) => new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(element).transform).m11,
      ),
    )
    .toBeCloseTo(1.055, 3);
  const button = card.locator(".lms-card-action");
  await button.hover();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      button.evaluate(
        (element) => new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(element).transform).m42,
      ),
    )
    .toBe(-4);
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await expect(card).toHaveCSS("transform", "none");
  await expect(artwork).toHaveCSS("transform", "none");
  await expect(button).toHaveCSS("transform", "none");
});
```

```typescript
test("original section copy is preserved apart from authorized reel and upcoming preview changes", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const html = readFileSync(
    "docs/evidence/portfolio-reference/source.html",
    "utf8",
  );
  await page.goto("/founder");
  const differences = await page.evaluate((html) => {
    const reference = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, "text/html");
    // HTML formatting inserts whitespace between blocks; React does not.
    // Compare every meaningful text node in order, retaining word spacing.
    const text = (root: Element | null) => {
      if (!root) return "";
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      const parts: string[] = [];
      while (walker.nextNode()) {
        const value = (walker.currentNode.textContent ?? "")
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();
        if (value) parts.push(value);
      }
      return parts.join(" ");
    };
    return [
      ...reference.querySelectorAll("body > section, body > footer"),
    ].flatMap((section) => {
      const actual =
        section.tagName === "FOOTER"
          ? document.querySelector(".personal-footer")
          : document.querySelector(`main > section[id="${section.id}"]`);
      const actualCopy = actual?.cloneNode(true) as Element | null;
      // User approved removing reel captions and replacing the upcoming thumbnail.
      section
        .querySelectorAll(".reel-title, .reel-stats")
        .forEach((node) => node.remove());
      actualCopy
        ?.querySelectorAll(".p-ref-reel-title, .p-ref-reel-stats")
        .forEach((node) => node.remove());
      section.querySelector('.course-yt-card[href="#collab"] .course-yt-thumb')?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelector('.personal-course-upcoming .p-ref-course-yt-thumb')?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelectorAll("[data-project-navigation]").forEach((node) => node.remove());
      section.querySelector(".footer-designer-credit")?.remove();
      actualCopy?.querySelector(".p-ref-footer-designer-credit")?.remove();
      const expected = text(section);
      const received = text(actualCopy);
      return expected === received
        ? []
        : [{ section: section.id || "footer", expected, received }];
    });
  }, html);
  expect(differences).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("T06 radius does not control spacing or footer measure", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  const measure = () =>
    page
      .locator(".lms-navbar,.lms-secondary-button,.lms-footer p")
      .evaluateAll((elements) =>
        elements.map((element) => {
          const css = getComputedStyle(element);
          return { padding: css.padding, gap: css.gap, width: css.maxWidth };
        }),
      );
  const before = await measure();
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--radius-md", "40px");
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--portfolio-radius", "55px");
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      "--measure-testimonial-summary",
      "2ch",
    );
  });
  expect(await measure()).toEqual(before);
  const spacing = await page
    .locator(".lms-secondary-button")
    .first()
    .evaluate((node) => ({
      padding: getComputedStyle(node).padding,
      radius: getComputedStyle(node).borderRadius,
    }));
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--space-control", "43px"),
  );
  const changed = await page
    .locator(".lms-secondary-button")
    .first()
    .evaluate((node) => ({
      padding: getComputedStyle(node).padding,
      radius: getComputedStyle(node).borderRadius,
    }));
  expect(changed.radius).toBe(spacing.radius);
  expect(changed.padding).not.toBe(spacing.padding);
});

test("T08 palette follows primary without changing production identity", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const tokens = () =>
    page.evaluate(() => {
      const sample = document.createElement("div");
      document.body.append(sample);
      const values = [
        "--primary-red-glow",
        "--primary-red-subtle",
        "--primary-red-border",
        "--color-ffa59c",
        "--color-d42010",
      ].map((token) => {
        sample.style.backgroundColor = `var(${token})`;
        return getComputedStyle(sample).backgroundColor;
      });
      sample.remove();
      return values;
    });
  const before = await tokens();
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--primary-red", "#2255fc"),
  );
  const after = await tokens();
  after.forEach((color, index) => expect(color).not.toBe(before[index]));
  expect(after.every((color) => color !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)")).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

for (const kind of ["reel", "hero"] as const) {
  test(`${kind} opens fullscreen without cropping and exits through its button`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
    const player = page.locator(kind === "reel" ? ".reel-card .media-player" : ".hero-video-shell .media-player").first();
    await player.locator(".media-player-poster").click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
    await player.hover();
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "ملء الشاشة", exact: true }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => player.evaluate(node => document.fullscreenElement === node)).toBe(true);
    const video = player.locator("video");
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate(node => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const frame = await video.evaluate(node => {
      const video = node as HTMLVideoElement;
      return { fit: getComputedStyle(video).objectFit, portrait: video.videoHeight > video.videoWidth, controls: video.controls };
    });
    expect(frame.fit).toBe("contain");
    expect(frame.portrait).toBe(kind === "reel");
    expect(frame.controls).toBe(false);
    await video.click();
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate(node => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(true);
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "الخروج من ملء الشاشة" }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement === null)).toBe(true);
    await expect(video).toBeVisible();
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";

const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));

const fixtureUrl = process.env.REUSE_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3043";
async function installSdk(page: import("@playwright/test").Page) {
  await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/javascript", body: youtubeSdkStub }));
  await page.route("**/embed/**", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "text/html", body: "<html></html>" }));
}
async function endSdk(page: import("@playwright/test").Page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const players = (window as unknown as { sdkPlayers: { destroyed: boolean; events: { onStateChange: (event: { data: number }) => void } }[] }).sdkPlayers;
    players.findLast((p) => !p.destroyed)!.events.onStateChange({ data: 0 });
  });
}

test("R08 media bounds handle nonfinite and out-of-range inputs before real property assignments", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  const sources = Object.fromEntries(["native/seek", "native/set-volume", "youtube/seek", "youtube/set-volume"].map((file) => [file, bundleBrowserModule(`packages/design-system/helpers/media/${file}.ts`)]));
  const actual = await page.evaluate((sources) => {
    const modules: Record<string, Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>> = {};
    for (const [name, source] of Object.entries(sources)) { const exports = {}; new Function("exports", source as string)(exports); modules[name] = exports; }
    const video = document.createElement("video"); Object.defineProperty(video, "duration", { value: 100 });
    const levels: number[] = [], seeks: number[] = [];
    const sdk = { seekTo: (value: number) => seeks.push(value), setVolume: (value: number) => levels.push(value), mute() {}, unMute() {}, isMuted: () => false };
    let publications = 0; const publish = () => publications++;
    for (const value of [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity]) {
      modules["native/seek"].seekNativeVideo(video, value, publish);
      modules["native/set-volume"].setNativeVolume(video, value);
      modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, 100, value, publish);
      modules["youtube/set-volume"].setYouTubeVolume(sdk, value, publish);
    }
    const invalidPublications = publications;
    for (const value of [-1, 200]) {
      modules["native/seek"].seekNativeVideo(video, value, publish);
      modules["native/set-volume"].setNativeVolume(video, value);
      modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, 100, value, publish);
      modules["youtube/set-volume"].setYouTubeVolume(sdk, value, publish);
    }
    modules["youtube/seek"].seekYouTubePlayer(sdk, Infinity, 1, publish);
    return { invalidPublications, seeks, levels, time: video.currentTime, volume: video.volume };
  }, sources);
  expect(actual).toEqual({ invalidPublications: 0, seeks: [0, 100], levels: [0, 100], time: 100, volume: 1 });
});
```

### File: `tests/player-snapshot-helpers.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `7219aa33ff3d5c311b5365c79136ebfadf71800295dd147e8453c837d04bff2f`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { initialPlayerSnapshot } from "../packages/design-system/helpers/media/initial-snapshot";
import { readNativeSnapshot } from "../packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/read-snapshot";

test("native snapshot priority preserves loading, error and completion across nonfinite media values", () => {
  const previous = initialPlayerSnapshot();
  const video = { error: null as MediaError | null, ended: false, paused: true, readyState: 0,
    currentTime: Number.NaN, duration: Infinity, volume: .375, muted: true };
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous)).toEqual({
    status: "loading", ready: false, time: 0, duration: 0, volume: 38, muted: true,
  });
  video.readyState = 2;
  video.paused = false;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("buffering");
  video.readyState = 3;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("playing");
  video.ended = true;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous).status).toBe("ended");
  video.error = {} as MediaError;
  expect(readNativeSnapshot(video as HTMLVideoElement, previous)).toMatchObject({ status: "error", ready: false });
});
```

### File: `tests/reel-motion.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `b94165999a57e400659253260bf195379a1a34be49caa6c110b84d7b13c05a82`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("creator marquee moves left and repeats without a gap or position jump", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  const track = page.locator(".creators-track");
  await expect.poll(() => track.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(1);
  const motion = await track.evaluate((node) => {
    const animation = node.getAnimations()[0];
    animation.pause();
    const duration = Number(animation.effect!.getTiming().duration);
    animation.currentTime = 0;
    const first = node.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().left;
    const start = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m41;
    animation.currentTime = duration / 4;
    const quarter = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m41;
    animation.currentTime = duration - 1;
    const repeat = node.children[node.children.length / 2].getBoundingClientRect().left;
    return { start, quarter, seam: Math.abs(first - repeat), iterations: animation.effect!.getTiming().iterations };
  });
  expect(motion.quarter).toBeLessThan(motion.start);
  expect(motion.iterations).toBe(Infinity);
  expect(motion.seam).toBeLessThan(0.2);
});

test("reduced motion reproduces the static reels and turning it off restores animation", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const card = page.locator(".reel-card").first();
  const track = page.locator(".creators-track");
  await expect(track).toHaveCSS("animation-name", "none");
  await expect(card).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await expect(card.locator(".reel-play-btn")).toHaveCSS("transition-duration", "0s");
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
  await expect(track).toHaveCSS("animation-name", "marqueeScroll");
  await expect.poll(() => track.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) => animation.playState === "running"))).toBe(true);
  expect(await card.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).transitionDuration)).toContain("0.5s");
  await card.hover();
  await expect.poll(() => card.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) =>
    animation instanceof CSSTransition && animation.transitionProperty === "transform",
  ))).toBe(true);
});
```

```typescript
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import {
  remainingCountdownSeconds,
  resolveCountdownDeadline,
} from "../app/lib/countdown";

test("alternate content and multiple instances work independently", () => {
  execFileSync(process.execPath, ["tests/helpers/render-reuse.cjs"], {
    stdio: "pipe",
  });
});

test("campaigns isolate storage and refresh cadence does not alter elapsed seconds", () => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  const storage = {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      values.set(key, value);
    },
  };
  const options = {
    endsAt: null,
    durationSeconds: 60,
    storageKey: "campaign-a",
    tickMs: 250,
  };
  const first = resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 1000, storage);
  expect(first).toBe(61000);
  expect(remainingCountdownSeconds(first, 2000)).toBe(59);
  expect(resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 2000, storage)).toBe(first);
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(
      { ...options, storageKey: "campaign-b" },
      2000,
      storage,
    ),
  ).toBe(62000);
  expect(remainingCountdownSeconds(first, 70000)).toBe(0);
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(
      { ...options, endsAt: "2026-10-07T00:00:00Z" },
      0,
      storage,
    ),
  ).toBe(Date.parse("2026-10-07T00:00:00Z"));
  expect(
    resolveCountdownDeadline(options, 0, {
      getItem() {
        throw new Error("blocked");
      },
      setItem() {},
    }),
  ).toBe(60000);
});
```

### File: `tests/shared-contracts.typecheck.ts`

SHA-256: `2c5d855b4acc5dd8553fa8c39dfcf4bb8f737311d1881016afd245c1936da4ea`

```typescript
import type { MenuDismissalOptions } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-menu-dismissal";
import type { ScrollRevealHookOptions } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-scroll-reveals";
import type { NativeSubscriptionOptions } from "@khatab/design/helpers/media/native/subscribe";
import type { LessonOutlineOptions } from "@platform/features/learning/helpers/lesson-outline";
import type { MobileMenuOptions } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
/** Required ownership and domain dependencies must stay explicit as optional settings grow. */
export function verifySharedContracts() {
  // @ts-expect-error a dismissal lifecycle needs an owner and close action
  const menu: MenuDismissalOptions = { open: true };
  // @ts-expect-error a reveal lifecycle cannot infer which page owns its elements
  const reveal: ScrollRevealHookOptions = { enabled: true };
  // @ts-expect-error publication cannot be omitted from a native subscription
  const native: NativeSubscriptionOptions = { video: {} as HTMLVideoElement, sourceUrl: "demo.mp4" };
  // @ts-expect-error a domain outline cannot supply application routes implicitly
  const outline: LessonOutlineOptions = { course: {} as LessonOutlineOptions["course"], state: {} as LessonOutlineOptions["state"] };
  const defaults: MobileMenuOptions = {};
  const configured: MobileMenuOptions = { breakpointToken: "--custom-breakpoint", initialOpen: true };
  return { menu, reveal, native, outline, defaults, configured };
}
```

### File: `tests/shared-helper-contracts.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `d6b5198f2037e6e4c3d27d08ad9996225a1dd3cb83b7fe0398b3ed0acf1072b2`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type { subscribeDismissal } from "@khatab/design/helpers/navigation/subscribe-dismissal";
import type { pauseOtherVideos } from "@khatab/design/helpers/media/native/pause-other-videos";
const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));
const { bundleBrowserModule } = require("./tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs");

test("menu dismissal respects owner, optional focus policy and cleanup", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setContent('<nav id="root"><button id="inside">Inside</button></nav><button id="toggle">Toggle</button><button id="outside">Outside</button>');
  const result = await page.evaluate((code) => {
    const subscribe = new Function("exports", code + ";return exports.subscribeDismissal;")({}) as typeof subscribeDismissal;
    const root = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#root")!;
    const toggle = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#toggle")!;
    const outside = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#outside")!;
    let closes = 0;
    const dispose = subscribe({ root, toggle, onClose: () => closes++ });
    root.firstElementChild!.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerdown", { bubbles: true }));
    toggle.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerdown", { bubbles: true }));
    const insideCount = closes;
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape" }));
    const restored = document.activeElement === toggle;
    outside.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerdown", { bubbles: true }));
    dispose();
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape" }));
    const afterDispose = closes;
    outside.focus();
    const noFocus = subscribe({ root, toggle, onClose: () => closes++, restoreFocus: false });
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape" }));
    const retained = document.activeElement === outside;
    noFocus();
    return { insideCount, restored, afterDispose, closes, retained };
  }, bundleBrowserModule("packages/design-system/helpers/navigation/subscribe-dismissal.ts"));
  expect(result).toEqual({ insideCount: 0, restored: true, afterDispose: 2, closes: 3, retained: true });
});

test("native playback scope is configurable and defaults to the owning document", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setContent('<section id="panel"><video id="active"></video><video id="sibling"></video></section><video id="unrelated"></video>');
  const result = await page.evaluate((code) => {
    const pause = new Function("exports", code + ";return exports.pauseOtherVideos;")({}) as typeof pauseOtherVideos;
    const panel = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#panel")!;
    const active = document.querySelector<HTMLVideoElement>("#active")!;
    const paused: string[] = [];
    document.querySelectorAll("video").forEach((video) => { video.pause = () => { paused.push(video.id); }; });
    pause(active, panel);
    const scoped = [...paused];
    paused.length = 0;
    pause(active);
    return { scoped, defaults: paused };
  }, bundleBrowserModule("packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/pause-other-videos.ts"));
  expect(result).toEqual({ scoped: ["sibling"], defaults: ["sibling", "unrelated"] });
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

for (const site of [
  { name: "workshop", url: "http://localhost:3040/7days-freelance", menu: ".nav-links", toggle: ".mobile-nav-toggle", card: ".client-work-card", reveal: ".clients-grid" },
  { name: "LMS", url: "http://localhost:3040/ta3allam", menu: ".lms-marketing-links", toggle: ".lms-mobile-toggle", card: ".lms-course-card", reveal: ".lms-card-entrance" },
]) {
  test(`${site.name} shares smooth motion and animates FAQ/menu in both directions`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 900 });
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
    await page.goto(site.url);
    const theme = await page.locator("body").evaluate((node) => {
      const style = getComputedStyle(node);
      return ["--motion-duration-control", "--motion-duration-surface", "--motion-duration-reveal", "--motion-easing"]
        .map((token) => style.getPropertyValue(token).trim());
    });
    // Production CSS minification may express milliseconds in seconds.
    expect(theme.slice(0, 3).map((value) => parseFloat(value) * (value.endsWith("ms") ? 1 : 1000)))
      .toEqual([300, 500, 500]);
    expect(theme[3].match(/[\d.]+/g)?.map(Number)).toEqual([0.4, 0, 0.2, 1]);
    await expect.poll(() => page.locator(site.reveal).first().evaluate((node) =>
      node.getAnimations().some((animation) => animation.effect?.getTiming().duration === 500),
    )).toBe(true);
    const card = page.locator(site.card).first();
    const cardMotion = await card.evaluate((node) => {
      const style = getComputedStyle(node);
      const index = style.transitionProperty.split(", ").indexOf("transform");
      return style.transitionDuration.split(", ")[index];
    });
    expect(parseFloat(cardMotion)).toBe(0.5);
    const menu = page.locator(site.menu);
    const toggle = page.locator(site.toggle);
    await expect(menu).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
    await toggle.click();
    await expect(menu).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) =>
      animation instanceof CSSTransition && animation.transitionProperty === "opacity" && animation.effect?.getTiming().duration === 500,
    ))).toBe(true);
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).opacity)).toBe("1");
    await toggle.click();
    await expect(menu).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) =>
      animation instanceof CSSTransition && animation.transitionProperty === "opacity",
    ))).toBe(true);
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).visibility)).toBe("hidden");
    const question = page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first();
    const panel = page.locator(".faq-answer-panel").first();
    await question.click();
    await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().some((animation) =>
      animation instanceof CSSTransition && animation.transitionProperty === "grid-template-rows" && animation.effect?.getTiming().duration === 500,
    ))).toBe(true);
    await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
    const height = await panel.evaluate((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    expect(height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await question.click();
    await expect(panel).toHaveAttribute("inert", "");
    expect(await panel.evaluate((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBe(0);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
    await question.click();
    await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
    await question.click();
    await expect.poll(() => panel.evaluate((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect().height)).toBe(0);
    await toggle.click();
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).opacity)).toBe("1");
    await toggle.click();
    await expect.poll(() => menu.evaluate((node) => getComputedStyle(node).visibility)).toBe("hidden");
    expect(await menu.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
  });
}

for (const site of [
  { name: "workshop", url: "http://localhost:3040/7days-freelance", card: ".client-work-card" },
  { name: "LMS", url: "http://localhost:3040/ta3allam", card: ".lms-course-card" },
]) {
  test(`${site.name} hover and leave visibly interpolate instead of snapping`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "no-preference" });
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await page.goto(site.url);
    await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
    const card = page.locator(site.card).first();
    await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    // Settle ancestor entrance transforms before measuring the hover itself.
    await expect.poll(() => card.evaluate((node) => {
      for (let parent = node.parentElement; parent; parent = parent.parentElement)
        if (parent.getAnimations().some((animation) => animation.playState === "running")) return false;
      return true;
    })).toBe(true);
    const offset = () => card.evaluate((node) => new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m42);
    expect(await offset()).toBe(0);
    // Sample the browser's transition timeline directly; hover() itself can
    // consume part of the duration when the test machine is busy.
    const sampleQuarter = () => card.evaluate((node) => {
      const animation = node.getAnimations().find((entry) =>
        entry instanceof CSSTransition && entry.transitionProperty === "transform",
      );
      if (!animation?.effect) throw new Error("Expected a live transform transition");
      const duration = Number(animation.effect.getTiming().duration);
      animation.pause();
      animation.currentTime = duration / 4;
      const y = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(node).transform).m42;
      animation.play();
      return { duration, y };
    });
    await card.hover();
    const entering = await sampleQuarter();
    expect(entering.duration).toBe(500);
    const enterQuarter = entering.y;
    await expect.poll(() => card.evaluate((node) => node.getAnimations().length)).toBe(0);
    const hovered = await offset();
    expect(hovered).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(enterQuarter).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(enterQuarter).toBeGreaterThan(hovered);
    // The old front-loaded curve travelled ~60% in 200ms; the new curve settles gradually.
    expect(enterQuarter / hovered).toBeLessThan(0.5);
    await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
    const leaving = await sampleQuarter();
    expect(leaving.duration).toBe(500);
    const leaveQuarter = leaving.y;
    expect(leaveQuarter).toBeGreaterThan(hovered);
    expect(leaveQuarter).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(leaveQuarter / hovered).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
    await expect.poll(offset).toBe(0);
    // Reversing before completion must continue from the current visual position.
    await card.hover();
    const beforeLeave = (await sampleQuarter()).y;
    await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
    const afterLeave = await offset();
    expect(afterLeave).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(Math.abs(afterLeave - beforeLeave)).toBeLessThan(Math.abs(hovered) / 2);
    await expect.poll(offset).toBe(0);
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("one featured review and three smaller reviews expand from a centered primary action", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const section = page.locator("#testimonials");
  await expect(section.locator(".featured-review-card")).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(section.locator(".review-card")).toHaveCount(3);
  const more = section.getByRole("button", { name: "عرض المزيد", exact: true });
  await more.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await expect(more).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  const geometry = await more.evaluate(node => {
    const button = node.getBoundingClientRect();
    const parent = node.parentElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { color: getComputedStyle(node).color, center: Math.abs(button.x + button.width / 2 - parent.x - parent.width / 2) };
  });
  expect(geometry.color).toBe("rgb(252, 53, 34)");
  expect(geometry.center).toBeLessThan(1);
  await more.hover();
  await expect(more).toHaveCSS("text-decoration-line", "underline");
  await more.click();
  await expect(section.locator(".review-card")).toHaveCount(9);
  await expect(section.locator(".review-revealed")).toHaveCount(6);
  await expect(more).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(section.locator(".featured-review-card")).toHaveCount(1);
});

test("fullscreen action is hidden until hover or keyboard focus; play remains inline", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const player = page.locator(".hero-video-shell .media-player");
  await player.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
  const control = player.getByRole("button", { name: "ملء الشاشة", exact: true });
  await expect(control).toHaveCSS("opacity", "0");
  await player.hover();
  await expect(control).toHaveCSS("opacity", "1");
  const position = await control.evaluate(node => {
    const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect(), parent = node.parentElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { right: rect.right > parent.x + parent.width / 2, top: rect.y < parent.y + parent.height / 2 };
  });
  expect(position).toEqual({ right: true, top: true });
  await player.locator(".media-player-poster").click();
  await expect(player.locator("video")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.fullscreenElement)).toBeNull();
  await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
  await expect(control).toHaveCSS("opacity", "0");
  await page.keyboard.press("Tab");
  await control.focus();
  await expect(control).toHaveCSS("opacity", "1");
});
```

### File: `tests/youtube-player-helpers.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `347d67f4cde2a26dae595813a97df34ba275a0e78778d2fc77f3fcb7b1c4603a`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { youtubeSdkStub } from "./helpers/youtube-sdk-stub";
const fixtureUrl = process.env.REUSE_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3043";
test("shared YouTube helpers defer SDK, handle controls and release a replaced player", async ({ page }) => {
  let sdkLoads = 0;
  await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api", (route) => {
    sdkLoads++;
    return route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/javascript", body: youtubeSdkStub });
  });
  await page.route("**/embed/**", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "text/html", body: "<html></html>" }));
  await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/youtube-player`);
  expect(sdkLoads).toBe(0);
  await expect(page.locator("iframe")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK" }).click();
  const player = page.getByRole("region", { name: "SDK player" });
  await expect(player.getByRole("button", { name: "PAUSE", exact: true })).toBeEnabled();
  await expect(page.locator("iframe")).toHaveAttribute("src", /controls=0.*enablejsapi=1/);
  await player.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press("k");
  await expect(player.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press("ArrowRight");
  await expect(player.getByRole("slider", { name: "SEEK" })).toHaveValue("5");
  await page.keyboard.press("m");
  await expect(player.getByRole("button", { name: "UNMUTE" })).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Toggle player" }).click();
  await expect(page.locator("iframe")).toHaveCount(0);
  const destroyed = () => page.evaluate(() => {
    const records = (window as Window & { sdkPlayers?: { destroyed: boolean }[] }).sdkPlayers;
    return records?.map((record) => record.destroyed) ?? [];
  });
  expect(await destroyed()).toEqual([true]);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Toggle player" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK" }).click();
  await expect(player.getByRole("button", { name: "PAUSE", exact: true })).toBeEnabled();
  expect(sdkLoads).toBe(1);
  expect(await destroyed()).toEqual([true, false]);
});

test("failed shared SDK loading is recoverable on retry", async ({ page }) => {
  let sdkLoads = 0;
  await page.route("https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api", (route) => {
    sdkLoads++;
    return sdkLoads === 1 ? route.abort() : route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/javascript", body: youtubeSdkStub });
  });
  await page.route("**/embed/**", (route) => route.fulfill({ contentType: "text/html", body: "<html></html>" }));
  await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/youtube-player`);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Activate SDK" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "SDK player" }).getByRole("alert")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "RETRY" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "PAUSE", exact: true })).toBeEnabled();
  expect(sdkLoads).toBe(2);
});
```
